reviews.text:
It could be great...

There are some wonderful exhibits and pieces to see/experience, the curators have done an exceptional job bringing together an eclectic mix of works from across multiple periods with global reference.  The spaces are in the main light and easy to move around, the modern-era galleries however were freezing cold compared to the rest, making it a little uncomfortable.
There is plenty of space outside to rest and relax and take in the bizarre spectacle of people walking the dock.

However;
The wayfinding signage is effectively non-existent, whilst the layout of exhibits is confused making it occasionally difficult to identify where the path for each room starts.
Especially in the first spaces, the information signs on the floor are almost unreadable due to their location, especially when it's busy, whilst in the remainder of the galleries there is really not much information shared for each piece.
The gallery introduction text is illogically placed, in most spaces it is effectively behind you and easily missed.
The guided talk via the app contains numerous basic pronunciation errors, and serves to provide little additional information beyond that on the introduction passages and piece descriptions.  When it is busy, as it was when we visited, it doesn't feel comfortable to be able to try to read information boards as people push past or are otherwise 'instagramming' their way through life, so the lack of audio information was a little disappointing.
There are no places to sit and observe the pieces as you would in a typical gallery/museum space, especially those of scale, whilst the prohibitive security controls (whilst assuredly required to cater to the lowest denominator of visitor) preclude what is a fairly standard practice of note-taking and observational sketching/drawing in other places.

Overall Louvre Abu Dhabi is well worth a visit, and upcoming exhibitions will certainly be visited, however it's a shame that the overall experience caters more to those who want to say they have been, rather than those who truly want to experience the pieces and the space.

reviews.text:
It could be great...

There are some wonderful exhibits and pieces to see/experience, the curators have done an exceptional job bringing together an eclectic mix of works from across multiple periods with global reference.  The spaces are in the main light and easy to move around, the modern-era galleries however were freezing cold compared to the rest, making it a little uncomfortable.
There is plenty of space outside to rest and relax and take in the bizarre spectacle of people walking the dock.

However;
The wayfinding signage is effectively non-existent, whilst the layout of exhibits is confused making it occasionally difficult to identify where the path for each room starts.
Especially in the first spaces, the information signs on the floor are almost unreadable due to their location, especially when it's busy, whilst in the remainder of the galleries there is really not much information shared for each piece.
The gallery introduction text is illogically placed, in most spaces it is effectively behind you and easily missed.
The guided talk via the app contains numerous basic pronunciation errors, and serves to provide little additional information beyond that on the introduction passages and piece descriptions.  When it is busy, as it was when we visited, it doesn't feel comfortable to be able to try to read information boards as people push past or are otherwise 'instagramming' their way through life, so the lack of audio information was a little disappointing.
There are no places to sit and observe the pieces as you would in a typical gallery/museum space, especially those of scale, whilst the prohibitive security controls (whilst assuredly required to cater to the lowest denominator of visitor) preclude what is a fairly standard practice of note-taking and observational sketching/drawing in other places.

Overall Louvre Abu Dhabi is well worth a visit, and upcoming exhibitions will certainly be visited, however it's a shame that the overall experience caters more to those who want to say they have been, rather than those who truly want to experience the pieces and the space.

We went to Louvre Abu Dhabi, an annex of the Louvre Museum in Paris.
The surrounding area was crowded, but once inside the museum it wasn't so noticeable and I was able to enjoy the exhibits at my own pace.

It's not as large as the Louvre in France,
but there are a fair number of exhibits, so it will take some time to see everything.
Photography is permitted inside the museum.

We didn't have much time so we left after about an hour, but honestly it was a shame.
It's best to buy your tickets online in advance.
They're a little cheaper and allow for smoother entry.
reviews.author: Rei

reviews.text:
The Louvre at Abu Dhabi is really only for those who are seriously interested in history, art, and most importantly, have the patience to read all the name plates and descriptions.

If not, it is a short walk through a very modern looking building that literally sits on the sea. There were some gorgeous, ancient sculptures, paintings, and even jewellery. There were so many ancient pieces from long dead civilizations with the only exception being the pieces from the Indian civilization (meaning the Indian civilization is the only one that survived to modern day). There were also more relatively contemporary works from the last 500 years.

reviews.text:
The Louvre Abu Dhabi is a beautifully designed museum with a clean, post-modern layout. The iconic steel dome is both striking and practical — a perfect parasol under the sun. The experience feels immersive, with thoughtfully curated displays that guide you smoothly through history.

Highlights for me were the bulla, the statue of Ramses II, and the paintings of the Virgin Mary and other Christian relics — truly exquisite pieces. The museum connects cultures and eras effortlessly, making it both engaging and meaningful.

A must-visit in Abu Dhabi. Elegant, inspiring and genuinely memorable. 🏛️✨

reviews.text:
Bu müzeyi grup turuyla ziyaret ettim. Dubai ve Abu Dabi’deki her şey gibi bu bina, harika bir zevk ve modern mimari sergiliyor. Burası Louvre adını kullanıyor ancak orijinaliyle rekabet etmeyi düşünmüyor. Sergiler çoğunlukla heykellerdir, ancak sergilerin düzenlemesi gözüme çok hoş geliyor. Akşam saatlerinde vardık ve onu görmek için yalnızca 2 saatimiz vardı. O yüzden kız arkadaşım ve ben hızımızı hızlandırdık ve oradaki her şeyi hızlı bir tempoda bile hayranlıkla izleyebildik.
Büyüleyici sergiler, sizi dünyanın farklı bölgelerini birbirine bağlayan, asırlarca süren bir arazi gezintisine çıkarır. Ekranların çoğu etkileşimliydi ve bu da deneyimi iyileştirdi.

Mamluklar, 1250-1517 yılları arasında büyülüydü; yükselmelerini, sanatları, kültürleri ve mirasıyla tarihe nasıl etki ettiğini gösteriyorlardı.

Biletler makul fiyatlıydı ve fiyatına kıyasla yüksek değer verdiğimi düşündüm. Kafe, hak ettiğiniz bir mola veriyor ve hediyelik eşya dükkânı hediyelik eşyalarla dolu. Otobüs veya taksi kullanmak çok kolay.

Personel cana yakın, yardımsever ve bilgili. Gezginlerin, farklı kültürlerin ve bölgelerin sanat ve tasarım yoluyla nasıl bir araya geldiğine dair bilgi edinmek için burayı ziyaret etmelerini tavsiye ederim.

reviews.text:
A Must-Visit Cultural Spot in Abu Dhabi

We visited Manarat Al Saadiyat during the National Day holidays, and it turned out to be one of the best family experiences we’ve had in Abu Dhabi. This place is perfect for both tourists and residents who want to enjoy arts, culture, and creative activities in a welcoming and beautifully designed space.

The outdoor area was decorated so nicely for the occasion — very pretty, festive, and great for photos. The whole environment feels peaceful, artistic, and thoughtfully planned.

Inside, the kids’ workshop was a real highlight. It was extremely affordable, which is rare in Abu Dhabi, and the activities were high quality. My child enjoyed dressing up in traditional Emirati clothing, posing at an authentic photography stand, and doing art activities like bag painting and various craft projects. Everything was hands-on, fun, and run by friendly staff who clearly love what they do.

There was also a very interesting exhibition inside, which made the visit enjoyable for adults as well. Manarat Al Saadiyat is known for changing exhibitions, so there is usually something new to see each time you visit.

Another big positive is their drop-in art classes for kids. These are set up in a super creative, inspiring environment, and are perfect for families who want their children to experience art in a relaxed, modern space. The whole setup feels very “artsy” in the best way — creative, modern, and thoughtfully curated.

The facilities are excellent too. There is a lovely coffee shop right at the entrance, great for a quick break, and a restaurant on the side if you want something more substantial. Between the workshops, exhibitions, cafés, and beautiful indoor and outdoor areas, you can easily spend a few hours here.

Easy to get by car with spacious parking, taxi drop off and even bus stop is very close.

Manarat Al Saadiyat is a place I’ve been visiting for three years now, and every time it fills me with a fresh wave of inspiration.
I visited the gallery yesterday, and once again I was impressed by the exceptional level of organization and attention to detail. You can truly feel the respect for art and for the audience.

Many of the works on display stunned me with their depth and professionalism. It’s clear that the curators carefully select each exhibition, creating a space where you don’t just view art - you experience it.

As an artist, I deeply appreciate cultural initiatives like this. I sincerely wish exhibitions of this level were held more often and lasted longer, as they genuinely enrich the creative community.

I highly recommend visiting, whether you’re an art lover or simply seeking a place to recharge with new ideas and emotions🎨✨

Specifically stopped by here to try the camel. The restaurant is located within Emirate Palace, which was a really beautiful place to look around. The palace reeked of opulence and extravagance which was very different from what I'm used to.
After getting to the restaurant with my booking, I was served doughnuts, dates and special coffee. The doughnuts were really amazing. I had the choice for inside or outdoor dining and opted to eat outside. The outdoor area had booths with very comfortable seats. After getting the menu I did feel like I was forgotten for a bit. Due to its location, it was hard to get anyone's attention without having to leave the table.
After getting to order, the item I wanted wasn't available so I ended with going with the other camel dish. I was also recommended the camel milk with dates.
The camel milk was interesting. It didn't have a strong milk flavour but that could have been due to the dates. It was kinda hard to drink though since the date pieces kept getting stuck in the straw.
I started with the veal harees, which was like a meat pate. The meat was spiced very delicately but the texture was a bit weird for me, almost gummy. It did go really well with the pita bread. The pita bread was delicious. I found the camel chop a bit dry. The vegetables that came with it were seasoned and cooked well.
I had the angel hair and kashta for dessert. There was a pistachio and honey parfait on one side and angel hair filled with cream and topped with chocolate on the other. Both items were nice.
The food was made well but it wasn't something that I would go for again, particularly due to the price. Service was really nice when they were there, but that could have been due to the time, as I arrived there quite late (2130). Overall it was an interesting experience.

reviews.text:
Observation Deck at 300 rozhodně stojí za návštěvu a patří k nejlepším vyhlídkám v Abu Dhabi. Jedná se o nejvýše veřejně přístupné vyhlídkové místo ve městě, které se nachází ve věži Etihad Towers ve výšce přibližně 300 metrů.
Vstupenky lze bez problémů koupit přímo dole pod věží, není nutná žádná rezervace předem. Děti do 6 let mají vstup zdarma, což je velké plus pro rodiny. Pro starší děti a dospělé je cena podle mého názoru přiměřená tomu, jaký zážitek vyhlídka nabízí.
Samotný výhled je opravdu krásný a panoramatický na všechny strany. Přímo pod vámi se rozprostírá ikonický Qasr Al Watan (Prezidentský palác), jehož architektura vynikne právě z této výšky. Zároveň je skvěle vidět luxusní Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental, dále pobřeží Corniche, Arabský záliv a velká část města.
Vyhlídka je krytá, klimatizovaná a velmi příjemná i v teplejších měsících. Součástí je i menší kavárna, takže si můžete dát kávu nebo něco malého a výhled si v klidu vychutnat. Návštěva není časově omezená, takže není kam spěchat.
Shrnutí:
jedno z nejlepších míst, odkud získáte kompletní představu o Abu Dhabi, jeho architektuře i poloze u moře. Skvělé jak pro první návštěvu města, tak jako rychlá zastávka během dne. Jednoznačně doporučuji.

reviews.text:
Das Observation Deck 300 bietet eine unglaubliche Aussicht auf den Emirates Palace, und den Präsidentenpalast Qasr Al Watan! Die auf 305 Meter Höhe befindliche Aussichtsplattform, bietet einen rund um Blick, sowie einen Kaffee, in dem die Eintrittskarte für die Plattform, zum Teil für den Verzehr genutzt werden kann! Zudem gibt es auf der Aussichtsplattform auch einige Infotafeln, auf denen erklärt wird, wo sich bestimmte Gebäude befinden!

Eintritt: 95 AED (davon 50 als Freiverzehr im Café)

Hinweis: es gibt auch Ferngläser die für 1 Dirham genutzt werden können!

Tipp: um 19:15 Uhr findet die Lichtershow am Präsidentenpalast Stadt, die von der Aussichtsplattform aus beobachtet werden kann!

Benötigte Zeit: vormittags kann man circa 30 Minuten für das Observation Deck einplanen! Abends wenn die Lichtershow am Präsidentenpalast stattfindet, kann man auch 45 Minuten einplanen!

reviews.text: Nie ma co ukrywać, że to najpiękniejszy punkt widokowy w całym Abu Dhabi. Widoki z budynku Etihad Towers zapierają dech w piersi. Podobnie panorama na zatokę i Hotel Atlantis zostanie z nami na długo. Warto rozpocząć zwiedzanie Abu Dhabi właśnie od tego miejsca.

the perfect spot to unwind. Very beautiful and relaxing ambience with a great view of Abu Dhabi. We chose the AED 95 package, which includes AED 50 worth of food consumables, and it was definitely worth it. The food was excellent and portions were generous. The salmon was very fresh (no fishy smell at all), and the pumpkin salad was surprisingly delicious and well balanced.
Madela and Neba were both super friendly, attentive, and genuinely pleasant. They made us feel comfortable, checked on us at the right times, and added a really nice personal touch to the whole experience.Overall, I’d highly recommend this place and the package. reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience at Observation Deck 300, Conrad Etihad Towers

I had a very disappointing experience at the Observation Deck 300. I called around 3:00 PM to ask if I needed to make a reservation, and the person on the phone told me it’s a walk-in venue, not busy, and that no booking was needed. They never mentioned that seating is on a first-come, first-served basis.

I arrived around 4:00 PM, planning to spend about an hour and a half enjoying the view with my guest who came from outside Abu Dhabi especially for this visit. However, when I arrived, the lady at the reception said there were no available tables and that I could only go up to see the view without being seated.

After I explained that I had called in advance and that a proper table was important for the experience, she said she would check and offered me a table near the TV — not by the window and definitely not with a view. When I asked to see it, she only showed me a photo, and it was clearly unsuitable.

I decided to skip dining and just visit the deck, but once I went up, I was surprised to see several empty tables available. The bigger disappointment, however, was the view itself — the glass was dirty and completely ruined the experience.

Overall, from the reception to the deck, the experience was extremely disappointing and not worth the effort. It’s a shame because this place has great potential as a major tourist spot in Abu Dhabi, but poor management and lack of maintenance make it fall short.

Definitely not an experience I would repeat or recommend.

Attached some pictures.

reviews.text:
The best panoramic view in Abu Dhabi! As a hotel guest at the Conrad, I didn’t need a ticket to access the Observation Deck — definitely a perk worth taking advantage of. The views stretch from the Corniche all the way to the Emirates Palace and the open Gulf — absolutely stunning, especially near sunset.

It’s a calm and elegant spot most of the day, but it can get crowded when tour groups arrive, so try to go early in the morning or later in the evening for a quieter experience. There’s also a café where you can sit by the windows and soak in the skyline with tea or mocktails — worth every minute.

reviews.text:
Prison Island was really fun. There were 26 rooms with different specialties, and they required different skills. For example, some rooms required more skill like the basketball game, some required strength like Shark Bay, and some required brains like the Einstein room. I went with my friends, and it was very worth it, especially with other people.

The price felt very reasonable for the experience. There were six of us and we played for two hours, which was a lot of fun. Each person was supposed to pay 200, but thanks to a voucher we only paid 100, which made it an even better deal overall. If you are going with a group larger than 5, I recommend splitting yourselves into groups of 2-3, since most rooms are designed for 1–3 players and some rooms require exactly 3. It wouldn’t be fun if everyone was in the same group because it would be chaotic.

We split into groups of 3, and our experience was really fun. I recommend this place if you want to feel adventurous while having fun with your friends.

Ich habe das Qasr Al Hosn besucht, weil mich die Geschichte von Abu Dhabi interessiert hat, und konnte während der Besichtigung der alten Festung einiges dazu lernen. reviews.text:
La visita a Qasr Al Watan, il Palazzo Presidenziale degli Emirati Arabi Uniti ad Abu Dhabi, è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e memorabili del mio viaggio. Questo luogo non è una semplice attrazione turistica, ma un monumento culturale e simbolico che racconta la storia, l’arte, la conoscenza e la visione del Paese. Appena arrivi ti resta impressa la facciata maestosa in granito bianco e pietra, con dettagli lavorati e decorazioni che esprimono lusso e identità araba. La struttura è enorme e ogni sala, corridoio o galleria ha un impatto visivo impressionante, soprattutto la Great Hall con il suo enorme lampadario, che ti lascia davvero senza parole. Entrare qui significa fare un viaggio nella storia e nei valori degli Emirati. Ci sono esposizioni che illustrano l’evoluzione politica e sociale del Paese, oggetti diplomatici, e una biblioteca ricca di testi rari che riflette la profonda attenzione alla conoscenza e alla cultura.
Una delle parti più belle della visita è lo spettacolo di luci e suoni “Palace in Motion” che si tiene in serata: la facciata del palazzo si trasforma in un enorme schermo che racconta, con proiezioni e musica, la storia e le aspirazioni degli Emirati. È un momento suggestivo e molto scenografico. Mi raccomando, pantaloni lunghi o gonne sotto il ginocchio, perché è un luogo istituzionale. Prenota il biglietto in anticipo per evitare code, soprattutto nei periodi di alta stagione. Dedica almeno 1–2 ore se vuoi esplorare bene le sale e vivere anche lo spettacolo serale. Per me Qasr Al Watan non è solo un palazzo, ma un’esperienza culturale e visiva che racconta l’anima degli Emirati, ricca di architettura spettacolare, storia e tradizione. È un must se visiti Abu Dhabi, e la sua maestosità ti rimane impressa molto dopo che te ne sei andato.

Más que un palacio ceremonial, funciona como un centro cultural que promueve el conocimiento sobre la historia, el gobierno y los valores del país. Alberga una importante biblioteca, exposiciones permanentes y eventos culturales que reflejan la herencia y la visión moderna de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos.

reviews.text:
Der Qasr Al-Watan ist ein absoluter Traumpalast, den man bei einem Besuch in Abu Dhabi unbedingt besichtigen sollte.

Eintritt: die Eintrittskarten können ausschließlich online gekauft werden, und an der Kasse muss dann der QR-Code vorgezeigt werden.

Sicherheitskontrolle: obwohl der Palast von sehr vielen Menschen besucht wurde, ging die Sicherheitskontrolle erstaunlicherweise schnell voran, und nach der Sicherheitskontrolle werden alle Besucher mit Bussen zum Haupteingang gefahren.

Benötigte Besuchszeit: planen Sie für die Besichtigung des Qasr Al-Watan, mindestens 1 1/2 - 2 Stunden ein, da es abgesehen von dem Palast selbst, auch interessante Ausstellungsräume zu besichtigen gibt, in denen dem Besucher zum Beispiel Geschenke zu repräsentiert werden, die dem Herrscher von Abu Dhabi wären Staatsbesuchen gemacht wurden. Eine kleine Ausstellung thematisiert auch die Geschichte der Raumfahrt in den vereinigten Arabischen Emiraten, und auch die Besichtigung des Bankett, sowie einer Ausstellung über Kalligraphie, sind sehr sehenswert im Qasr Al-Watan.

Tipp: Abends um 19:15 Uhr gibt es vor dem Palast eine Lichtershow, die sie unbedingt sehen sollten!

Qasr Al Watan is truly impressive, grand, perfectly symmetrical, and surprisingly peaceful. The architecture is exceptionally detailed, with a strong sense of balance and proportion that makes the space feel calm despite its scale.

We visited the banquet halls, library, and Gift Room. The Gift Room was my personal highlight, a fascinating collection of diplomatic gifts from countries around the world, each reflecting cultural exchange and international relations. The gardens are beautifully maintained and offer a quiet contrast to the palace interiors.

Photos speak for itself! Highly recommended if you appreciate design, craftsmanship, and meaningful spaces.

reviews.text:
Qasr Al Watan — это настоящий дворец-шедевр в Абу-Даби, который невозможно забыть. Открытый для публики в 2019 году  и поражает как масштабами, так и утончённой красотой.

С первых минут понимаешь: здесь каждая деталь произведение искусства. Главный зал с куполом диаметром 37 метров и высотой 60 метров парит над тобой, как небесный свод. Стены украшены тончайшими орнаментами в бело-золотой гамме, выполненными вручную, а мрамор, привезённый из лучших уголков мира, сияет в солнечном свете.

Залы дворца - это отдельные миры. Hall of Knowledge хранит редкие книги и манускрипты, Banquet Hall впечатляет столами длиной 120 метров, а Gift Hall демонстрирует изысканные подарки мировых лидеров. Огромные люстры, каждая весом несколько тонн, свисают как каскады звёзд.

Qasr Al Watan - это не просто туристическая достопримечательность, а символ культуры и роскоши ОАЭ. Если вы хотите увидеть восточный люкс в его высшем проявлении, прикоснуться к величию архитектуры и почувствовать себя частью чего-то грандиозного -это место обязательно для посещения

reviews.text: An enormous presidential palace, absolutely stuffed with lots of swishiness!  The scale and opulence of this palace is unbelievable, especially as it is only used for meetings and no one lives there!  You need to catch the free shuttle bus to get to the palace, and also have your bags scanned/checked.  No big deal all this is done very efficiently and quickly, bus ride is only a few minutes.  Once inside you will see how huge and cavernous the palace is,  there are a few restricted areas and some rooms you can only look through the door.  Speaking of doors, the main doors are massive and apparently weigh something like 50 tons!  Some rooms have small exhibitions of artifacts, costumes etc.  The library is huge as you would expect, although the shelves are not completely full!  There are some pleasant garden areas and a water fountain, accessible to tourists too.  1-2 hours should be enough time for your visit.

(2025.11.) 입장권을 현장에서 구매하면 75디르함으로 인터넷 구매보다 비쌉니다. 저는 마이**트립으로 구매했는데 1만 7천원 정도였습니다. 사전 구매하면 QR코드가 있는 pdf 파일을 받게 되는데 입장 시 방문객센터 오른쪽의 Ticket Counter가 아닌 왼쪽 문으로 바로 들어가면 됩니다.
아부다비 왕가의 장엄함을 그대로 보여 주는 건물입니다. 아랍의 전통미를 반영한 하얀색과 금색의 조화가 매우 뛰어납니다. 셰이크 자이드 그랜드 모스크와 유사한 분위기이면서도 국가 의전에 쓰이는 건물다운 면모도 보입니다.
건물 자체도 뛰어나지만 국가 정상 간에 주고 받은 선물이라든지 아랍 문자에 관한 전시 등 다른 볼거리도 많습니다. 우리나라에서 선물한 도자기, 자개, 단도 등이 다른 나라의 선물들과 함께 전시되어 있어 흥미로웠습니다.

reviews.text:
Visiting Qasr Al Watan was an unforgettable experience from start to finish. Everything was organized beautifully, beginning with the ease of online booking—the process was smooth, quick, and straightforward, which made planning the visit completely hassle-free.

Upon arrival, the experience only got better. The shuttle bus that takes you to the palace entrance was comfortable and well-managed, setting the tone for the high level of hospitality you feel throughout the visit.

Stepping inside the palace is like entering another world. The architecture, details, and craftsmanship are absolutely breathtaking. Every hall tells a story, and every corner reflects the rich heritage and vision of the UAE.

Walking through the different halls was truly mesmerizing—each space more impressive than the one before. But the highlight of the visit for me was the Presidential Gifts Hall. Seeing the collection of gifts presented to the UAE from leaders around the world was fascinating. Every piece carries deep meaning and represents a moment of diplomacy, friendship, and respect between nations.

Overall, Qasr Al Watan offers a perfect combination of culture, history, and beauty. If you're visiting Abu Dhabi or even living in the UAE, this is a must-see landmark. The entire experience was seamless, enriching, and simply amazing.
Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
Het presidentieel paleis

Qasr Al Watan is zonder twijfel één van de meest indrukwekkende bezienswaardigheden van Abu Dhabi. Ga zeker met zonsondergang: vooral buiten is het fenomenaal mooi. In het warme licht van de ondergaande zon voelt het alsof je in een scène uit Aladdin terechtkomt.

Binnen is het “groot, groter, grootst”. De zalen zijn stijlvol ingericht in wit, geel en lichtblauw, zo groots en verfijnd dat je het amper kunt bevatten.

Blijf vooral tot na zonsondergang om de Palace in Motion lichtshow mee te pikken. Die is absoluut de moeite waard. Check wel vooraf de tijden online, want die veranderen per maand. Onze originele reservatie werd enkele dagen op voorhand geannuleerd door een ceremonieel bezoek, maar we konden gelukkig nog verplaatsen.

Een majestueuze ervaring die je niet snel vergeet.
reviews.author: Patrick Rottiers

reviews.text:
One of the most magnificent palaces i’ve been to and one of the highlights of the city.

Qasr Al Watan is a working presidential palace, not a royal residence, but a venue for important state functions. It hosts diplomatic meetings, Council of Ministers sessions, and other high-level governmental events.

Built between 2010 and 2017, the exterior is made from white granite and limestone, giving it a majestic appearance. The central dome (in the Great Hall) is especially impressive: about 37 m in diameter and reaching 60 m in height.

The palace uses three main colours: blue, white, and yellow, symbolically representing the Arabian Gulf, purity, and desert sands.

The main hall is by far the main highlight of the palace, it’s very gigantic and spacious, richly decorated and simply breathtaking.

There are multiple exhibitions within the palace, from gifts from world leaders, to historical manuscripts and a 50,000 books library. There’s also a cafe inside.

It’s most definitely not a place you wanna miss if you’re in Abu Dhabi.

reviews.text:
La visita a Qasr Al Watan, il Palazzo Presidenziale degli Emirati Arabi Uniti ad Abu Dhabi, è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e memorabili del mio viaggio. Questo luogo non è una semplice attrazione turistica, ma un monumento culturale e simbolico che racconta la storia, l’arte, la conoscenza e la visione del Paese. Appena arrivi ti resta impressa la facciata maestosa in granito bianco e pietra, con dettagli lavorati e decorazioni che esprimono lusso e identità araba. La struttura è enorme e ogni sala, corridoio o galleria ha un impatto visivo impressionante, soprattutto la Great Hall con il suo enorme lampadario, che ti lascia davvero senza parole. Entrare qui significa fare un viaggio nella storia e nei valori degli Emirati. Ci sono esposizioni che illustrano l’evoluzione politica e sociale del Paese, oggetti diplomatici, e una biblioteca ricca di testi rari che riflette la profonda attenzione alla conoscenza e alla cultura.
Una delle parti più belle della visita è lo spettacolo di luci e suoni “Palace in Motion” che si tiene in serata: la facciata del palazzo si trasforma in un enorme schermo che racconta, con proiezioni e musica, la storia e le aspirazioni degli Emirati. È un momento suggestivo e molto scenografico. Mi raccomando, pantaloni lunghi o gonne sotto il ginocchio, perché è un luogo istituzionale. Prenota il biglietto in anticipo per evitare code, soprattutto nei periodi di alta stagione. Dedica almeno 1–2 ore se vuoi esplorare bene le sale e vivere anche lo spettacolo serale. Per me Qasr Al Watan non è solo un palazzo, ma un’esperienza culturale e visiva che racconta l’anima degli Emirati, ricca di architettura spettacolare, storia e tradizione. È un must se visiti Abu Dhabi, e la sua maestosità ti rimane impressa molto dopo che te ne sei andato.

visiting Qasr Al Watan in abu dhabi is simply unbelievable. this place is a must-visit for anyone, truly breathtaking.

the amount of intricate work is insane — the walls and ceilings are covered in mosaics made from semi-precious stones, all crafted with incredible detail. every pattern, every design is perfectly executed, and the beauty is overwhelming. it’s not just decoration, it’s art on a monumental scale.

the patterns and mosaics create an atmosphere that leaves you speechless. everywhere you look, it’s just wow, wow, wow. the craftsmanship, the attention to detail, the grandeur — everything is just… unreal.

overall, Qasr Al Watan is a place that truly stuns and inspires. absolutely must see, and you will be amazed by every corner.
reviews.author: Diana B

reviews.text: Qasr Al Watan es el Palacio Presidencial de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, ubicado en Abu Dabi. Abierto al público en 2019, destaca por su imponente arquitectura árabe, elaborados detalles en mármol y amplias cúpulas. Más que un palacio ceremonial, funciona como un centro cultural que promueve el conocimiento sobre la historia, el gobierno y los valores del país. Alberga una importante biblioteca, exposiciones permanentes y eventos culturales que reflejan la herencia y la visión moderna de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos.

reviews.text:
Der Qasr Al-Watan ist ein absoluter Traumpalast, den man bei einem Besuch in Abu Dhabi unbedingt besichtigen sollte.

Eintritt: die Eintrittskarten können ausschließlich online gekauft werden, und an der Kasse muss dann der QR-Code vorgezeigt werden.

Sicherheitskontrolle: obwohl der Palast von sehr vielen Menschen besucht wurde, ging die Sicherheitskontrolle erstaunlicherweise schnell voran, und nach der Sicherheitskontrolle werden alle Besucher mit Bussen zum Haupteingang gefahren.

Benötigte Besuchszeit: planen Sie für die Besichtigung des Qasr Al-Watan, mindestens 1 1/2 - 2 Stunden ein, da es abgesehen von dem Palast selbst, auch interessante Ausstellungsräume zu besichtigen gibt, in denen dem Besucher zum Beispiel Geschenke zu repräsentiert werden, die dem Herrscher von Abu Dhabi wären Staatsbesuchen gemacht wurden. Eine kleine Ausstellung thematisiert auch die Geschichte der Raumfahrt in den vereinigten Arabischen Emiraten, und auch die Besichtigung des Bankett, sowie einer Ausstellung über Kalligraphie, sind sehr sehenswert im Qasr Al-Watan.

Qasr Al Watan is an absolute masterpiece! The palace is not only architecturally stunning but also rich in history and culture. Walking through its grand halls, beautifully landscaped gardens, and intricate interiors feels like stepping into a world of elegance and heritage.
The exhibits are informative and give a deep insight into the UAE’s history, governance, and traditions. The staff are friendly and the visitor experience is seamless. Every corner is incredibly photogenic, making it perfect for photography enthusiasts as well.
A must-visit for anyone in Abu Dhabi who wants to experience the grandeur and culture of the UAE. Allocate a few hours to truly appreciate everything this palace has to offer!

reviews.text:
Qasr Al Watan is truly impressive, grand, perfectly symmetrical, and surprisingly peaceful. The architecture is exceptionally detailed, with a strong sense of balance and proportion that makes the space feel calm despite its scale.

We visited the banquet halls, library, and Gift Room. The Gift Room was my personal highlight, a fascinating collection of diplomatic gifts from countries around the world, each reflecting cultural exchange and international relations. The gardens are beautifully maintained and offer a quiet contrast to the palace interiors.

Photos speak for itself! Highly recommended if you appreciate design, craftsmanship, and meaningful spaces.

reviews.text:
Qasr Al Watan — это настоящий дворец-шедевр в Абу-Даби, который невозможно забыть. Открытый для публики в 2019 году  и поражает как масштабами, так и утончённой красотой.

С первых минут понимаешь: здесь каждая деталь произведение искусства. Главный зал с куполом диаметром 37 метров и высотой 60 метров парит над тобой, как небесный свод. Стены украшены тончайшими орнаментами в бело-золотой гамме, выполненными вручную, а мрамор, привезённый из лучших уголков мира, сияет в солнечном свете.

Залы дворца - это отдельные миры. Hall of Knowledge хранит редкие книги и манускрипты, Banquet Hall впечатляет столами длиной 120 метров, а Gift Hall демонстрирует изысканные подарки мировых лидеров. Огромные люстры, каждая весом несколько тонн, свисают как каскады звёзд.

Qasr Al Watan - это не просто туристическая достопримечательность, а символ культуры и роскоши ОАЭ. Если вы хотите увидеть восточный люкс в его высшем проявлении, прикоснуться к величию архитектуры и почувствовать себя частью чего-то грандиозного -это место обязательно для посещения

Visitors can explore its opulent halls, majestic rooms, and beautiful gardens, all while learning about the country's governance and traditions. Qasr Al Watan is a must-visit for anyone interested in experiencing the UAE's blend of modernity and tradition.

reviews.text: An enormous presidential palace, absolutely stuffed with lots of swishiness!  The scale and opulence of this palace is unbelievable, especially as it is only used for meetings and no one lives there!  You need to catch the free shuttle bus to get to the palace, and also have your bags scanned/checked.  No big deal all this is done very efficiently and quickly, bus ride is only a few minutes.  Once inside you will see how huge and cavernous the palace is,  there are a few restricted areas and some rooms you can only look through the door.  Speaking of doors, the main doors are massive and apparently weigh something like 50 tons!  Some rooms have small exhibitions of artifacts, costumes etc.  The library is huge as you would expect, although the shelves are not completely full!  There are some pleasant garden areas and a water fountain, accessible to tourists too.  1-2 hours should be enough time for your visit.

reviews.text:
Visiting Qasr Al Watan was an unforgettable experience from start to finish. Everything was organized beautifully, beginning with the ease of online booking—the process was smooth, quick, and straightforward, which made planning the visit completely hassle-free.

Upon arrival, the experience only got better. The shuttle bus that takes you to the palace entrance was comfortable and well-managed, setting the tone for the high level of hospitality you feel throughout the visit.

Stepping inside the palace is like entering another world. The architecture, details, and craftsmanship are absolutely breathtaking. Every hall tells a story, and every corner reflects the rich heritage and vision of the UAE.

Walking through the different halls was truly mesmerizing—each space more impressive than the one before. But the highlight of the visit for me was the Presidential Gifts Hall. Seeing the collection of gifts presented to the UAE from leaders around the world was fascinating. Every piece carries deep meaning and represents a moment of diplomacy, friendship, and respect between nations.

Overall, Qasr Al Watan offers a perfect combination of culture, history, and beauty. If you're visiting Abu Dhabi or even living in the UAE, this is a must-see landmark. The entire experience was seamless, enriching, and simply amazing.
Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
One of the most magnificent palaces i’ve been to and one of the highlights of the city.

Qasr Al Watan is a working presidential palace, not a royal residence, but a venue for important state functions. It hosts diplomatic meetings, Council of Ministers sessions, and other high-level governmental events.

Built between 2010 and 2017, the exterior is made from white granite and limestone, giving it a majestic appearance. The central dome (in the Great Hall) is especially impressive: about 37 m in diameter and reaching 60 m in height.

The palace uses three main colours: blue, white, and yellow, symbolically representing the Arabian Gulf, purity, and desert sands.

The main hall is by far the main highlight of the palace, it’s very gigantic and spacious, richly decorated and simply breathtaking.

There are multiple exhibitions within the palace, from gifts from world leaders, to historical manuscripts and a 50,000 books library. There’s also a cafe inside.

It’s most definitely not a place you wanna miss if you’re in Abu Dhabi.

reviews.text:
La visita a Qasr Al Watan, il Palazzo Presidenziale degli Emirati Arabi Uniti ad Abu Dhabi, è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e memorabili del mio viaggio. Questo luogo non è una semplice attrazione turistica, ma un monumento culturale e simbolico che racconta la storia, l’arte, la conoscenza e la visione del Paese. Appena arrivi ti resta impressa la facciata maestosa in granito bianco e pietra, con dettagli lavorati e decorazioni che esprimono lusso e identità araba. La struttura è enorme e ogni sala, corridoio o galleria ha un impatto visivo impressionante, soprattutto la Great Hall con il suo enorme lampadario, che ti lascia davvero senza parole. Entrare qui significa fare un viaggio nella storia e nei valori degli Emirati. Ci sono esposizioni che illustrano l’evoluzione politica e sociale del Paese, oggetti diplomatici, e una biblioteca ricca di testi rari che riflette la profonda attenzione alla conoscenza e alla cultura.
Una delle parti più belle della visita è lo spettacolo di luci e suoni “Palace in Motion” che si tiene in serata: la facciata del palazzo si trasforma in un enorme schermo che racconta, con proiezioni e musica, la storia e le aspirazioni degli Emirati. È un momento suggestivo e molto scenografico. Mi raccomando, pantaloni lunghi o gonne sotto il ginocchio, perché è un luogo istituzionale. Prenota il biglietto in anticipo per evitare code, soprattutto nei periodi di alta stagione. Dedica almeno 1–2 ore se vuoi esplorare bene le sale e vivere anche lo spettacolo serale. Per me Qasr Al Watan non è solo un palazzo, ma un’esperienza culturale e visiva che racconta l’anima degli Emirati, ricca di architettura spettacolare, storia e tradizione. È un must se visiti Abu Dhabi, e la sua maestosità ti rimane impressa molto dopo che te ne sei andato.

reviews.text:
La visita a Qasr Al Watan, il Palazzo Presidenziale degli Emirati Arabi Uniti ad Abu Dhabi, è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e memorabili del mio viaggio. Questo luogo non è una semplice attrazione turistica, ma un monumento culturale e simbolico che racconta la storia, l’arte, la conoscenza e la visione del Paese. Appena arrivi ti resta impressa la facciata maestosa in granito bianco e pietra, con dettagli lavorati e decorazioni che esprimono lusso e identità araba. La struttura è enorme e ogni sala, corridoio o galleria ha un impatto visivo impressionante, soprattutto la Great Hall con il suo enorme lampadario, che ti lascia davvero senza parole. Entrare qui significa fare un viaggio nella storia e nei valori degli Emirati. Ci sono esposizioni che illustrano l’evoluzione politica e sociale del Paese, oggetti diplomatici, e una biblioteca ricca di testi rari che riflette la profonda attenzione alla conoscenza e alla cultura.
Una delle parti più belle della visita è lo spettacolo di luci e suoni “Palace in Motion” che si tiene in serata: la facciata del palazzo si trasforma in un enorme schermo che racconta, con proiezioni e musica, la storia e le aspirazioni degli Emirati. È un momento suggestivo e molto scenografico. Mi raccomando, pantaloni lunghi o gonne sotto il ginocchio, perché è un luogo istituzionale. Prenota il biglietto in anticipo per evitare code, soprattutto nei periodi di alta stagione. Dedica almeno 1–2 ore se vuoi esplorare bene le sale e vivere anche lo spettacolo serale. Per me Qasr Al Watan non è solo un palazzo, ma un’esperienza culturale e visiva che racconta l’anima degli Emirati, ricca di architettura spettacolare, storia e tradizione. È un must se visiti Abu Dhabi, e la sua maestosità ti rimane impressa molto dopo che te ne sei andato.

Der Qasr Al-Watan ist ein absoluter Traumpalast, den man bei einem Besuch in Abu Dhabi unbedingt besichtigen sollte.

Eintritt: die Eintrittskarten können ausschließlich online gekauft werden, und an der Kasse muss dann der QR-Code vorgezeigt werden.

Sicherheitskontrolle: obwohl der Palast von sehr vielen Menschen besucht wurde, ging die Sicherheitskontrolle erstaunlicherweise schnell voran, und nach der Sicherheitskontrolle werden alle Besucher mit Bussen zum Haupteingang gefahren.

Benötigte Besuchszeit: planen Sie für die Besichtigung des Qasr Al-Watan, mindestens 1 1/2 - 2 Stunden ein, da es abgesehen von dem Palast selbst, auch interessante Ausstellungsräume zu besichtigen gibt, in denen dem Besucher zum Beispiel Geschenke zu repräsentiert werden, die dem Herrscher von Abu Dhabi wären Staatsbesuchen gemacht wurden. Eine kleine Ausstellung thematisiert auch die Geschichte der Raumfahrt in den vereinigten Arabischen Emiraten, und auch die Besichtigung des Bankett, sowie einer Ausstellung über Kalligraphie, sind sehr sehenswert im Qasr Al-Watan.

Tipp: Abends um 19:15 Uhr gibt es vor dem Palast eine Lichtershow, die sie unbedingt sehen sollten!

Qasr Al Watan — это настоящий дворец-шедевр в Абу-Даби, который невозможно забыть. Открытый для публики в 2019 году  и поражает как масштабами, так и утончённой красотой.

С первых минут понимаешь: здесь каждая деталь произведение искусства. Главный зал с куполом диаметром 37 метров и высотой 60 метров парит над тобой, как небесный свод. Стены украшены тончайшими орнаментами в бело-золотой гамме, выполненными вручную, а мрамор, привезённый из лучших уголков мира, сияет в солнечном свете.

Залы дворца - это отдельные миры. Hall of Knowledge хранит редкие книги и манускрипты, Banquet Hall впечатляет столами длиной 120 метров, а Gift Hall демонстрирует изысканные подарки мировых лидеров. Огромные люстры, каждая весом несколько тонн, свисают как каскады звёзд.

Qasr Al Watan - это не просто туристическая достопримечательность, а символ культуры и роскоши ОАЭ. Если вы хотите увидеть восточный люкс в его высшем проявлении, прикоснуться к величию архитектуры и почувствовать себя частью чего-то грандиозного -это место обязательно для посещения

reviews.text: An enormous presidential palace, absolutely stuffed with lots of swishiness!  The scale and opulence of this palace is unbelievable, especially as it is only used for meetings and no one lives there!  You need to catch the free shuttle bus to get to the palace, and also have your bags scanned/checked.  No big deal all this is done very efficiently and quickly, bus ride is only a few minutes.  Once inside you will see how huge and cavernous the palace is,  there are a few restricted areas and some rooms you can only look through the door.  Speaking of doors, the main doors are massive and apparently weigh something like 50 tons!  Some rooms have small exhibitions of artifacts, costumes etc.  The library is huge as you would expect, although the shelves are not completely full!  There are some pleasant garden areas and a water fountain, accessible to tourists too.  1-2 hours should be enough time for your visit.

Visiting Qasr Al Watan was an unforgettable experience from start to finish. Everything was organized beautifully, beginning with the ease of online booking—the process was smooth, quick, and straightforward, which made planning the visit completely hassle-free.

Upon arrival, the experience only got better. The shuttle bus that takes you to the palace entrance was comfortable and well-managed, setting the tone for the high level of hospitality you feel throughout the visit.

Stepping inside the palace is like entering another world. The architecture, details, and craftsmanship are absolutely breathtaking. Every hall tells a story, and every corner reflects the rich heritage and vision of the UAE.

Walking through the different halls was truly mesmerizing—each space more impressive than the one before. But the highlight of the visit for me was the Presidential Gifts Hall. Seeing the collection of gifts presented to the UAE from leaders around the world was fascinating. Every piece carries deep meaning and represents a moment of diplomacy, friendship, and respect between nations.

Overall, Qasr Al Watan offers a perfect combination of culture, history, and beauty. If you're visiting Abu Dhabi or even living in the UAE, this is a must-see landmark. The entire experience was seamless, enriching, and simply amazing.
Highly recommended!

Qasr Al Watan is zonder twijfel één van de meest indrukwekkende bezienswaardigheden van Abu Dhabi. Ga zeker met zonsondergang: vooral buiten is het fenomenaal mooi. In het warme licht van de ondergaande zon voelt het alsof je in een scène uit Aladdin terechtkomt.

reviews.text:
One of the most magnificent palaces i’ve been to and one of the highlights of the city.

Qasr Al Watan is a working presidential palace, not a royal residence, but a venue for important state functions. It hosts diplomatic meetings, Council of Ministers sessions, and other high-level governmental events.

Built between 2010 and 2017, the exterior is made from white granite and limestone, giving it a majestic appearance. The central dome (in the Great Hall) is especially impressive: about 37 m in diameter and reaching 60 m in height.

The palace uses three main colours: blue, white, and yellow, symbolically representing the Arabian Gulf, purity, and desert sands.

The main hall is by far the main highlight of the palace, it’s very gigantic and spacious, richly decorated and simply breathtaking.

There are multiple exhibitions within the palace, from gifts from world leaders, to historical manuscripts and a 50,000 books library. There’s also a cafe inside.

It’s most definitely not a place you wanna miss if you’re in Abu Dhabi.

reviews.text:
La visita a Qasr Al Watan, il Palazzo Presidenziale degli Emirati Arabi Uniti ad Abu Dhabi, è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e memorabili del mio viaggio. Questo luogo non è una semplice attrazione turistica, ma un monumento culturale e simbolico che racconta la storia, l’arte, la conoscenza e la visione del Paese. Appena arrivi ti resta impressa la facciata maestosa in granito bianco e pietra, con dettagli lavorati e decorazioni che esprimono lusso e identità araba. La struttura è enorme e ogni sala, corridoio o galleria ha un impatto visivo impressionante, soprattutto la Great Hall con il suo enorme lampadario, che ti lascia davvero senza parole. Entrare qui significa fare un viaggio nella storia e nei valori degli Emirati. Ci sono esposizioni che illustrano l’evoluzione politica e sociale del Paese, oggetti diplomatici, e una biblioteca ricca di testi rari che riflette la profonda attenzione alla conoscenza e alla cultura.
Una delle parti più belle della visita è lo spettacolo di luci e suoni “Palace in Motion” che si tiene in serata: la facciata del palazzo si trasforma in un enorme schermo che racconta, con proiezioni e musica, la storia e le aspirazioni degli Emirati. È un momento suggestivo e molto scenografico. Mi raccomando, pantaloni lunghi o gonne sotto il ginocchio, perché è un luogo istituzionale. Prenota il biglietto in anticipo per evitare code, soprattutto nei periodi di alta stagione. Dedica almeno 1–2 ore se vuoi esplorare bene le sale e vivere anche lo spettacolo serale. Per me Qasr Al Watan non è solo un palazzo, ma un’esperienza culturale e visiva che racconta l’anima degli Emirati, ricca di architettura spettacolare, storia e tradizione. È un must se visiti Abu Dhabi, e la sua maestosità ti rimane impressa molto dopo che te ne sei andato.

Special thanks to Derek for his superb service and warm assistance throughout the night, and to Daniel for kindly accommodating a last-minute change in our booking slot. Their professionalism and attentiveness truly made the evening memorable.

We ordered the mixed grill meat, and the steak was cooked perfectly — just the way we liked it. The only part I wasn’t quite happy with was the peppercorn sauce, which leaned a bit on the sweet side for my taste.

While the price is on the higher side, it feels reasonable given the quality of food, the romantic ambiance, and the beautiful view that comes with the experience. Overall, Rays Grill gave us a celebration worth remembering, and we would definitely recommend it for special occasions.

From the moment we walked into Ray’s Grill, we knew we were in for something special. The ambiance was warm and inviting, and the menu was full of tempting options, each dish showcasing fresh ingredients and creative flavors.

But what truly set our experience apart was the service. Alam, our server, was nothing short of amazing. Attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely lovely, he made us feel like VIPs from start to finish. His recommendations were spot-on, and his passion for both the food and the guests was evident in every interaction.

The food was beautifully presented and absolutely delicious. Each bite was perfectly seasoned and cooked to perfection, and it was clear the kitchen took great pride in their craft. We left Ray’s Grill feeling more than satisfied – it was a memorable experience we’ll be talking about for a long time.

If you’re looking for a place with outstanding food and the warmest service (be sure to ask for Alam!), Ray’s Grill is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: My boyfriend and I went to Ray’s Grill to celebrate something special, but unfortunately, the food ruined our night. We ordered a ribeye, which turned out to be extremely rubbery and lacked any sear. It felt like I had swallowed half of it, with the other half still in my mouth. When I mentioned this to the waitress and demonstrated how difficult it was to cut the steak, she attributed it to our order of 500 grams, even though it appeared to be closer to 300 grams or less. Additionally, the lobster we ordered, which cost 200 AED, was the saddest lobster I've ever tried, with almost no meat. If it weren't for the lava cake and the pleasant view and atmosphere, I would rate this experience a zero. Paying AED 800 felt like a total waste, despite the 20% discount they gave us. Never again!

reviews.text: This shopping mall is a popular destination for both locals and tourists, offering a wide variety of shops, from international brands to local boutiques. Visitors can enjoy a range of dining options, including restaurants, cafes, and fast-food outlets, as well as entertainment facilities such as cinemas and play areas for children. The mall provides a comfortable and modern environment for shopping, relaxing, and spending time with family and friends. It is conveniently located and often hosts seasonal events and promotions, making it an attractive place for a full day of leisure and shopping.
reviews.author: Moza Ahli

reviews.text:
I recently visited Reem Mall in Abu Dhabi and was thoroughly impressed! This modern mall is a must-visit destination for shopping, dining, and entertainment. With over 400 international and local brands, including Carrefour, EMax, Samsung, and Toy Station, you'll find everything you need under one roof.

The mall's design is stunning, with a spacious and well-organized layout that's easy to navigate. The atmosphere is calm and welcoming, making it perfect for families and relaxation. Don't miss Snow Abu Dhabi, the indoor snow park that's perfect for kids and adults alike!

The food court offers a diverse range of cuisines, and the Vox Cinemas is a great spot for movie enthusiasts. Plus, with ample parking and friendly security staff, you'll feel right at home.

Whether you're looking for a fun day out with family, a relaxing shopping experience, or a unique entertainment spot, Reem Mall is the perfect choice. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
Great stay and the hotel is absolutely beautiful but there were a few things I think could be improved. The main buffet restaurant is closed between 4pm and 7pm which is peak time for feeding young children. The other available options in that time don't really work when you have fussy children. The kids food in the restaurant could also be improved. Chips and chicken nuggets everyday is fine if you have children that like chips and chicken nuggets but it would be good to have other child friendly options like fish fingers, plain pasta, peas.
The turndown service is also very late for families. We had a knock on our door at 9.30pm but with young children that is far too late.
Everything else at the hotel was brilliant and we had a really great week.
reviews.author: Emily Nicholson

reviews.text:
We as a family had recently the pleasure of staying at Rixos Saadiyat, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. From the moment I arrived, the staff greeted me with warmth and exceptional hospitality, except one person who was arrogant and not welcoming. The rooms are elegantly designed, offering nice views and excellent ambiance.

The amenities are top-notch, with a stunning pool and direct beach access that made relaxation effortless. The dining options are diverse, featuring delicious cuisine from around the world, and the superb service.

Overall, Rixos Saadiyat exceeded my expectations in every way. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for.
I wish to say extra thank you to the amazing people who helped us during this stay Latifa and Sofia at client service, Valeria at reception, Ali by the pool, Dishika and
Jim Kelly  at turquoise restaurant, Yin and Mina Shrestha.
Also we really enjoyed Mermaid restaurant extra thank ms to Dennis, and all others welcoming staff and oriental.
Thank you so much for the excellent experience

A special shout-out to Nathalia Reyes, who truly elevated our vacation. She was incredibly helpful, kind, and attentive to every small detail. Her exceptional service turned a great holiday into a perfect one.

If you’re looking for luxury paired with amazing service, this is the place to be. Highly recommended!

Im writing this review after just leaving the rixos after spending 5 days with family there. It is a lovely hotel with staff that work extremely hard to give you the best service. Throughout, the waiter staff in both the buffet and the bar staff around the pool area do their best to keep you topped up with drinks.
The buffet is a good level for an all inclusive for both breakfast and dinner. Where I would like to mention this hotel excells is the a la carte restaurants. The Chinese and the Italian were really of a very high standard. And also the house wines on offer extremely nice as well as a great beer bottle Selection.
Sadly the steak restaurant and greek was a bit of a let down and not of the same standard food wise as the other two.. The steak a really strange smell and taste.. The Greek was ok but is mainly fish so if your not keen on fish then try the Italian instead
I also couldn't  find where there was any ice cream stations other than the kids club which I find strange and not to the level of other all inclusives I have been where they are dotted every where. Overall it was a lovely stay and I would come Again for some winter sun. Thank you Rixos staff.

reviews.text:
This was our 2nd visit to Rixos Saadiyat, first was November 2024. We really enjoyed our first stay so much that we came back.  Was really nice that some of the staff recognised us and the service was excellent from all throughout our stay.

Some nice upgrades to the loungers at the pool and the cooler boxes are a great idea.

Nice addition to the DJ set up at the beach bar with the mirrored setting.  The vibe created at the beach bar is amazing getting really chilled for sunset; however the music set could be changed daily as it gets repetitive,  sounds more like a preset playlist rather than a proper DJ set.

Evening entertainment is in a great setting in the outdoor area,  well organised and the vibe is very chilled,  however the bands playing this year were all virtually identical with all playing the same songs,  it began to get repetitive.

Buffet provided ample choice and had something for everyone.

We dined at Aja, Orient, Mermaid and L'Olivio and all were excellent,  food was delicious and really good choice on the menus. Staff service at all was first class.

Highlights pool bar was excellent, thanks to all the guys who knew exactly what we were drinking and kept us topped up all day, special mention to KB for introducing us to a particular rum cocktail.

Bar lounge was excellent with a great selection of drinks and great staff constantly on the go ensuring we were taken care of.

Overall great stay,  we highly recommend 👌
reviews.author: mark james

reviews.text:
Очень приятный отель. Прекрасный, доброжелательный и крайне внимательный персонал. На территории и в номерах очень чисто. Чудесное постельное белье. Еда выше всяких похвал, на любой вкус .
Мы просили за месяц до прибывания, чтобы нам сделали номера рядом и на первом этаже , за меся это вполне возможно организовать. Однако, оказалось, что эта информация не дошла до отеля и ресепшен. Но сотрудники нам помогли и сделали номер на первом этаже, рядом не получилось, мои друзья жили выше….
Это было немного странно, что информацию никто не передал и выглядело , просто как игнорирование просьбы , за фразой «мы сделаем всё, что возможно» .  Но сотрудники ресепшен Любовь, всё исправила.
То что люди , которые выезжают из отеля позже 12 дня , не могут пойти на обед, выглядит, как то странно, про том количестве еды , что остается .
Нас это тоже не коснулось. Но для других, я полагаю это важно и может испортить впечатление об отдыхе.
Мы вернемся на следующий год ещё большей компанией .
Спасибо.

reviews.text:
Working for a premium airline, I stay in many 4 to 5-Star hotels around the world – but Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island is in a class of its own. From the first moment, everything feels elevated: the beautifully designed rooms, the sparkling wine and sweet treats waiting on arrival, and the quiet, perfectly maintained surroundings.
What makes this place truly exceptional is the service. The staff are incredibly attentive, warm, and professional – it feels like they anticipate your every wish. The word “no” simply doesn’t exist here. Whether at the pool, the beach, or one of the many restaurants, you’re constantly and discreetly looked after.
The food and drinks are of outstanding quality, with an impressive variety and freshness that reflect true 5-star standards. The atmosphere is calm, elegant, and relaxed – ideal for guests who value peace, luxury, and excellent service.
At Rixos Saadiyat, I didn’t just feel like a guest – I felt like royalty.

reviews.text: Дорогая команда отеля, |хочется выразить вам огромную благодарность за ваше гостеприимство и сервис высочайшего уровня!||Отдыхали с супругом 2-ой раз за этот год: весной и в ноябре. К моему большому удивлению, за 6 месяцев качество сервиса достигло апогея и превзошло все наши ожидания от повторного отдыха. Что добавилось к и так уже превосходному сервису:||- при заселении сделали комплимент в виде напитка по мотивам свежевыжатого гранатового сока с осибори. Очень приятно!|- в номер принесли пляжную сумку - очень удобно. По весне этого не было;|- персонал, который разносит алкоголь на пляже - если весной их приходилось или отлавливать, или чаще самому идти к бару, чтобы не ждать долго - сейчас постоянно курсирует между лежаками и спрашивает «не принести ли чего»;|- на пляже подходил персонал с боксом - предлагают протереть солнцезащитные очки (это когда уже совсем обленился =) но забавно!);|- стенд с авторскими коктейлями под диджейский сет на закате;|- на шведском столе очень много персонала - не приходится ни ждать, ни отлавливать. Только вино в бокале начинает заканчиваться, официант уже спешит его наполнить :) Приносили несколько раз осибори - тоже классная задумка, как будто ты и не на шведском;|- еда: разнообразие фруктов - добавили клубнику. Уголок с морепродуктами/суши/свеж рыбой на швед столе на ежедневной основе на ужин - по весне не каждый вечер это было)||Теперь впечатления без сравнений с предыдущим визитом.||Спортивная программа - восторг! Мне очень полюбились сапы с утра!|Качество продуктов/еды - все на высшем уровне! Подача в а-ля карт ресторанах - отдельный вид искусства . Живая музыка у бара, за ужином - просто отдыхаешь душой и телом.||Официант Тристан - отдельная любовь. Видно сразу - человек обожает свою работу! Лучший просто официант! Очень радушный, доброжелательный, и все очень искренне! ||Спасибо, что трудитесь как пчелки! Учитывая кол-во отдыхающих, наших просьб - всегда внимательны, легки, доброжелательны и улыбчивы! |Хочется возвращаться снова и снова!|Лучший отель на Саадияте!

reviews.text: This was our third stay at a Rixos resort (previously stayed in Belek and Dubai) and once again the service, cleanliness and overall experience was excellent!||However this resort would be 3rd on our top 3 Rixos resorts… the à la carte restaurants were not as impressive, the Orient was the stand out, the Asian underwhelming which was a shame as Asian restaurants at Rixos resorts have typically been the most memorable.||Entertainment was a bit tame for us.. having experienced the entertainment at Rixos Belek.||Our biggest gripe would be as two adults travelling without children we couldn’t enjoy any child free areas… the hotel has a few adult only areas but none of them are policed by staff or fully respected by holiday makers.||Similarly people leaving towels on lounges most of the day unattended around the pool and beach created a shortage of lounges which staff seemed unwilling to manage (although blame is squarely on customers, it took us no time to simply return our towels after we were finished)||The above is not helped by just having one main pool!||The birds around the pool area are a problem, we saw them going into people’s beach bags and flying off with stuff.||So with those with families this would be a good hotel but for adults traveling without children this may be a little frustrating.

reviews.text: This hotel is a dream come true! The infrastructure is dreamy, very well designed. The gardens, the pools are kept very clean and the care of the facility is great! Every staff, from the receptionists, waiting staff, pool managers, the cleaning staff, everyone not only very attentive but so kind and greets with a hearty smile. And if you are thinking of spending your baby moon here or the first vacation with your baby (doesn’t matter if 1 month or older): it is the perfect place to spend your holiday! Not only is it baby friendly, we were provided with much care and support from everyone. We were provided with a baby bottle sterilizer, a cod (but you can cosleep since there is no gap in the bed and the beds are big enough), they even have strollers to lend out. If you have bigger kids there is a babysitting service (if I’m not mistaken from 1 year old onwards) and a kids club with a baby/ kids pool. We also recommend getting massages (special thanks to Oxana who is a wonderful massage therapist). The spa has won many awards and we agree that it deserves them. The spa is separated for men and women. To add on: everyone here tries wishes to come true, any request you have there will be at least someone trying their best to make it possible. Even if you arrive late at night, try to talk to the front desk about your possibilities, there are many more things (whisky tastings, sports club, etc.). There is a small market to get diapers, things for babies, even baby sunglasses, you could arrive with no luggage and you would find everything here. The food is another level: the selection is massive. Nobody will leave hungry. And it’s very fresh. Special thanks to the very friendly bakers! The next ATM is 5 min away by walking. Thank you Rixos! See you next year! Special thanks to Yasin, Eren, Erdem, Nathalia, Manuela, Ludi, Angelyn, Ianne, and many more people.

reviews.text:
Прожили 10 дней в Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island — как раз в пик сезона, во время Гран-при Формулы-1. Выбор отеля оказался удачным: несмотря на высокую загрузку, всё работало слаженно и без сбоев.

Питание — одно из главных достоинств. Особенно впечатлили морепродукты: !краб!, устрицы, мидии, разные виды рыбы — подавали регулярно и с разной подачей, так что интерес не угасал даже к концу отпуска. Шведский стол действительно богатый — столы буквально «ломятся» от блюд, в том числе и с местными, и с интернациональными акцентами. Десерты - отдельная история, самый Чизкейк на всем белом свете. В мясном ресторане а-ля карт очень приятный официант София)

Пляжная зона — отдельное удовольствие. Песок мелкий, белоснежный, ухоженный — ни ракушек, ни камней. Вход в море очень плавный, вода прозрачная и чистая. На каждом лежаке есть кнопка вызова официанта, персонал очень оперативно приносит коктейль, свежайшие фрукты и снеки.

В целом, Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island — это отель для тех, кто ценит спокойствие, качественное питание и продуманный сервис без излишней театральности. За 10 дней ни разу не захотелось «сбежать» куда-то — всё, что нужно для настоящего отдыха, было под рукой.

Analytical overview:
Bars:
- Main Bar Night Performance: ⭐️

- Pool Bars: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Kitchen:
- Main Kitchen: ⭐️
- Excessive recycling practices.
- Lack of variety.
- Food of low-cost quality.

- Some dishes were served when they were past their optimal consumption period.

reviews.text:
My partner and I stayed for 8 nights in November for the first time. I’ll start with the positives we experienced during our stay.
Firstly the location is perfect, you are equally close to Yas Island or the city and can enjoy exploring both, you’re also very close to the new cultural district which has museums to explore. The beach is stunning along with the sunsets you can view.
Next the service, every staff member there is incredibly kind and helpful, from the pool to each restaurant, they can’t do enough to help.
Finally the common areas are stunning, the decor is extravagant and clearly a lot of thought has been put into it.

Now onto the negatives, if you are not a family this is not the hotel for you. It is a predominantly family friendly hotel with only one main pool.
There is a huge kids pool with slides and a wave pool that was empty during our stay, we were told by staff that this was because alcohol is not served in these areas so the parents prefer the main pool. An easy fix would be to change this rule or something more permanent would be to build an Adults only pool. There were some areas of sun loungers that were adult only but they were not poolside and they also had children there with staff not enforcing the rule.
Onto the food, we were really disappointed in the quality of food at the resort, even in the al a carte restaurants, it was fine but not in standing with the cost of the stay. The drinks on offer were generally really good, except the wine, of which there were only two option of both red and white - both of which weren’t great.
The rooms themselves looked tired, I don’t think there has been any work done to maintain the standard since opening and it showed. Paint peeling and chipped, and general wear and tear on the furniture. We stayed in the fourth floor overlooking the pool in a sea view room, at multiple points during our stay there was a smell of sewage in the hallway. One evening we returned to our room  and the smell was incredibly strong inside, I called reception immediately to report it, they called back after 20 minutes to offer us a new room on the ground floor, but at this point is was 11pm and we were tired. My parents were staying two doors down and had the same issue and the same solution was offered however again not appropriate at the time, after a while the smell started to dissipate so we were able to get to sleep. The following day management followed up with my mum (not me) and offered the same room again, however we had selected the sea view rooms for exactly that so it wasn’t an appropriate compensation, they also offered my parents a discount upon their next stay.
I work in hospitality and this was shocking to me, you should not have to pay extra in order to solve a solution that has happened during this stay. The hotel could have easily offered a complimentary gesture such as resort credit and it would have been a welcomed, particularly given the cost of the stay.
Upon checkout nothing was mentioned to me at all, no apology or acknowledgment of the issue, so I asked to speak with a Manager. I explained the problem and advised how I was really disappointed with the communication and management of the whole issue, she had no idea about it and also no idea who had been communicating with my parents, but reassured me she would fix it as they had two more days left of their stay.
Unfortunately no one reached out to them at all, and upon checking out they were informed that a ‘free’ bottle of prosecco had been placed in their room - this was incorrect, so potentially was left in the wrong room - and again this is the same prosecco that is complimentary across the resort so no real effort.
It was an incredibly disappointing end to a mostly positive stay at the Rixos, I would encourage some Incident resolution training for their management along with taking the above feedback on board.

Wow, das Hotel ist einfach top und wunderschön!! Wir waren Ende November für 8 Nächte dort (in einer One Bedroom Suite) und es hat uns so gut gefallen, dass wir dieses Jahr nochmals dorthin möchten.

Wir haben lediglich folgende Kritikpunkte (der Rest verdient absolut 10 von 10 Punkten):

- Die Musiklautstärke war viel zu hoch! V.a. während der abendlichen Show im Kinderclub, wärend der Wassergymnastik am Pool, und während der abendlichen DJ-Performance am Strand. Mein Mann, spezialisiert u.a. auf Hörverlust, meinte, der Lautstärke-Grenzwert sei jeweils um ein Vielfaches überschritten gewesen. Unsere Tochter musste abends bei der Kinderclub-Show immer einen Kopfhörer (als Hörschutz) tragen und wir haben uns immer die Ohren zugehalten…
- Die Wassertemperatur des Hauptpools könnte min. 2 Grad wärmer sein (er war 29 Grad, was dazu führte, dass man ohne ständige Bewegung etwas kalt bekam. 31 Grad wären perfekt gewesen, um länger baden zu können).
- Auch die Pooltemperatur des Kinder-Wasserparks war sooo kalt, dass unsere Tochter (und wir) nicht lange dort bleiben wollten). Das ist vermutlich auch der Grund, weshalb dort fast nie Kinder sind (was schade ist, weil der Wasserpark wirklich schön ist); alle Kinder sind meist im Hauptpool, weil der natürlich einiges wärmer ist.

Bis auf diese Kritikpunkte ist das Hotel traumhaft! Der Service des gesamten Personals ist TOP! Die Auswahl und Qualität in allen Restaurants ebenfalls.

Wir freuen uns schon sehr auf unseren nächsten Aufenthalt!

reviews.text:
Wir waren vom 19. Dezember 2025 bis zum 1. Januar 2026 im Hotel, und das Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island hat uns in jeder Hinsicht beeindruckt. Das gesamte Hotelpersonal war unglaublich freundlich und aufmerksam, sodass wir uns jederzeit willkommen gefühlt haben.

Das kulinarische Erlebnis war atemberaubend – vom Frühstück über das Mittagessen bis hin zum Abendessen waren die Qualität und die Vielfalt der Speisen herausragend. Zudem waren wir angenehm überrascht, dass wir trotz der Hauptsaison nie Probleme hatten, eine freie Liege am Strand zu finden.

Mein persönliches Highlight war jedoch das Fitnessprogramm. Während meines Aufenthalts habe ich mehrere Trainingseinheiten bei den Coaches Kaan Barlas und Alperen Bulut absolviert. Beide Coaches sind hochprofessionell, sehr sympathisch und wissen genau, wie sie einen motivieren können. Es ist selten, ein so qualitativ hochwertiges Training in einem Hotel zu finden. Ein riesiges Kompliment an das gesamte Team und besonders an Kaan und Alperen für diese fantastischen Power-Einheiten! Wir hätten uns keinen besseren Urlaub wünschen können.

Great stay and the hotel is absolutely beautiful but there were a few things I think could be improved. The main buffet restaurant is closed between 4pm and 7pm which is peak time for feeding young children. The other available options in that time don't really work when you have fussy children. The kids food in the restaurant could also be improved. Chips and chicken nuggets everyday is fine if you have children that like chips and chicken nuggets but it would be good to have other child friendly options like fish fingers, plain pasta, peas.
The turndown service is also very late for families. We had a knock on our door at 9.30pm but with young children that is far too late.
Everything else at the hotel was brilliant and we had a really great week.

reviews.text:
We as a family had recently the pleasure of staying at Rixos Saadiyat, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. From the moment I arrived, the staff greeted me with warmth and exceptional hospitality, except one person who was arrogant and not welcoming. The rooms are elegantly designed, offering nice views and excellent ambiance.

The amenities are top-notch, with a stunning pool and direct beach access that made relaxation effortless. The dining options are diverse, featuring delicious cuisine from around the world, and the superb service.

Overall, Rixos Saadiyat exceeded my expectations in every way. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for.
I wish to say extra thank you to the amazing people who helped us during this stay Latifa and Sofia at client service, Valeria at reception, Ali by the pool, Dishika and
Jim Kelly  at turquoise restaurant, Yin and Mina Shrestha.
Also we really enjoyed Mermaid restaurant extra thank ms to Dennis, and all others welcoming staff and oriental.
Thank you so much for the excellent experience

The facilities are top-notch, with clean restrooms, showers, and plenty of shaded loungers, perfect for a relaxing day out. The beach is great for families, and the calm waves are ideal for swimming. Visitare la Gran Moschea dello Sceicco Zayed ad Abu Dhabi è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e profonde del mio viaggio negli Emirati Arabi Uniti. Non è solo una tappa panoramica, ma una delle attrazioni culturali e spirituali più impressionanti del mondo moderno. Appena ci si avvicina, la sua facciata in marmo bianco immacolato con oltre 80 cupole e minareti imponenti è mozzafiato, un vero simbolo di Abu Dhabi che combina architettura islamica tradizionale e maestosità contemporanea. All’interno, la sala di preghiera principale lascia senza parole: il gigantesco tappeto fatto a mano (il più grande del mondo), i lampadari decorati con cristalli e i dettagli in foglia d’oro creano un’atmosfera di bellezza e pace difficili da descrivere. La luce sul marmo e le piscine riflettenti rendono la moschea ancora più spettacolare al tramonto o alla sera, quando le ombre giocano sui mosaici e i colori cambiano gradualmente.
Visitare questo luogo ti fa pensare sia all’arte e all’architettura, sia alla cultura e alla spiritualità che ispira milioni di persone ogni giorno. È importante ricordare di seguire il dress code rispettoso richiesto per l’accesso (spalle e gambe coperte, e per le donne anche testa coperta), una regola che contribuisce al senso di rispetto all’interno di un luogo di culto attivo. Per me la Gran Moschea dello Sceicco Zayed è una delle meraviglie architettoniche più belle che abbia visto, un luogo dove la grandiosità incontra la serenità. Che tu sia religioso o meno, la visita è emozionante, istruttiva e visivamente straordinaria, una tappa assolutamente da non perdere ad Abu Dhabi. Entra con calma al mattino presto o al tramonto per un’esperienza più tranquilla e fotografie spettacolari!

reviews.text:
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is absolutely breathtaking and one of the most unforgettable places i have ever visited — truly a must visit.

the scale of this mosque is incredible. it covers a huge area of about 22 400 square meters (about the size of five football fields) and can welcome tens of thousands of worshippers, with its elegant architecture and peaceful atmosphere inspiring awe the moment you arrive.  ￼

everywhere you look, the details are insane. the walls and columns are inlaid with marble and semi‑precious stones such as lapis lazuli, amethyst, mother‑of‑pearl and red agate — every piece of craftsmanship feels like art.  ￼

inside, the centerpiece is the world’s largest hand‑knotted carpet, covering over 5 600 square meters and weighing around 35 tons — a masterpiece woven by more than a thousand artisans with billions of knots of wool and cotton.  ￼

the chandeliers are equally stunning, studded with millions of crystals, and reflect light in the most beautiful way. the patterns on the floors and ceilings, the gold accents, the geometry — it all comes together in such a harmonious and majestic design that you can’t help but say wow, just wow.  ￼

overall, this mosque is not just a building, it’s a work of art and devotion, with every detail crafted to perfection. if you find yourself in abu dhabi, you absolutely have to see it — it will leave you speechless.
reviews.author: Diana B

reviews.text: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is one of those places that leaves a strong impression without trying too hard. The architecture is beautiful, especially for a relatively modern structure, with an incredible level of detail throughout. The mosque is immaculately maintained, and the open, expansive spaces make the visit feel calm and unhurried. Everything is very well organised, with a smooth and well managed flow from entry to exit. The only slightly tiring part is the amount of walking involved, which can be a bit much if you are visiting with toddlers or elderly family members. However, buggies are available and help make the experience much easier. Overall, it is a thoughtfully managed and memorable place to visit in Abu Dhabi.
