reviews.text:
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is absolutely breathtaking and one of the most unforgettable places i have ever visited — truly a must visit.

the scale of this mosque is incredible. it covers a huge area of about 22 400 square meters (about the size of five football fields) and can welcome tens of thousands of worshippers, with its elegant architecture and peaceful atmosphere inspiring awe the moment you arrive.  ￼

everywhere you look, the details are insane. the walls and columns are inlaid with marble and semi‑precious stones such as lapis lazuli, amethyst, mother‑of‑pearl and red agate — every piece of craftsmanship feels like art.  ￼

inside, the centerpiece is the world’s largest hand‑knotted carpet, covering over 5 600 square meters and weighing around 35 tons — a masterpiece woven by more than a thousand artisans with billions of knots of wool and cotton.  ￼

the chandeliers are equally stunning, studded with millions of crystals, and reflect light in the most beautiful way. the patterns on the floors and ceilings, the gold accents, the geometry — it all comes together in such a harmonious and majestic design that you can’t help but say wow, just wow.  ￼

overall, this mosque is not just a building, it’s a work of art and devotion, with every detail crafted to perfection. if you find yourself in abu dhabi, you absolutely have to see it — it will leave you speechless.

reviews.text:
Visitare la Gran Moschea dello Sceicco Zayed ad Abu Dhabi è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e profonde del mio viaggio negli Emirati Arabi Uniti. Non è solo una tappa panoramica, ma una delle attrazioni culturali e spirituali più impressionanti del mondo moderno. Appena ci si avvicina, la sua facciata in marmo bianco immacolato con oltre 80 cupole e minareti imponenti è mozzafiato, un vero simbolo di Abu Dhabi che combina architettura islamica tradizionale e maestosità contemporanea. All’interno, la sala di preghiera principale lascia senza parole: il gigantesco tappeto fatto a mano (il più grande del mondo), i lampadari decorati con cristalli e i dettagli in foglia d’oro creano un’atmosfera di bellezza e pace difficili da descrivere. La luce sul marmo e le piscine riflettenti rendono la moschea ancora più spettacolare al tramonto o alla sera, quando le ombre giocano sui mosaici e i colori cambiano gradualmente.
Visitare questo luogo ti fa pensare sia all’arte e all’architettura, sia alla cultura e alla spiritualità che ispira milioni di persone ogni giorno. È importante ricordare di seguire il dress code rispettoso richiesto per l’accesso (spalle e gambe coperte, e per le donne anche testa coperta), una regola che contribuisce al senso di rispetto all’interno di un luogo di culto attivo. Per me la Gran Moschea dello Sceicco Zayed è una delle meraviglie architettoniche più belle che abbia visto, un luogo dove la grandiosità incontra la serenità. Che tu sia religioso o meno, la visita è emozionante, istruttiva e visivamente straordinaria, una tappa assolutamente da non perdere ad Abu Dhabi. Entra con calma al mattino presto o al tramonto per un’esperienza più tranquilla e fotografie spettacolari!

reviews.text: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is one of those places that leaves a strong impression without trying too hard. The architecture is beautiful, especially for a relatively modern structure, with an incredible level of detail throughout. The mosque is immaculately maintained, and the open, expansive spaces make the visit feel calm and unhurried. Everything is very well organised, with a smooth and well managed flow from entry to exit. The only slightly tiring part is the amount of walking involved, which can be a bit much if you are visiting with toddlers or elderly family members. However, buggies are available and help make the experience much easier. Overall, it is a thoughtfully managed and memorable place to visit in Abu Dhabi.

reviews.text:
Visitare la Gran Moschea dello Sceicco Zayed ad Abu Dhabi è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e profonde del mio viaggio negli Emirati Arabi Uniti. Non è solo una tappa panoramica, ma una delle attrazioni culturali e spirituali più impressionanti del mondo moderno. Appena ci si avvicina, la sua facciata in marmo bianco immacolato con oltre 80 cupole e minareti imponenti è mozzafiato, un vero simbolo di Abu Dhabi che combina architettura islamica tradizionale e maestosità contemporanea. All’interno, la sala di preghiera principale lascia senza parole: il gigantesco tappeto fatto a mano (il più grande del mondo), i lampadari decorati con cristalli e i dettagli in foglia d’oro creano un’atmosfera di bellezza e pace difficili da descrivere. La luce sul marmo e le piscine riflettenti rendono la moschea ancora più spettacolare al tramonto o alla sera, quando le ombre giocano sui mosaici e i colori cambiano gradualmente.
Visitare questo luogo ti fa pensare sia all’arte e all’architettura, sia alla cultura e alla spiritualità che ispira milioni di persone ogni giorno. È importante ricordare di seguire il dress code rispettoso richiesto per l’accesso (spalle e gambe coperte, e per le donne anche testa coperta), una regola che contribuisce al senso di rispetto all’interno di un luogo di culto attivo. Per me la Gran Moschea dello Sceicco Zayed è una delle meraviglie architettoniche più belle che abbia visto, un luogo dove la grandiosità incontra la serenità. Che tu sia religioso o meno, la visita è emozionante, istruttiva e visivamente straordinaria, una tappa assolutamente da non perdere ad Abu Dhabi. Entra con calma al mattino presto o al tramonto per un’esperienza più tranquilla e fotografie spettacolari!

reviews.text:
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is absolutely breathtaking and one of the most unforgettable places i have ever visited — truly a must visit.

the scale of this mosque is incredible. it covers a huge area of about 22 400 square meters (about the size of five football fields) and can welcome tens of thousands of worshippers, with its elegant architecture and peaceful atmosphere inspiring awe the moment you arrive.  ￼

everywhere you look, the details are insane. the walls and columns are inlaid with marble and semi‑precious stones such as lapis lazuli, amethyst, mother‑of‑pearl and red agate — every piece of craftsmanship feels like art.  ￼

inside, the centerpiece is the world’s largest hand‑knotted carpet, covering over 5 600 square meters and weighing around 35 tons — a masterpiece woven by more than a thousand artisans with billions of knots of wool and cotton.  ￼

the chandeliers are equally stunning, studded with millions of crystals, and reflect light in the most beautiful way. the patterns on the floors and ceilings, the gold accents, the geometry — it all comes together in such a harmonious and majestic design that you can’t help but say wow, just wow.  ￼

overall, this mosque is not just a building, it’s a work of art and devotion, with every detail crafted to perfection. if you find yourself in abu dhabi, you absolutely have to see it — it will leave you speechless.

Every time I visit Sir Bani Yas Island, it is through a cruise, and this was my second visit.
The island is very beautiful, simple, and peaceful, with a relaxing natural atmosphere.
It is home to some wildlife, and we enjoyed an exciting jeep safari experience.
We also saw dolphins, and the view was absolutely beautiful and joyful.
The island features more than one hotel and offers many activities such as swimming, kayaking, jet skiing, and more.
We truly enjoyed the visit and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a calm and nature-filled getaway.

تعتبر جزيرة صير بني ياس واحدة من المواقع الثمانية التي تشكل جزر الصحراء في منطقة الظفرة إذ تتميّز بواجهتها الطبيعية البرية والأنشطة الشيّقة التي تقدّمها والفنادق والفلل الفاخرة بالإضافة إلى الاسطبلات والمواقع التاريخية استثنائية.
حصدت الجزيرة جائزة أفضل وجهة سياحية مستدامة في العالم ضمن جوائز السفر العالمية 2014، حيث تضمّ منتزه الحياة البرية العربية الذي يُعدّ أحد أكبر محميات الحياة البرية في المنطقة إذ يشمل أكثر من 17 ألف حيوان مثل المها العربي والغزلان والزرافات والضباع والفهود الصيادة. يتسنى للضيوف أيضاً الاستمتاع بجولة في سيارة رباعية الدفع لاستكشاف الطبيعة والحياة البرية برفقة فريق من الخبراء فيما توفر اسطبلات الجزيرة الحديثة مجموعةً متنوعة من أنشطة الفروسية ودروس ركوب الخيل لجميع أفراد العائلة. وإذا كنت ترغب في الانطلاق بجولة استكشافية في الجزيرة، يستطيع منتجع دانات جبل الظنة الواقع في البر الرئيسي لأبوظبي مساعدتك في حجز جولة.

وتضم جزيرة صير بني ياس الدير المسيحي الوحيد الذي تمّ اكتشافه في دولة الإمارات العربية المتّحدة والذي يمكن زيارته أثناء جولات منتجع وسبا جزر الصحراء السياحية. ويُعتقدُ بأنّ الدير بُنِي حوالى العام 600 م، ثمّ تمّ هجره في العام 750 م. أمّا اكتشافه فتمّ خلال عمليات التنقيب في الجزيرة في العام 1992.

reviews.text:
We stayed for three nights as part of the inaugural Challenge Sir Bani Yas event.

The island itself quite a drive away. 3:30hrs from Dubai 2hrs from Abu Dhabi.

There is a private airport if that’s how you roll.

To get to the island otherwise you need to take a ferry. You must pre book and provide identification. The journey itself is around 30mins or less.

The island has been invested in by the Abu Dhabi government. The roads are good and so is signage etc.

We stayed in the Anantara (the only option) the staff are amazing. Facilities though are definitely aged. Still nice but nothing compared to other Anantara resorts.

The safari is not like a Kenyan safari. At the time of writing this there is one zebra and two cheetahs. Both of which were hiding at the back of a cage when we were there. Giraffes are amazing though and they have plenty of other wildlife. Over 13000.

Two nights is more than enough.

reviews.text:
A definite one time visit to understand and appreciate the vision of the country; the island is aimed at planting trees and increasing fertility of its land so as to make it an agricultural area. Very wide spread area with animals running around and well maintained.

The trip from Abu Dhabi to the ferry took 2.30 hours. The ferry ride is another 30 minutes ride and then a bus that will take you to the Anantara resort from where the Safari for wildlife begins. The safari is a 90 minute ride with a tour guide. Very passionate tour guides and makes it a wonderful experience.

The journey can get tiring if you take a day visit; like we did. There is quite a lot of journey involved. It’s worth the visit at least once. Please take snacks and water with you so that you are not starving. Although the safari ride do have water in their cars. The safari cars are quite comfortable as well; and they help seniors get into the vehicle with additional support if they aren’t able to get into the jeep.

Good place to go with family; I would recommend a stay though in the hotel. If you have a tight budget; just take a day visit and enjoy nature at its diversity! Start with a full tank and then there are petrol stations almost when you reach Sir baniyas

reviews.text:
Beautiful experience overall. The grounds, flora, and fauna that they’ve managed to create is stunning as the place is generally not highly fertile. The project is very ambitious. On the Sir Bani Yas island there are 3 resorts. One feels like another hotel is Dubai or Abu Dhabi, that’s (1) Desert Islands Resort & Spa, (2) Sahel Villa Resort, and (3) Al Yamm Villa Resort. They have cars on the island shuttling you around from one resort to another one so that you can try the different restaurants so no need to worry about not having enough dining options. For context, we stayed at Al Yamm Villa Resort.

Here is the good, the bad, and special:

The ‘Good’
- The resort felt rustic and it fit in the environment
- The private villa’s pool was heated so it was comfy to get into at night
- Turn down service was nice. They have yummy cookies
- Even though they take a bit of time to reply, the Anantara app is useful to connect with front desk
- You get access to the beautiful beach
- There are different activities to keep the fun going

The ‘Bad’
- We paid AED 5,000 per night and AED 1,000+ per meal and we felt the value wasn’t there versus Nurai Island or Al Maha Resort
- The villa is definitely outdated. I love that it’s rustic, but it can definitely use an upgrade asap. For the prices they charge, it should be luxurious
- We wanted a king size bed and they gave us 2 queens and pushed the beds together :( Even though the beds were comfortable, we aren’t used to sleeping on anything less than a California King
- Privacy of the outdoor area of the villa was lacking in a major way. Not only could your neighbors see you 100% at all times, but even people walking in front of the villas
- Reception doesn’t welcome you with useful information about the resort and how things work
- Hit or miss when it came to the staff knowing English well
- The shower head holder of the villa was loose. Housekeeping should check for all these things and get them fixed before the guest arrives.
- Getting the shower head to work was impossible
- The amenities in the bathroom lacked a loofah
- The transportation boat from the mainland to the island and return was simply awful. They should have a high quality boat just for guests staying at the hotel(s) on the island

The ‘Special’

- Tour guide of the mini safari was amazing. Very knowledgeable and cared a lot about the island itself as a project
- Dinner at the African restaurant in the Sahel property was special. They had some nice music on the background coming from the ‘bush’ and it made it cozy
- At the African restaurant, baby oryx approached and it was a beautiful experience
- The spa was solid. We had a couples experience which included time in the jacuzzi, then a massage, and mini facials
- The animal variety in the mini safari tour was great. I’m still amazed at what they were able to build here

Would I go back?
- Yes, I hope they fix all these things, but regardless I’d love to go back and experience it with friends and family

🌴

في كل مرة أزور فيها جزيرة صير بني ياس تكون الزيارة عن طريق الكروز، وهذه كانت المرة الثانية.
الجزيرة جميلة جدًا وبسيطة، وتتميز بطبيعتها الهادئة.
تضم بعض الحيوانات، وقد قمنا بتجربة سفاري بسيارات الجيب وكانت تجربة ممتعة ومميزة.
كما شاهدنا الدلافين، وكان منظرها جميلًا جدًا ومبهجًا.
تحتوي الجزيرة على أكثر من فندق، وتتوفر فيها العديد من الأنشطة مثل السباحة، الكاياك، الجت سكي وغيرها الكثير.
استمتعنا كثيرًا بالزيارة، وأنصح بها بشدة لكل من يبحث عن تجربة طبيعية وهادئة.

——

Every time I visit Sir Bani Yas Island, it is through a cruise, and this was my second visit.
The island is very beautiful, simple, and peaceful, with a relaxing natural atmosphere.
It is home to some wildlife, and we enjoyed an exciting jeep safari experience.
We also saw dolphins, and the view was absolutely beautiful and joyful.
The island features more than one hotel and offers many activities such as swimming, kayaking, jet skiing, and more.
We truly enjoyed the visit and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a calm and nature-filled getaway.

reviews.text:
تعتبر جزيرة صير بني ياس واحدة من المواقع الثمانية التي تشكل جزر الصحراء في منطقة الظفرة إذ تتميّز بواجهتها الطبيعية البرية والأنشطة الشيّقة التي تقدّمها والفنادق والفلل الفاخرة بالإضافة إلى الاسطبلات والمواقع التاريخية استثنائية.
حصدت الجزيرة جائزة أفضل وجهة سياحية مستدامة في العالم ضمن جوائز السفر العالمية 2014، حيث تضمّ منتزه الحياة البرية العربية الذي يُعدّ أحد أكبر محميات الحياة البرية في المنطقة إذ يشمل أكثر من 17 ألف حيوان مثل المها العربي والغزلان والزرافات والضباع والفهود الصيادة. يتسنى للضيوف أيضاً الاستمتاع بجولة في سيارة رباعية الدفع لاستكشاف الطبيعة والحياة البرية برفقة فريق من الخبراء فيما توفر اسطبلات الجزيرة الحديثة مجموعةً متنوعة من أنشطة الفروسية ودروس ركوب الخيل لجميع أفراد العائلة. وإذا كنت ترغب في الانطلاق بجولة استكشافية في الجزيرة، يستطيع منتجع دانات جبل الظنة الواقع في البر الرئيسي لأبوظبي مساعدتك في حجز جولة.

وتضم جزيرة صير بني ياس الدير المسيحي الوحيد الذي تمّ اكتشافه في دولة الإمارات العربية المتّحدة والذي يمكن زيارته أثناء جولات منتجع وسبا جزر الصحراء السياحية. ويُعتقدُ بأنّ الدير بُنِي حوالى العام 600 م، ثمّ تمّ هجره في العام 750 م. أمّا اكتشافه فتمّ خلال عمليات التنقيب في الجزيرة في العام 1992.

reviews.text:
We stayed for three nights as part of the inaugural Challenge Sir Bani Yas event.

The island itself quite a drive away. 3:30hrs from Dubai 2hrs from Abu Dhabi.

There is a private airport if that’s how you roll.

To get to the island otherwise you need to take a ferry. You must pre book and provide identification. The journey itself is around 30mins or less.

The island has been invested in by the Abu Dhabi government. The roads are good and so is signage etc.

We stayed in the Anantara (the only option) the staff are amazing. Facilities though are definitely aged. Still nice but nothing compared to other Anantara resorts.

The safari is not like a Kenyan safari. At the time of writing this there is one zebra and two cheetahs. Both of which were hiding at the back of a cage when we were there. Giraffes are amazing though and they have plenty of other wildlife. Over 13000.

Two nights is more than enough.

reviews.text:
A definite one time visit to understand and appreciate the vision of the country; the island is aimed at planting trees and increasing fertility of its land so as to make it an agricultural area. Very wide spread area with animals running around and well maintained.

The trip from Abu Dhabi to the ferry took 2.30 hours. The ferry ride is another 30 minutes ride and then a bus that will take you to the Anantara resort from where the Safari for wildlife begins. The safari is a 90 minute ride with a tour guide. Very passionate tour guides and makes it a wonderful experience.

The journey can get tiring if you take a day visit; like we did. There is quite a lot of journey involved. It’s worth the visit at least once. Please take snacks and water with you so that you are not starving. Although the safari ride do have water in their cars. The safari cars are quite comfortable as well; and they help seniors get into the vehicle with additional support if they aren’t able to get into the jeep.

Good place to go with family; I would recommend a stay though in the hotel. If you have a tight budget; just take a day visit and enjoy nature at its diversity! Start with a full tank and then there are petrol stations almost when you reach Sir baniyas

However, it’s important to check ride availability before going, as some attractions — especially the zip line — may be closed at times due to maintenance. The number of rides is limited, so it’s best planned as a 2–3 hour visit rather than a full-day trip. Overall, it’s a nice, well-maintained attraction for short, fun-filled snow time.

Unforgettable Experience at Snow Abu Dhabi

Our visit to Snow Abu Dhabi was truly amazing and beyond our expectations. The entire place is magical, well-organized, and perfect for all ages. From the moment we entered, the atmosphere already felt special.

The entire crew deserves high praise for being so friendly, helpful, and professional. A very special thank you to Sir Peter and all the elves, who went above and beyond to make our experience memorable. They were incredibly warm, entertaining, and attentive, and they made my mother and sister’s vacation extra special. Because of them, they truly enjoyed every moment and felt very well taken care of.

This experience brought so much joy and wonderful memories to our family. Snow Abu Dhabi is a must-visit, and we highly recommend it to everyone looking for a unique and happy experience. We will definitely come back again!

reviews.text:
مرحبا بالجميع
تجربة ممتعة وفريدة في سنو أبوظبي!
المكان مصمّم بطريقة رائعة تجعلك تعيش أجواء الثلج الحقيقية وسط أبوظبي، ويُعد واحدًا من أفضل الوجهات الترفيهية العائلية في المدينة. الأجواء باردة وممتعة، والأنشطة المتوفرة كثيرة ومتنوعة وتناسب جميع الأعمار.

العروض والألعاب الثلجية مثل الانزلاق، تسلق الجليد، والأنفاق الثلجية تضيف عنصر الإثارة، بينما أماكن الجلوس الثلجية ومجسّمات الحيوانات تمنح لحظات جميلة للتصوير والاستمتاع بالأجواء. المكان واسع ومنظم، مما يجعل الحركة فيه سهلة ومريحة حتى مع الازدحام.

الطاقم محترف ومتعاون، ويقدّمون الإرشادات بوضوح ويهتمون بسلامة الزوار، خصوصًا الأطفال. كما أن الملابس الشتوية المتوفرة عند الدخول تزيد من راحة التجربة، وتسمح بالاستمتاع داخل المكان لفترة طويلة دون الشعور بالبرد الشديد.

النظافة ممتازة، والتنظيم رائع، والأسعار تعتبر مناسبة مقارنة بحجم التجربة وجودتها. كذلك توجد مناطق للراحة وشراء المشروبات الساخنة، مما يجعل الزيارة مكتملة وممتعة.

سنو أبوظبي تجربة رائعة تجمع بين المتعة والمرح والأجواء الباردة الجميلة. مكان مثالي للعائلات وللأطفال ومحبي الأنشطة الجديدة و التغير

reviews.text: Snow Abu Dhabi is truly one of the most unique and magical attractions in the UAE. reviews.text:
Overall Snow Abu Dhabi experience is very nice but I would like to share my feedback regarding the photo package. Out of the 90 photos provided, only 17 are unique with different poses; the rest are duplicates or edited  (Photoshop) versions. In effect, there are fewer than 20 distinct photos.

Considering the cost of AED 220, which includes just one small snowfall photo frame, I find this pricing to be very high and not reflective of the actual value received. I am very dissatisfied with this outcome.

I kindly request that this feedback be conveyed to the management/owner, as a fair adjustment in pricing would make the service more accessible and reasonable for middle-class families.

Absolutely NOT recommended specially if you have children below 120cm height as almost all activities required a minimum height of 120cm to be able to do it. They made me pay for my child ticket (almost same price as an adult) as she is 115cm but inside she was denied to carry out most activities due to minimum height requirement.

Very pricey for these few activities available and that also you will have to wait lots in the queue before being able to carry out an activity, even though only few people were present. So it will be only worst when full.

They are under staff and most of them are rude, no smile, no greetings, limit "aggressive" while putting/removing the safety gears.

Highly recommend to take the waterproof gloves specially for children and to bring warm clothes though you will be provided with other necessary equipments including boots.

reviews.author: Tatiana Gievtigidou

reviews.text: Snow Abu Dhabi is a fun and unique indoor snow park, especially great for families and first-time visitors. The snow setting, play areas, and rides create an enjoyable winter experience in the middle of the city. However, it’s important to check ride availability before going, as some attractions — especially the zip line — may be closed at times due to maintenance. The number of rides is limited, so it’s best planned as a 2–3 hour visit rather than a full-day trip. Overall, it’s a nice, well-maintained attraction for short, fun-filled snow time.
reviews.author: PositiveVibes

reviews.text: Visited Snow Abu Dhabi with family, very nice place to have fun with family,  enjoyed different rides and it was really a fun. Snow abu dhabi is ideally located in Reem mall easily accessible from city, ticket price is also reasonable.  Staff is also very cooperative.  It was a memorable experience with family.  I recommend families to go and enjoy sub zero temperatures inside in summer. Costume is provided free of charge to keep yourself warm.

reviews.text:
Unforgettable Experience at Snow Abu Dhabi

Our visit to Snow Abu Dhabi was truly amazing and beyond our expectations. The entire place is magical, well-organized, and perfect for all ages. From the moment we entered, the atmosphere already felt special.

The entire crew deserves high praise for being so friendly, helpful, and professional. A very special thank you to Sir Peter and all the elves, who went above and beyond to make our experience memorable. They were incredibly warm, entertaining, and attentive, and they made my mother and sister’s vacation extra special. Because of them, they truly enjoyed every moment and felt very well taken care of.

This experience brought so much joy and wonderful memories to our family. Snow Abu Dhabi is a must-visit, and we highly recommend it to everyone looking for a unique and happy experience. We will definitely come back again!

reviews.text: Snow Abu Dhabi is a fun and unique indoor snow park, especially great for families and first-time visitors. The snow setting, play areas, and rides create an enjoyable winter experience in the middle of the city. However, it’s important to check ride availability before going, as some attractions — especially the zip line — may be closed at times due to maintenance. The number of rides is limited, so it’s best planned as a 2–3 hour visit rather than a full-day trip. Overall, it’s a nice, well-maintained attraction for short, fun-filled snow time.

reviews.text:
Unforgettable Experience at Snow Abu Dhabi

Our visit to Snow Abu Dhabi was truly amazing and beyond our expectations. The entire place is magical, well-organized, and perfect for all ages. From the moment we entered, the atmosphere already felt special.

The entire crew deserves high praise for being so friendly, helpful, and professional. A very special thank you to Sir Peter and all the elves, who went above and beyond to make our experience memorable. They were incredibly warm, entertaining, and attentive, and they made my mother and sister’s vacation extra special. Because of them, they truly enjoyed every moment and felt very well taken care of.

This experience brought so much joy and wonderful memories to our family. Snow Abu Dhabi is a must-visit, and we highly recommend it to everyone looking for a unique and happy experience. We will definitely come back again!

reviews.text:
مرحبا بالجميع
تجربة ممتعة وفريدة في سنو أبوظبي!
المكان مصمّم بطريقة رائعة تجعلك تعيش أجواء الثلج الحقيقية وسط أبوظبي، ويُعد واحدًا من أفضل الوجهات الترفيهية العائلية في المدينة. الأجواء باردة وممتعة، والأنشطة المتوفرة كثيرة ومتنوعة وتناسب جميع الأعمار.

العروض والألعاب الثلجية مثل الانزلاق، تسلق الجليد، والأنفاق الثلجية تضيف عنصر الإثارة، بينما أماكن الجلوس الثلجية ومجسّمات الحيوانات تمنح لحظات جميلة للتصوير والاستمتاع بالأجواء. المكان واسع ومنظم، مما يجعل الحركة فيه سهلة ومريحة حتى مع الازدحام.

الطاقم محترف ومتعاون، ويقدّمون الإرشادات بوضوح ويهتمون بسلامة الزوار، خصوصًا الأطفال. كما أن الملابس الشتوية المتوفرة عند الدخول تزيد من راحة التجربة، وتسمح بالاستمتاع داخل المكان لفترة طويلة دون الشعور بالبرد الشديد.

النظافة ممتازة، والتنظيم رائع، والأسعار تعتبر مناسبة مقارنة بحجم التجربة وجودتها. كذلك توجد مناطق للراحة وشراء المشروبات الساخنة، مما يجعل الزيارة مكتملة وممتعة.

سنو أبوظبي تجربة رائعة تجمع بين المتعة والمرح والأجواء الباردة الجميلة. مكان مثالي للعائلات وللأطفال ومحبي الأنشطة الجديدة و التغير
ويستحق الزيارة أكثر من مرة
ويستحق التقيم
ويستحق التجربه
سلام ✋🏼

reviews.text: Snow Abu Dhabi is truly one of the most unique and magical attractions in the UAE. The moment you step inside, you forget you’re in the middle of the desert — the snowy atmosphere, cool temperature, and beautiful winter scenery make it feel like a real winter wonderland.It’s the perfect spot for families, tourists, or anyone who just wants a break from the heat and experience real snow indoors. A fantastic experience from start to finish — highly recommended for a fun, memorable day.

reviews.text:
Overall Snow Abu Dhabi experience is very nice but I would like to share my feedback regarding the photo package. Out of the 90 photos provided, only 17 are unique with different poses; the rest are duplicates or edited  (Photoshop) versions. In effect, there are fewer than 20 distinct photos.

Considering the cost of AED 220, which includes just one small snowfall photo frame, I find this pricing to be very high and not reflective of the actual value received. I am very dissatisfied with this outcome.

I kindly request that this feedback be conveyed to the management/owner, as a fair adjustment in pricing would make the service more accessible and reasonable for middle-class families.

reviews.text:
Absolutely NOT recommended specially if you have children below 120cm height as almost all activities required a minimum height of 120cm to be able to do it. They made me pay for my child ticket (almost same price as an adult) as she is 115cm but inside she was denied to carry out most activities due to minimum height requirement.

Very pricey for these few activities available and that also you will have to wait lots in the queue before being able to carry out an activity, even though only few people were present. So it will be only worst when full.

They are under staff and most of them are rude, no smile, no greetings, limit "aggressive" while putting/removing the safety gears.

Highly recommend to take the waterproof gloves specially for children and to bring warm clothes though you will be provided with other necessary equipments including boots.

reviews.text:
Excellent indoor park in the heart of Abu Dhabi city (it's inside Reem Mall) with plenty of activities and rides for adults and kids. Easily escape the heat at any time of the year and feel the real cold and snow sensation. Snow gear will be provided (suit, boots, socks, gloves). Plenty of packages to choose from. Advice: take a snow hat/beanie and wear warm clothes. Lockers are provided free of charge and changing room available.  Plenty of pictures not to be missed .A day full of enjoyment and fun is guaranteed😍🤩☃️🌬
You can get the package with food and drinks included .PS : don't miss the delicious hot chocolate 😋

reviews.text: Snow Abu Dhabi is truly one of the most unique and magical attractions in the UAE. reviews.text:
Overall Snow Abu Dhabi experience is very nice but I would like to share my feedback regarding the photo package. Out of the 90 photos provided, only 17 are unique with different poses; the rest are duplicates or edited  (Photoshop) versions. In effect, there are fewer than 20 distinct photos.

Considering the cost of AED 220, which includes just one small snowfall photo frame, I find this pricing to be very high and not reflective of the actual value received. I am very dissatisfied with this outcome.

I kindly request that this feedback be conveyed to the management/owner, as a fair adjustment in pricing would make the service more accessible and reasonable for middle-class families.

The only negative thing I found was there is one employee who was arguing with a colleague in front of us and making us wait for the ride because they had issues between each other. He was also a little aggressive. Everyone else were smiling, nice, and professional.
I highly recommend visiting Snow Abu Dhabi. Feels like you are in one of the cold snowing countries. The staff at the restaurant were also excellent 👍🏻.  My daughters enjoyed the hot chocolate that had an eatable cup. Highly recommend

reviews.text:
Absolutely NOT recommended specially if you have children below 120cm height as almost all activities required a minimum height of 120cm to be able to do it. They made me pay for my child ticket (almost same price as an adult) as she is 115cm but inside she was denied to carry out most activities due to minimum height requirement.

Very pricey for these few activities available and that also you will have to wait lots in the queue before being able to carry out an activity, even though only few people were present. So it will be only worst when full.

They are under staff and most of them are rude, no smile, no greetings, limit "aggressive" while putting/removing the safety gears.

Highly recommend to take the waterproof gloves specially for children and to bring warm clothes though you will be provided with other necessary equipments including boots.

reviews.author: Muzammil Zaam

reviews.text:
Excellent indoor park in the heart of Abu Dhabi city (it's inside Reem Mall) with plenty of activities and rides for adults and kids. Easily escape the heat at any time of the year and feel the real cold and snow sensation. Snow gear will be provided (suit, boots, socks, gloves). Plenty of packages to choose from. Advice: take a snow hat/beanie and wear warm clothes. Lockers are provided free of charge and changing room available.  Plenty of pictures not to be missed .A day full of enjoyment and fun is guaranteed😍🤩☃️🌬
You can get the package with food and drinks included .PS : don't miss the delicious hot chocolate 😋

reviews.text: Snow Abu Dhabi is a fun and unique indoor snow park, especially great for families and first-time visitors. The snow setting, play areas, and rides create an enjoyable winter experience in the middle of the city. However, it’s important to check ride availability before going, as some attractions — especially the zip line — may be closed at times due to maintenance. The number of rides is limited, so it’s best planned as a 2–3 hour visit rather than a full-day trip. Overall, it’s a nice, well-maintained attraction for short, fun-filled snow time.
reviews.author: PositiveVibes

reviews.text: Visited Snow Abu Dhabi with family, very nice place to have fun with family,  enjoyed different rides and it was really a fun. Snow abu dhabi is ideally located in Reem mall easily accessible from city, ticket price is also reasonable.  Staff is also very cooperative.  It was a memorable experience with family.  I recommend families to go and enjoy sub zero temperatures inside in summer. Costume is provided free of charge to keep yourself warm.

reviews.text:
Unforgettable Experience at Snow Abu Dhabi

Our visit to Snow Abu Dhabi was truly amazing and beyond our expectations. The entire place is magical, well-organized, and perfect for all ages. From the moment we entered, the atmosphere already felt special.

The entire crew deserves high praise for being so friendly, helpful, and professional. A very special thank you to Sir Peter and all the elves, who went above and beyond to make our experience memorable. They were incredibly warm, entertaining, and attentive, and they made my mother and sister’s vacation extra special. Because of them, they truly enjoyed every moment and felt very well taken care of.

This experience brought so much joy and wonderful memories to our family. Snow Abu Dhabi is a must-visit, and we highly recommend it to everyone looking for a unique and happy experience. We will definitely come back again!

reviews.text: Snow Abu Dhabi is a fun and unique indoor snow park, especially great for families and first-time visitors. The snow setting, play areas, and rides create an enjoyable winter experience in the middle of the city. However, it’s important to check ride availability before going, as some attractions — especially the zip line — may be closed at times due to maintenance. The number of rides is limited, so it’s best planned as a 2–3 hour visit rather than a full-day trip. Overall, it’s a nice, well-maintained attraction for short, fun-filled snow time.
reviews.author: PositiveVibes

reviews.text: Visited Snow Abu Dhabi with family, very nice place to have fun with family,  enjoyed different rides and it was really a fun. I recommend families to go and enjoy sub zero temperatures inside in summer. Costume is provided free of charge to keep yourself warm.

reviews.text:
Unforgettable Experience at Snow Abu Dhabi

Our visit to Snow Abu Dhabi was truly amazing and beyond our expectations. The entire place is magical, well-organized, and perfect for all ages. From the moment we entered, the atmosphere already felt special.

The entire crew deserves high praise for being so friendly, helpful, and professional. A very special thank you to Sir Peter and all the elves, who went above and beyond to make our experience memorable. They were incredibly warm, entertaining, and attentive, and they made my mother and sister’s vacation extra special. Because of them, they truly enjoyed every moment and felt very well taken care of.

This experience brought so much joy and wonderful memories to our family. Snow Abu Dhabi is a must-visit, and we highly recommend it to everyone looking for a unique and happy experience. We will definitely come back again!

reviews.text:
مرحبا بالجميع
تجربة ممتعة وفريدة في سنو أبوظبي!
المكان مصمّم بطريقة رائعة تجعلك تعيش أجواء الثلج الحقيقية وسط أبوظبي، ويُعد واحدًا من أفضل الوجهات الترفيهية العائلية في المدينة. الأجواء باردة وممتعة، والأنشطة المتوفرة كثيرة ومتنوعة وتناسب جميع الأعمار.

العروض والألعاب الثلجية مثل الانزلاق، تسلق الجليد، والأنفاق الثلجية تضيف عنصر الإثارة، بينما أماكن الجلوس الثلجية ومجسّمات الحيوانات تمنح لحظات جميلة للتصوير والاستمتاع بالأجواء. المكان واسع ومنظم، مما يجعل الحركة فيه سهلة ومريحة حتى مع الازدحام.

الطاقم محترف ومتعاون، ويقدّمون الإرشادات بوضوح ويهتمون بسلامة الزوار، خصوصًا الأطفال. كما أن الملابس الشتوية المتوفرة عند الدخول تزيد من راحة التجربة، وتسمح بالاستمتاع داخل المكان لفترة طويلة دون الشعور بالبرد الشديد.

النظافة ممتازة، والتنظيم رائع، والأسعار تعتبر مناسبة مقارنة بحجم التجربة وجودتها. كذلك توجد مناطق للراحة وشراء المشروبات الساخنة، مما يجعل الزيارة مكتملة وممتعة.

سنو أبوظبي تجربة رائعة تجمع بين المتعة والمرح والأجواء الباردة الجميلة. مكان مثالي للعائلات وللأطفال ومحبي الأنشطة الجديدة و التغير
ويستحق الزيارة أكثر من مرة
ويستحق التقيم
ويستحق التجربه
سلام ✋🏼

reviews.text:
Overall Snow Abu Dhabi experience is very nice but I would like to share my feedback regarding the photo package. Out of the 90 photos provided, only 17 are unique with different poses; the rest are duplicates or edited  (Photoshop) versions. In effect, there are fewer than 20 distinct photos.

Considering the cost of AED 220, which includes just one small snowfall photo frame, I find this pricing to be very high and not reflective of the actual value received. I am very dissatisfied with this outcome.

I kindly request that this feedback be conveyed to the management/owner, as a fair adjustment in pricing would make the service more accessible and reasonable for middle-class families.

Very pricey for these few activities available and that also you will have to wait lots in the queue before being able to carry out an activity, even though only few people were present. So it will be only worst when full.

Advice: take a snow hat/beanie and wear warm clothes. Lockers are provided free of charge and changing room available.  Plenty of pictures not to be missed .A day full of enjoyment and fun is guaranteed😍🤩☃️🌬
You can get the package with food and drinks included .PS : don't miss the delicious hot chocolate 😋

reviews.text:
Surf Abu Dhabi is an amazing place to relax, learn how to surf as a beginner, and catch some perfect barrels for intermediate surfers.

The atmosphere is great and welcoming for all levels.

The food at Nalu is also really good and a perfect place to unwind after surfing.

If you’re on a tighter budget, try the Surf Social fun wave — it’s ideal for a group of friends. You still get to surf the famous wave, enjoy bites and drinks, chill by the pool, and it’s very family-friendly with a huge open space where kids can run around.

Highly recommended for a fun day with friends or family.

As an experienced surfer with a sense of business economics I’d say this:  enjoy this gift from UAE.  I doubt this business model works at this level without some subsidy (land cost, building, etc).  Worthwhile life experience.  Expensive, but a lot cheaper and more forgiving than getting to a reef in the middle of the South Pacific!

I recently visited Surf Abu Dhabi, and it completely exceeded my expectations. From the moment we arrived, everything was perfect. The staff were friendly, professional, and genuinely passionate about surfing. The facilities are world-class, clean, and thoughtfully designed, creating the perfect environment for both beginners and experienced surfers.

The wave quality was unbelievable — consistent, powerful, and customizable to suit every level. It’s the closest thing you can get to surfing in the ocean, with the added bonus of perfect conditions every single session. The team does an amazing job keeping things safe, fun, and flowing smoothly.

A special shoutout to Grace, our surf coach, who made the whole experience even better. She was super knowledgeable, patient, and encouraging — her tips helped us improve quickly while keeping things relaxed and enjoyable. Grace’s energy and professionalism really stood out, and she made the session unforgettable.

If you’re in Abu Dhabi and love surfing (or want to learn), Surf Abu Dhabi is an absolute must-visit. I will defiently be back again to visit.

Thanks to all the team at Surf Abudabi 🙏

Great service both poolside/lakeside throughout the day, lovely food at the adjactent Nalu restaurant and great vibes throughout - the vibe moves from chilled to party vibes as the day progresses, with a combination of live music and a dj. A bit loud for my tastes, but I'm a middle-aged man from the UK - everything is loud!

The facility is modern, clean, and very professionally maintained. The artificial wave pool looks spectacular powerful yet controlled and you can see the excitement and energy from the surfers enjoying their sessions. The staff were welcoming and helpful, and the entire atmosphere had a vibrant, beachside vibe right in the heart of Abu Dhabi.

reviews.text:
The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi rozhodně stojí za návštěvu. Akvária mám projitá po celém světě – v Evropě, Americe i Asii – a tohle bez váhání řadím mezi ta úplně nejlepší.
Akvárium je rozděleno do deseti tematických zón, které na sebe plynule navazují. Vše je perfektně čisté, moderní, vizuálně velmi dobře řešené a zároveň přehledné i pro rodiny s dětmi. Je vidět, že jde o nové a velmi dobře udržované místo.
Mezi největší taháky patří kapustňák, arapajma gigas a hlavně velký podvodní tunel, kde se nad vámi pohybují žraloci, včetně kladivounů. Celé to působí velmi přirozeně, expozice nejsou přeplácané a zvířata jsou dobře viditelná. Zážitek je silný jak pro děti, tak pro dospělé.
Menší, ale praktická kritická poznámka:
během celé prohlídkové trasy je minimum toalet. Jedna větší možnost je až před hlavním tunelem. Pokud jdete s dětmi, určitě doporučuji využít toalety hned na začátku, jinak vás čeká nepříjemné vracení se zpět po trase.
Vstupné je podle mého názoru přiměřené kvalitě i délce návštěvy. Lístky jsme kupovali přímo na místě a nebyl s tím žádný problém. Akvárium je plně klimatizované, což je v Abu Dhabi velké plus, zejména v teplejších měsících.
Doprava je velmi jednoduchá – Uber je v Abu Dhabi spolehlivý, dostupný a cenově rozumný, z centra města naprosto bez problému.
Velkou výhodou je i samotná lokalita. V bezprostředním okolí je krásná promenáda plná restaurací a kaváren a hned na stejné ulici se nachází velké zábavní centrum se spoustou atrakcí pro děti i dospělé. Pokud tedy plánujete program mimo samotné centrum Abu Dhabi, dá se zde bez problému strávit celý den – my jsme to tak měli, včetně oběda, procházky po promenádě a posezení v kavárnách.
Shrnuto:
moderní, špičkově udělané akvárium světové úrovně, které funguje nejen jako samostatná atrakce, ale i jako ideální základna pro celodenní program s rodinou. Jednoznačně doporučuji.

reviews.text:
The National Aquarium is the largest aquarium in the Middle East, located in the Al Qana development in Abu Dhabi. It is home to over 46,000 animals from more than 300 unique species across 10 themed zones, ranging from the UAE’s marine treasures to the frozen Arctic and the Red Sea Wreck.

Notable features include the region's longest underwater tunnel and a focus on marine conservation and education. Visitors can enjoy interactive experiences like glass-bottom boat tours, a glass bridge walk, and animal encounters with sharks, rays, and puffins. It stands as a major family attraction dedicated to exploring and preserving the marine environment.

reviews.text:
Our visit to The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi was truly exceptional. The entire experience was educational, engaging, and perfectly designed for families. The exhibits are beautifully arranged, the environment is clean and well-organized, and the variety of marine life is simply impressive. It’s a place where children learn while having fun, and adults enjoy every moment just as much.

I would also like to extend special thanks and appreciation to Ms. Hanan, one of the staff members who made our visit unforgettable. She took the time to give my children a detailed explanation about how animals are examined, cared for, rehabilitated, and eventually released back into Abu Dhabi’s natural environment. Her passion, knowledge, and kindness truly stood out. She made the experience more meaningful and inspired my children to appreciate wildlife conservation.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Abu Dhabi—an amazing place with amazing people behind it.

reviews.text:
The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi rozhodně stojí za návštěvu. Akvária mám projitá po celém světě – v Evropě, Americe i Asii – a tohle bez váhání řadím mezi ta úplně nejlepší.
Akvárium je rozděleno do deseti tematických zón, které na sebe plynule navazují. Vše je perfektně čisté, moderní, vizuálně velmi dobře řešené a zároveň přehledné i pro rodiny s dětmi. Je vidět, že jde o nové a velmi dobře udržované místo.
Mezi největší taháky patří kapustňák, arapajma gigas a hlavně velký podvodní tunel, kde se nad vámi pohybují žraloci, včetně kladivounů. Celé to působí velmi přirozeně, expozice nejsou přeplácané a zvířata jsou dobře viditelná. Zážitek je silný jak pro děti, tak pro dospělé.
Menší, ale praktická kritická poznámka:
během celé prohlídkové trasy je minimum toalet. Jedna větší možnost je až před hlavním tunelem. Pokud jdete s dětmi, určitě doporučuji využít toalety hned na začátku, jinak vás čeká nepříjemné vracení se zpět po trase.
Vstupné je podle mého názoru přiměřené kvalitě i délce návštěvy. Lístky jsme kupovali přímo na místě a nebyl s tím žádný problém. Akvárium je plně klimatizované, což je v Abu Dhabi velké plus, zejména v teplejších měsících.
Doprava je velmi jednoduchá – Uber je v Abu Dhabi spolehlivý, dostupný a cenově rozumný, z centra města naprosto bez problému.
Velkou výhodou je i samotná lokalita. V bezprostředním okolí je krásná promenáda plná restaurací a kaváren a hned na stejné ulici se nachází velké zábavní centrum se spoustou atrakcí pro děti i dospělé. Pokud tedy plánujete program mimo samotné centrum Abu Dhabi, dá se zde bez problému strávit celý den – my jsme to tak měli, včetně oběda, procházky po promenádě a posezení v kavárnách.
Shrnuto:
moderní, špičkově udělané akvárium světové úrovně, které funguje nejen jako samostatná atrakce, ale i jako ideální základna pro celodenní program s rodinou. Jednoznačně doporučuji.

reviews.text:
The National Aquarium is the largest aquarium in the Middle East, located in the Al Qana development in Abu Dhabi. It is home to over 46,000 animals from more than 300 unique species across 10 themed zones, ranging from the UAE’s marine treasures to the frozen Arctic and the Red Sea Wreck.

Notable features include the region's longest underwater tunnel and a focus on marine conservation and education. Visitors can enjoy interactive experiences like glass-bottom boat tours, a glass bridge walk, and animal encounters with sharks, rays, and puffins. It stands as a major family attraction dedicated to exploring and preserving the marine environment.

reviews.text:
The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi rozhodně stojí za návštěvu. Akvária mám projitá po celém světě – v Evropě, Americe i Asii – a tohle bez váhání řadím mezi ta úplně nejlepší.
Akvárium je rozděleno do deseti tematických zón, které na sebe plynule navazují. Vše je perfektně čisté, moderní, vizuálně velmi dobře řešené a zároveň přehledné i pro rodiny s dětmi. Je vidět, že jde o nové a velmi dobře udržované místo.
Mezi největší taháky patří kapustňák, arapajma gigas a hlavně velký podvodní tunel, kde se nad vámi pohybují žraloci, včetně kladivounů. Celé to působí velmi přirozeně, expozice nejsou přeplácané a zvířata jsou dobře viditelná. Zážitek je silný jak pro děti, tak pro dospělé.
Menší, ale praktická kritická poznámka:
během celé prohlídkové trasy je minimum toalet. Jedna větší možnost je až před hlavním tunelem. Pokud jdete s dětmi, určitě doporučuji využít toalety hned na začátku, jinak vás čeká nepříjemné vracení se zpět po trase.
Vstupné je podle mého názoru přiměřené kvalitě i délce návštěvy. Lístky jsme kupovali přímo na místě a nebyl s tím žádný problém. Akvárium je plně klimatizované, což je v Abu Dhabi velké plus, zejména v teplejších měsících.
Doprava je velmi jednoduchá – Uber je v Abu Dhabi spolehlivý, dostupný a cenově rozumný, z centra města naprosto bez problému.
Velkou výhodou je i samotná lokalita. V bezprostředním okolí je krásná promenáda plná restaurací a kaváren a hned na stejné ulici se nachází velké zábavní centrum se spoustou atrakcí pro děti i dospělé. Pokud tedy plánujete program mimo samotné centrum Abu Dhabi, dá se zde bez problému strávit celý den – my jsme to tak měli, včetně oběda, procházky po promenádě a posezení v kavárnách.
Shrnuto:
moderní, špičkově udělané akvárium světové úrovně, které funguje nejen jako samostatná atrakce, ale i jako ideální základna pro celodenní program s rodinou. Jednoznačně doporučuji.

reviews.text:
The National Aquarium is the largest aquarium in the Middle East, located in the Al Qana development in Abu Dhabi. It is home to over 46,000 animals from more than 300 unique species across 10 themed zones, ranging from the UAE’s marine treasures to the frozen Arctic and the Red Sea Wreck.

Notable features include the region's longest underwater tunnel and a focus on marine conservation and education. Visitors can enjoy interactive experiences like glass-bottom boat tours, a glass bridge walk, and animal encounters with sharks, rays, and puffins. It stands as a major family attraction dedicated to exploring and preserving the marine environment.

Το Yas Marina Circuit είναι μια πίστα μηχανοκίνητου αθλητισμού μήκους 5.281 χιλιομέτρων που βρίσκεται στο νησί Yas, στο Άμπου Ντάμπι, Ηνωμένα Αραβικά Εμιράτα. Το σιρκουί σχεδιάστηκε από τον Hermann Tilke. Φιλοξενεί το Grand Prix της Formula 1 Abu Dhabi που τελειώνει τη σεζόν από το 2009.

Χωρητικότητα 60000
Αξεχαστη Κυριακη,
Αρχές Δεκεμβρίου 2025  με  άκρως   ενδιαφέροντες Επισκέπτες ιδανικοί για networking.

Η Φιλοξενία στο Mandarin Oriental Emirates Palace το ίδιο όπως πάντα Αξεχαστη.
Η καλύτερη πίστα Αγωγών F1, Ασφάλεια, Άνεση, στην πιο Όμορφη και ασφαλή πόλη του κόσμου
το Abu Dhabi 🇦🇪

ΗΛΙΑΣ ΜΠΑΡΤΖΗΣ
Athens 🇬🇷

reviews.text: Yas Marina Abu Dhabi felt like an amazing place to me. The atmosphere is very modern and lively, with incredible views of the marina and the Formula 1 circuit. I really liked the mix of restaurants, lights, and the waterfront setting; it’s perfect for walking around, having a meal, and enjoying the place, especially at night. It’s definitely an experience worth having.

reviews.text:
We were super excited to see the F1 final race of the season, especially when there were 3 drivers in the running; it made it all the more interesting! We had tickets for the South Grandstand, but our coach could only drop us off by the West Grandstand. You can only enter the tracks where your tickets are. So we walked what seems like miles in the midday heat to find our entrance.
Once we arrived, they scanned our tickets and our bags. No food and drink were allowed in. We had empty bottles in the bag and they threw that away! We were saving them to use at the water stations!

There were plenty of food choices available but they were the same in each grandstand area. We just got some food near our seats!

We had plenty of time before Quali to explore, but with the sheer amount of people, it took forever to get even from South to West Grandstand!

The Quali and the final race were amazing in such a beautiful track. The atmosphere was amazing with the fly past at the beginning and the brilliant fireworks display at the end!

The seats were cheap and uncomfortable to sit on for long hours! Plus the steps down to your seats were steep, so not good if you are afraid of heights!

Leaving the race on both days were carnage! We wanted to get a shuttle to Yas Mall afterwards, but it was impossible to get near a bus with soooooo many people pushing to get in. In the end we walked an hour to the Mall! On actual race day, there was no point considering a shuttle bus and getting a taxi was impossible! So we ended up walking 2 miles (2 hours) towards West Yas to get a taxi!

The race weekend was a phenomenal experience, but the logistics of getting out of the circuit was off putting.
reviews.author: Elisa Winstanley

reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with the customer service at Yas Marina.
I was unable to travel to Dubai due to unexpected immigration restrictions related to my passport, and I contacted Yas Marina well in advance to request a reschedule, refund, or even a simple gift voucher so I wouldn’t completely lose my money.
They refused every option and showed no flexibility or empathy, despite the situation being completely outside my control. Most reputable attractions offer at least a credit or alternative date when a guest cannot travel due to official entry restrictions, but Yas Marina chose not to help at all.
This experience has left me feeling frustrated and unheard.
I would strongly caution others to consider the lack of customer support before booking here, especially if you are travelling internationally and may face unexpected travel issues.

My first F1 experience at Yas was nothing short of incredible. I was there on Friday and Saturday, and watched almost all the events that took place.

Masters Historic Racing, Formula 4, Formula 2, Pirelli Hot Laps, then F1 events. There’s a lot to watch and it rewards you for getting there early.

I saw some reviews saying that they missed the race due to congestion, but I feel like that’s really their on responsibility to be timely and expect that kind of delay the closer you are to the main event. Just come early! There’s plenty to do.

I parked at Yas Mall and used the shuttles which were great, but, on the main race day the post-race walk to Yas Mall is not bad as long as you follow the clear signage and cut through Ferrari World (not the directions on your Maps Application). It was about 30-40 minutes, which is what you will end up waiting in line for an extremely packed shuttle anyway. This is honestly expected at an event of this scale, and all I felt was it was quite well organized for a scale of this size.

There was good food, staff were attentive and the atmosphere was breathtaking. I hope to have the opportunity to visit again one day.

reviews.text:
Отвратительная организация гран-при Абу-Даби 2025

Мы опоздали на финальную гонку на 20 минут по вине организаторов. Из отеля мы вышли за 3 часа до гонки.

Первые 1,5ч мы пытались пройти пешком по маршруту из специального приложения, но 3 ближайших к отелю гейта были закрыты и толпы людей сливались в один вход. Это было невозможно пройти и простоять по жаре, и мы пошли на автобус.

У нас был билет Sunset lounge, который предусматривает отдельный трансфер до трека на специальном автобусе от молла. От отеля на трансфер не сесть.

За 1,5ч до гонки автобусы перестали ездить и сформировалась огромная очередь (фото людей за нами прикреплено). С нами стояли в одних условиях даже люди из паддока. За 1,5ч приехало 2 автобуса. За !!!!!1,5ч!!!!!! 2 автобуса. Это ненормально. Нас забрал второй автобус и мы ехали по пробке, никакой отдельной выеденной полосы нет. Старт гонки мы смотрели из автобуса на телефоне, имея на руках билет. Очень дорогой билет. Это ужасно.

По другую сторону молла были автобусы для других типов билетов. Сотни людей стояли на самом пекле и аналогично ждали их.

Обычный билет на трибуну = отсутствие организации, закрытые гейты, ожидание автобусов на пекле.
Билет в ~10 раз дороже в лаунж = то же самое, только автобус ждут поменьше людей и в тени.

Билет повышенного класса предусматривает комфорт логистики, никакого комфорта не было.

Билеты по типу Sunset lounge на гп Абу-Даби однозначно не советую. Это покупка испорченных впечатлений. Оно того абсолютно не стоит.

Еще проблемы:
1)Логистика и без опоздания автобуса ужасна:

В стоимость билета не включена парковка на территории, хотя на карте эта она обозначена!!!!  На физической карте, которая стоит у въезда на территорию трека. Фото с доказательством прикреплено.

Билет повышенного класса ДОЛЖЕН включать парковку, либо должна быть возможность докупить место.

На территории есть огромное количество парковочных мест, но они простаивают пустыми.

Шаттлы не работают нормально в день гонки, люди опаздывают.

2)Волонтеры ничего не знают и только путают.

В первый день мы аналогично добирались 3 часа, потому что одни нам говорили одно, в билете написано второе, водитель автобуса говорит третье.

3)Пешие маршруты не продуманы. Люди идут вдоль забора по траве, песку и камням, потому что так быстрее.

4)Места внутри Лаунжа не продуманы. Необходимо приходить заранее и занимать место, чтобы видеть трассу и экран. Людям сзади при этом обзора не будет, либо он будет сильно хуже.

Это нормально для недорогих билетов, в билетах в несколько раз дороже это должно быть предусмотрено и продумано.

5)С экраном на балконе в лаунже каждый день были технические проблемы: как со звуком, так и с картинкой

reviews.text:
We were super excited to see the F1 final race of the season, especially when there were 3 drivers in the running; it made it all the more interesting! We had tickets for the South Grandstand, but our coach could only drop us off by the West Grandstand. You can only enter the tracks where your tickets are. So we walked what seems like miles in the midday heat to find our entrance.
Once we arrived, they scanned our tickets and our bags. No food and drink were allowed in. We had empty bottles in the bag and they threw that away! We were saving them to use at the water stations!

There were plenty of food choices available but they were the same in each grandstand area. We just got some food near our seats!

We had plenty of time before Quali to explore, but with the sheer amount of people, it took forever to get even from South to West Grandstand!

The Quali and the final race were amazing in such a beautiful track. The atmosphere was amazing with the fly past at the beginning and the brilliant fireworks display at the end!

The seats were cheap and uncomfortable to sit on for long hours! Plus the steps down to your seats were steep, so not good if you are afraid of heights!

Leaving the race on both days were carnage! We wanted to get a shuttle to Yas Mall afterwards, but it was impossible to get near a bus with soooooo many people pushing to get in. In the end we walked an hour to the Mall! On actual race day, there was no point considering a shuttle bus and getting a taxi was impossible! So we ended up walking 2 miles (2 hours) towards West Yas to get a taxi!

The race weekend was a phenomenal experience, but the logistics of getting out of the circuit was off putting.
reviews.author: Elisa Winstanley

reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with the customer service at Yas Marina.
I was unable to travel to Dubai due to unexpected immigration restrictions related to my passport, and I contacted Yas Marina well in advance to request a reschedule, refund, or even a simple gift voucher so I wouldn’t completely lose my money.
They refused every option and showed no flexibility or empathy, despite the situation being completely outside my control. Most reputable attractions offer at least a credit or alternative date when a guest cannot travel due to official entry restrictions, but Yas Marina chose not to help at all.
This experience has left me feeling frustrated and unheard.
I would strongly caution others to consider the lack of customer support before booking here, especially if you are travelling internationally and may face unexpected travel issues.

reviews.text:
My first F1 experience at Yas was nothing short of incredible. I was there on Friday and Saturday, and watched almost all the events that took place.

Masters Historic Racing, Formula 4, Formula 2, Pirelli Hot Laps, then F1 events. There’s a lot to watch and it rewards you for getting there early.

I saw some reviews saying that they missed the race due to congestion, but I feel like that’s really their on responsibility to be timely and expect that kind of delay the closer you are to the main event. Just come early! There’s plenty to do.

I parked at Yas Mall and used the shuttles which were great, but, on the main race day the post-race walk to Yas Mall is not bad as long as you follow the clear signage and cut through Ferrari World (not the directions on your Maps Application). It was about 30-40 minutes, which is what you will end up waiting in line for an extremely packed shuttle anyway. This is honestly expected at an event of this scale, and all I felt was it was quite well organized for a scale of this size.

There was good food, staff were attentive and the atmosphere was breathtaking. I hope to have the opportunity to visit again one day.

reviews.text:
Отвратительная организация гран-при Абу-Даби 2025

Мы опоздали на финальную гонку на 20 минут по вине организаторов. Из отеля мы вышли за 3 часа до гонки.

Первые 1,5ч мы пытались пройти пешком по маршруту из специального приложения, но 3 ближайших к отелю гейта были закрыты и толпы людей сливались в один вход. Это было невозможно пройти и простоять по жаре, и мы пошли на автобус.

У нас был билет Sunset lounge, который предусматривает отдельный трансфер до трека на специальном автобусе от молла. От отеля на трансфер не сесть.

За 1,5ч до гонки автобусы перестали ездить и сформировалась огромная очередь (фото людей за нами прикреплено). С нами стояли в одних условиях даже люди из паддока. За 1,5ч приехало 2 автобуса. За !!!!!1,5ч!!!!!! 2 автобуса. Это ненормально. Нас забрал второй автобус и мы ехали по пробке, никакой отдельной выеденной полосы нет. Старт гонки мы смотрели из автобуса на телефоне, имея на руках билет. Очень дорогой билет. Это ужасно.

По другую сторону молла были автобусы для других типов билетов. Сотни людей стояли на самом пекле и аналогично ждали их.

Обычный билет на трибуну = отсутствие организации, закрытые гейты, ожидание автобусов на пекле.
Билет в ~10 раз дороже в лаунж = то же самое, только автобус ждут поменьше людей и в тени.

Билет повышенного класса предусматривает комфорт логистики, никакого комфорта не было.

Билеты по типу Sunset lounge на гп Абу-Даби однозначно не советую. Это покупка испорченных впечатлений. Оно того абсолютно не стоит.

Еще проблемы:
1)Логистика и без опоздания автобуса ужасна:

В стоимость билета не включена парковка на территории, хотя на карте эта она обозначена!!!!  На физической карте, которая стоит у въезда на территорию трека. Фото с доказательством прикреплено.

Билет повышенного класса ДОЛЖЕН включать парковку, либо должна быть возможность докупить место.

На территории есть огромное количество парковочных мест, но они простаивают пустыми.

Шаттлы не работают нормально в день гонки, люди опаздывают.

2)Волонтеры ничего не знают и только путают.

В первый день мы аналогично добирались 3 часа, потому что одни нам говорили одно, в билете написано второе, водитель автобуса говорит третье.

3)Пешие маршруты не продуманы. Люди идут вдоль забора по траве, песку и камням, потому что так быстрее.

4)Места внутри Лаунжа не продуманы. Необходимо приходить заранее и занимать место, чтобы видеть трассу и экран. Людям сзади при этом обзора не будет, либо он будет сильно хуже.

Это нормально для недорогих билетов, в билетах в несколько раз дороже это должно быть предусмотрено и продумано.

5)С экраном на балконе в лаунже каждый день были технические проблемы: как со звуком, так и с картинкой

The Quali and the final race were amazing in such a beautiful track. The atmosphere was amazing with the fly past at the beginning and the brilliant fireworks display at the end!

The seats were cheap and uncomfortable to sit on for long hours! Plus the steps down to your seats were steep, so not good if you are afraid of heights!

Leaving the race on both days were carnage! We wanted to get a shuttle to Yas Mall afterwards, but it was impossible to get near a bus with soooooo many people pushing to get in. In the end we walked an hour to the Mall! On actual race day, there was no point considering a shuttle bus and getting a taxi was impossible! So we ended up walking 2 miles (2 hours) towards West Yas to get a taxi!

The race weekend was a phenomenal experience, but the logistics of getting out of the circuit was off putting.

reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with the customer service at Yas Marina.
I was unable to travel to Dubai due to unexpected immigration restrictions related to my passport, and I contacted Yas Marina well in advance to request a reschedule, refund, or even a simple gift voucher so I wouldn’t completely lose my money.
They refused every option and showed no flexibility or empathy, despite the situation being completely outside my control. Most reputable attractions offer at least a credit or alternative date when a guest cannot travel due to official entry restrictions, but Yas Marina chose not to help at all.
This experience has left me feeling frustrated and unheard.
I would strongly caution others to consider the lack of customer support before booking here, especially if you are travelling internationally and may face unexpected travel issues.

My first F1 experience at Yas was nothing short of incredible. I was there on Friday and Saturday, and watched almost all the events that took place.

Masters Historic Racing, Formula 4, Formula 2, Pirelli Hot Laps, then F1 events. There’s a lot to watch and it rewards you for getting there early.

I saw some reviews saying that they missed the race due to congestion, but I feel like that’s really their on responsibility to be timely and expect that kind of delay the closer you are to the main event. Just come early! There’s plenty to do.

I parked at Yas Mall and used the shuttles which were great, but, on the main race day the post-race walk to Yas Mall is not bad as long as you follow the clear signage and cut through Ferrari World (not the directions on your Maps Application). It was about 30-40 minutes, which is what you will end up waiting in line for an extremely packed shuttle anyway. This is honestly expected at an event of this scale, and all I felt was it was quite well organized for a scale of this size.

There was good food, staff were attentive and the atmosphere was breathtaking. I hope to have the opportunity to visit again one day.

reviews.text:
Отвратительная организация гран-при Абу-Даби 2025

Мы опоздали на финальную гонку на 20 минут по вине организаторов. Из отеля мы вышли за 3 часа до гонки.

Первые 1,5ч мы пытались пройти пешком по маршруту из специального приложения, но 3 ближайших к отелю гейта были закрыты и толпы людей сливались в один вход. Это было невозможно пройти и простоять по жаре, и мы пошли на автобус.

У нас был билет Sunset lounge, который предусматривает отдельный трансфер до трека на специальном автобусе от молла. От отеля на трансфер не сесть.

За 1,5ч до гонки автобусы перестали ездить и сформировалась огромная очередь (фото людей за нами прикреплено). С нами стояли в одних условиях даже люди из паддока. За 1,5ч приехало 2 автобуса. За !!!!!1,5ч!!!!!! 2 автобуса. Это ненормально. Нас забрал второй автобус и мы ехали по пробке, никакой отдельной выеденной полосы нет. Старт гонки мы смотрели из автобуса на телефоне, имея на руках билет. Очень дорогой билет. Это ужасно.

По другую сторону молла были автобусы для других типов билетов. Сотни людей стояли на самом пекле и аналогично ждали их.

Обычный билет на трибуну = отсутствие организации, закрытые гейты, ожидание автобусов на пекле.
Билет в ~10 раз дороже в лаунж = то же самое, только автобус ждут поменьше людей и в тени.

Билет повышенного класса предусматривает комфорт логистики, никакого комфорта не было.

Билеты по типу Sunset lounge на гп Абу-Даби однозначно не советую. Это покупка испорченных впечатлений. Оно того абсолютно не стоит.

Еще проблемы:
1)Логистика и без опоздания автобуса ужасна:

В стоимость билета не включена парковка на территории, хотя на карте эта она обозначена!!!!  На физической карте, которая стоит у въезда на территорию трека. Фото с доказательством прикреплено.

Билет повышенного класса ДОЛЖЕН включать парковку, либо должна быть возможность докупить место.

На территории есть огромное количество парковочных мест, но они простаивают пустыми.

Шаттлы не работают нормально в день гонки, люди опаздывают.

2)Волонтеры ничего не знают и только путают.

В первый день мы аналогично добирались 3 часа, потому что одни нам говорили одно, в билете написано второе, водитель автобуса говорит третье.

3)Пешие маршруты не продуманы. Люди идут вдоль забора по траве, песку и камням, потому что так быстрее.

4)Места внутри Лаунжа не продуманы. Необходимо приходить заранее и занимать место, чтобы видеть трассу и экран. Людям сзади при этом обзора не будет, либо он будет сильно хуже.

Это нормально для недорогих билетов, в билетах в несколько раз дороже это должно быть предусмотрено и продумано.

5)С экраном на балконе в лаунже каждый день были технические проблемы: как со звуком, так и с картинкой

reviews.text: Yas Waterworld Abu Dhabi is a large and thrilling water park located on Yas Island. It offers more than 40 rides and attractions, including adrenaline-pumping slides, wave pools, and a lazy river for relaxing. The park is inspired by Emirati culture and the legend of “The Lost Pearl,” which gives it a unique theme and design. Children can enjoy special play areas, while adults can try extreme rides or relax in cabanas and pools. Yas Waterworld also provides a variety of dining options, from snacks to full meals, as well as gift shops and facilities for a comfortable visit. It is an ideal destination for families, friends, and tourists looking for adventure, fun, and memorable experiences.

We had an amazing time at Yas Waterworld with our family. The park is full of adventurous and exciting rides that kept everyone entertained throughout the day. There are plenty of options for thrill-seekers as well as fun and safe rides for kids.

What we really appreciated is that the kids’ areas have proper age and height limits, which made the experience feel safe and well-organized. The atmosphere was lively, the rides were well maintained, and there was something enjoyable for every age group.

reviews.text:
We were extremely disappointed upon arriving at Waterworld to purchase tickets for ourselves and our family visiting from overseas. We had received an email confirming that a discount would be valid until a specific date, as clearly stated in the message. However, when we arrived, we were informed that the original dates had been changed and that the discount no longer applied. As a result, we were required to pay full price for our family of six.

Unfortunately, this meant the cost was more than double what we had planned for, and we had to inform our family that we could no longer go — despite everyone already being packed, dressed, and excited for the day. This experience was extremely upsetting and left us feeling very disappointed.

reviews.text: Yas Waterworld Abu Dhabi is a large and thrilling water park located on Yas Island. It offers more than 40 rides and attractions, including adrenaline-pumping slides, wave pools, and a lazy river for relaxing. The park is inspired by Emirati culture and the legend of “The Lost Pearl,” which gives it a unique theme and design. Children can enjoy special play areas, while adults can try extreme rides or relax in cabanas and pools. Yas Waterworld also provides a variety of dining options, from snacks to full meals, as well as gift shops and facilities for a comfortable visit. It is an ideal destination for families, friends, and tourists looking for adventure, fun, and memorable experiences.

reviews.text:
We were extremely disappointed upon arriving at Waterworld to purchase tickets for ourselves and our family visiting from overseas. We had received an email confirming that a discount would be valid until a specific date, as clearly stated in the message. However, when we arrived, we were informed that the original dates had been changed and that the discount no longer applied. As a result, we were required to pay full price for our family of six.

Unfortunately, this meant the cost was more than double what we had planned for, and we had to inform our family that we could no longer go — despite everyone already being packed, dressed, and excited for the day. This experience was extremely upsetting and left us feeling very disappointed.

We were extremely disappointed upon arriving at Waterworld to purchase tickets for ourselves and our family visiting from overseas. We had received an email confirming that a discount would be valid until a specific date, as clearly stated in the message. However, when we arrived, we were informed that the original dates had been changed and that the discount no longer applied. As a result, we were required to pay full price for our family of six.

Unfortunately, this meant the cost was more than double what we had planned for, and we had to inform our family that we could no longer go — despite everyone already being packed, dressed, and excited for the day. This experience was extremely upsetting and left us feeling very disappointed.

reviews.text: Yas Waterworld Abu Dhabi is a large and thrilling water park located on Yas Island. It offers more than 40 rides and attractions, including adrenaline-pumping slides, wave pools, and a lazy river for relaxing. The park is inspired by Emirati culture and the legend of “The Lost Pearl,” which gives it a unique theme and design. Children can enjoy special play areas, while adults can try extreme rides or relax in cabanas and pools. Yas Waterworld also provides a variety of dining options, from snacks to full meals, as well as gift shops and facilities for a comfortable visit. It is an ideal destination for families, friends, and tourists looking for adventure, fun, and memorable experiences.

ADNOC 2025 at Zayed Sports City – Exceptionally Well Organized

ADNOC 2025, organized at Zayed Sports City, was exceptionally well planned and executed. We truly enjoyed being part of the 5 km Family Fun Run, which was a wonderful experience for participants of all ages.

The parking arrangements were excellently managed at Wahat Al Karamah. We arrived early at around 4:15 AM, and the process was smooth and hassle-free. The shuttle service was well coordinated, allowing us to reach Zayed Sports City comfortably and on time.

Upon arrival, we were impressed by the wonderful crowd turnout and the high level of discipline and coordination maintained throughout the event. The atmosphere was energetic, positive, and family-friendly, making the entire experience even more enjoyable.

Overall, ADNOC 2025 stood out for its outstanding organization, efficient logistics, and vibrant community spirit. It was truly a memorable event, and we thoroughly enjoyed every moment of participating in the Family Fun Run. 👏🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️

reviews.text:
Al Fanar Restaurant & Cafe – Yas Mall was a really pleasant stop during our visit. The place has a traditional Emirati vibe, with old-school decor that makes it feel warm and welcoming rather than fancy.

The food was flavorful and filling, especially the local dishes. Portions were generous, and everything tasted fresh and well prepared. Service was friendly and fairly quick, even though the mall was busy.

It’s a nice spot to sit down, relax, and enjoy a proper meal after walking around Yas Mall. If you’re looking to try local cuisine in a comfortable, casual setting, this is definitely a good choice.

reviews.text:
Complaint against Mr Noufal working in Al Raiqa date fruit trading co. LLC
United Arab Emirates

Dear Al Raiqa date fruit trading co. LLC and Customer Service,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to formally express my dissatisfaction and disappointment with the service I received during my recent visit to your store.

On sunday 24th November 2024, I visited your shop to purchase dates and nuts. While shopping, I was unfortunately mistreated by an employee named Mr. Noufal. His behavior was unprofessional and disrespectful, which greatly affected my experience.
Mr Nofal was very rude  and arrogant and refused to assist, also he mentioned inappropriate comments to me as i asked him about the products displayed there. He is very unethical and gives poor customer service.

As a customer, I expect a certain level of courtesy and professionalism when shopping, especially at a reputable store like Al Raiqa. Mr. Noafel's actions have left me very dissatisfied with my visit.

I kindly request that you look into this matter and take appropriate action to ensure that such behavior does not occur in the future. I believe this will help maintain the high standards of customer service that your store is known for.

I look forward to your prompt response and a resolution to this issue or

If I do not receive a satisfactory resolution, I will be forced to escalate the issue to the relevant authorities, including the UAE's Baladiya (municipal authorities).

Please treat this matter with the urgency it deserves.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

An experience I highly recommend for all ages. Its a wonderful place to learn more about the universe we live in — from planets, comets, and stars to everything that surrounds Earth. It’s also ideal if you’re interested in purchasing customized equipment for capturing stunning images of space 🌌🔭.

reviews.text: A hidden gem in Abu Dhabi — quiet, open, and surrounded by the desert, which makes the experience even more magical. We loved the calm atmosphere as the sun started to set; the sky looked beautiful and it set the perfect mood for stargazing.The team is knowledgeable and passionate, and they explain everything in a way that’s easy to understand, even if you’re new to astronomy. You get to learn, observe, and really appreciate the universe in a deeper way. The telescope viewing is such a highlight — seeing the stars, planets, and the night sky up close feels unforgettable.It’s a great place for families, kids, or anyone who enjoys exploring something different in Abu Dhabi. The combination of science, nature, and calm desert surroundings makes it a truly special experience.
reviews.author: Shahida Alvarado
