reviews.text:
Sometimes the brightest impressions come completely unexpectedly. That’s how I found myself at Al Sadeem Observatory — a place where the stars suddenly feel closer and more real than ever before.

We arrived in the evening, and as the darkness turned into deep night, the sky seemed to open above us. Cool air, absolute silence, and the feeling that if you simply reached out your hand, you could touch the first star.

The astronomer who welcomed us has a rare gift for explaining complex things in a way that makes you listen, holding your breath. The children — who usually lose attention quickly — were completely captivated. They asked question after question, and he responded so gently and engagingly that we adults listened with the same sense of wonder.

Through the telescope, we saw the Moon with its craters, Saturn with its rings and tiny moons, and even a distant nebula, like a watercolor stain on velvet sky. Each object felt like a small miracle you can hardly believe in until you see it with your own eyes.

The Cosmic Cube made a huge impression as well — a space where you don’t analyze the cosmos with your mind, but feel it with your whole body. Light, sound, color — the kids felt like they were flying through galaxies, and I felt as if I was remembering something ancient and long forgotten.

We then visited the observatory’s main dome — a true “window into the cosmos.” We learned so much about modern telescopes, stars, and sky observations. And most importantly, we felt a rare mix of peace, curiosity, and awe — something that is so easy to lose in the city.

We left filled with gratitude — to the Al Sadeem Observatory team for their warmth, knowledge, and incredible patience. This place doesn’t just share information — it gives you the feeling of touching the Universe.

I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to give themselves and their children a genuine, living connection with space.

I visited the Al Sadeem Observatory last evening with a group of international colleagues. It was an extraordinary experience. Not only were the two staff scientists engaged, friendly and welcoming, but their enthusiasm for the work they do and for the wonders that their new technologies make available to all space enthusiasts, was relentlessly infectious. I can say, without fear of contradiction, that Surender Ponnalagar and his colleague (whose name unfortunately escapes me now -apologies!) were not only knowledgeable and obviously in love with learning and sharing more about the wonders of our universe. More than this, they helped guide both the human eye and mind towards a wider realization of the intangible nature of creation and our small but wondrous role in that enduring process. Actually seeing Saturn and its moons was a gift of unrelenting proportions.

I would encourage anyone and everyone to visit Al Sadeem....and bring your children. This delightful experience is meant for humans of any age as the experience of last evening demonstrated.

My son and I decided to visit Al Sadeem Observatory just to look at the stars through a telescope. To be honest, I don't know a lot about astronomy, and the main goal was just to show my child something new. But this evening exceeded all our expectations!

A huge thank you to our guide, Surender. You could really tell that he is passionate about his work. He explained everything so simply and engagingly that even I, someone far from science, was listening with my mouth wide open. There was no complicated jargon, just interesting facts and answers to any of our questions, even the most naive ones from my son. Surender was very patient and attentive to the children.

When we looked through the telescope and saw the rings of Saturn with our own eyes, it was pure amazement! Not in a picture, but for real. For my son, it was like real magic; he still tells everyone about it.

The atmosphere in the desert, away from the city lights, is magical in itself. We didn't just look at the sky; it felt like we took a short journey into space. We left with the feeling that we had touched something vast and wonderful. A huge thank you to the entire team and personally to Surender for this incredible experience! I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to spend a meaningful evening and make unforgettable memories.

We had an absolutely amazing experience at Al Sadeem Observatory!

From the warm welcome by Usama and his colleague Rajie, we instantly felt at home. They are a perfectly coordinated team – everything ran so smoothly, with preparations happening seamlessly in the background.

Usama is a truly passionate astronomer whose enthusiasm is contagious. His positive and engaging nature captivated everyone, and he was fantastic with the kids. We not only learned so much from him but also shared plenty of laughter – the perfect combination!

Before coming, I had some concerns after reading an older review mentioning bad road conditions. That review is clearly outdated – the roads and the route to the observatory are now in perfect condition, easy to drive, and Google Maps takes you there without any issues.

On site, you’ll find small giveaways as well as drinks and snacks.
The breathtaking space photography they share is pure art – it feels like glimpses from another world. Thanks to the Singularity App, we now have so many wonderful souvenir photos of galaxies and stars we photographed ourselves during the session. The Cosmic Cube is a one-of-a-kind experience, and seeing the Moon so close and detailed was an unforgettable, goosebump-worthy moment. The two hours flew by in what felt like minutes.

If you’re in Abu Dhabi (or like us in Dubai), don’t miss this experience – it’s simply magical! ✨

We spent an informative and beautiful evening at the Al Sadeem Observatory. Mohammed Usama, the resident astro- photographer and our tutor for the evening, took us on a cosmic journey through the lens of the observatory's many different telescopes.

Usama is highly knowledgeable and an even better presenter - his intro lecture was interactive!

The observatory has an arsenal of telescopes - from mirror based to the main dome covered research scope, through modern ones like vespera! We tried our hand at amateur astronomy using some of these.

We studie the cameras, lenses and filters that bring to life some of the exquisite photographs of space.

We ended the night with a cosmic cube experience which I'll best leave unexplained for visitors to experience for themselves.

At 300 AED per person, I think it a little bit on the pricier side but if you're a space geek / afficionado, I do recommend a visit. It's also a great way for kids to explore their interests in this field.

Thank you to the Al Sadeem Observatory team!

Tip: search for Al Sadeem Observatory main gate on Google Maps.

reviews.text:
I visited Anantara Santorini Abu Dhabi Retreat for a day pass experience priced at AED 800, with AED 400 redeemable on food and drinks. The ambiance was excellent, and the hotel’s Santorini-inspired design creates a truly serene and picturesque atmosphere. The infinity pool was stunning, and the service was top-notch—attentive and professional throughout.

However, the food didn’t meet my expectations, especially considering the premium pricing. For instance, the lobster roll was AED 195 but fell far short of what I’d expect for that price. Additionally, some items felt unnecessarily expensive—AED 100 for a glass of wine is hard to justify. While I understand this is a luxury destination, the food experience didn’t deliver the pleasure I anticipated.

That said, the hotel does an excellent job of creating a sense of disconnection from the outside world, and the adults-only policy adds to the tranquil vibe. It’s a wonderful spot to relax, but I hope to see improvements in the food quality to match the high standards of the property.

Would I visit again? Possibly, but I’d be cautious about the dining choices next time.

reviews.text:
Отдыхали в отеле Anantara Santorini с 29.11.25 по 04.12.25. Отель просто превосходный: недавно открылся, всего 22 номера в отеле, прекрасный сервис, вас сопровождает менеджер, очень красивые стильные номера, уединенное место на берегу моря. Нам сделали замену номера на более высокий уровень-без доплат, номер большой, с террасой и отдельным выходом к морю. В отеле отменная еда: завтрак включен - холодные закуски по системе шведский стол, горячий завтрак заказываешь по меню. Обедали, ужинали в ресторанах отеля, их два, еда превосходная, особенно на обед - рыба, курица, ягненок, все очень вкусно и огромные порции. Цена примерно 140-190 дирхамм. Иногда брали 1 блюдо на двоих, одному просто не съесть. Отдельное спасибо за сопровождение и внимание нашему менеджеру  Jasurbek, владеет английским, русским языками, очень внимательный, приятный.
We stayed at the Anantara Santorini from November 29, 2025, to December 4, 2025. The hotel is simply superb: newly opened, with only 22 rooms, excellent service, a dedicated manager, beautiful, stylish rooms, and a secluded location on the seashore. We were upgraded to a higher standard at no extra charge; the room is large, with a terrace and private access to the sea. The hotel food is excellent: breakfast is included—cold appetizers are served buffet-style, and hot breakfast is ordered à la carte. We had lunch and dinner at the hotel's two restaurants, and the food was excellent, especially lunch—fish, chicken, and lamb—everything was delicious and the portions were huge. Prices ranged from 140-190 dirhams. Sometimes we shared a dish; it was simply too much for one person to finish. Special thanks to our manager, Jasurbek, for his assistance and attention; he speaks English and Russian and is very attentive and pleasant.

reviews.text:
I visited Anantara Santorini Abu Dhabi Retreat for a day pass experience priced at AED 800, with AED 400 redeemable on food and drinks. The ambiance was excellent, and the hotel’s Santorini-inspired design creates a truly serene and picturesque atmosphere. The infinity pool was stunning, and the service was top-notch—attentive and professional throughout.

However, the food didn’t meet my expectations, especially considering the premium pricing. For instance, the lobster roll was AED 195 but fell far short of what I’d expect for that price. Additionally, some items felt unnecessarily expensive—AED 100 for a glass of wine is hard to justify. While I understand this is a luxury destination, the food experience didn’t deliver the pleasure I anticipated.

That said, the hotel does an excellent job of creating a sense of disconnection from the outside world, and the adults-only policy adds to the tranquil vibe. It’s a wonderful spot to relax, but I hope to see improvements in the food quality to match the high standards of the property.

Would I visit again? Possibly, but I’d be cautious about the dining choices next time.

“you can’t be here, leave, we are not open”.
When I explained that both Hilton and their own staff said it’s fine, he said he doesn’t care. I told him in a kind way that
“could you please discuss with Hilton staff and your own staff about timings, since many people told me I can come here”
He said “I don’t care about Hilton, we are not part of Hilton, i don’t talk to anyone, get out”

Really disappointing experience and very unprofessional. If he would be nice and tell me in a kind way to come back in 15min, it would be ok! His attitude was terrible, I believe he was some kind of manager in Cafe Del Mar Beach Club.

reviews.text:
I want to share my honest feedback about the workshop. The wheel-throwing instructor was incredibly sweet, patient, and truly helpful. She taught us really well, and I appreciated her effort with everyone. The only challenge was that she was alone with a group of six, so it became difficult for her to support all of us at the same time. Maybe having an additional instructor for bigger groups would make the experience even smoother.

For the coloring part, the ladies were helpful, but since it was my first time, I think a clearer explanation of all the painting rules before starting would really help beginners. For example, I only learned later that the sponge can be used to erase mistakes, and not everyone was told about the coating step. A short briefing before we begin would prevent small mistakes and make the process easier for everyone.

Overall, it was a lovely experience, and everyone was kind. My only suggestion is to have more staff available during busy sessions and to give a quick full rundown of the painting rules at the start to help first-timers feel more confident.

Google Review

Studio Clay is a chic and lovely place to visit if you enjoy pottery painting. While the selection is somewhat limited—mostly mugs and plates in specific sizes—the atmosphere is fantastic. The staff are incredibly talented, and I’m excited about the opportunity to custom-make designs and paint them later.

Pottery painting times are limited, but the team has been incredibly flexible with me, which I deeply appreciate. The owner’s personal touch, like cooking lunch for the staff, adds a warm sense of integrity to the environment.

If you’re looking to expand your pottery skills, especially with throwing, this is a fantastic place to start. My only suggestion would be to offer a wider collection of pottery pieces so guests can build a more diverse collection. Overall, it’s a wonderful spot that I highly recommend!

reviews.text:
A Masterpiece of an Experience!
I recently had the pleasure of visiting  Studio Clay and I must say, it was nothing short of incredible. From the moment I stepped in, I was enveloped in a cool ambiance that was both inspiring and calming. The studio itself is a testament to the beauty of clay pottery, with its earthy tones and rustic charm.
The staff were the cherry on top of this delightful experience. They were not just friendly, but also incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about their craft. They guided me through the process with such patience and enthusiasm that I couldn't help but be swept up in their love for pottery.
The hands-on experience of molding the clay, the anticipation of waiting for it to take shape in the kiln, and the joy of seeing the final product was truly magical. It was not just an activity, but a journey into the heart of creativity.
I left the studio feeling enriched and inspired, carrying with me a beautiful piece of pottery and a heart full of wonderful memories. I highly recommend this studio to anyone looking for an immersive and rewarding experience. It's not just about making pottery, it's about creating art and memories that will last a lifetime."

reviews.text:
A Wonderful Pottery Shopping Experience
I recently visited a pottery shop in my area, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.
The shop itself was beautifully designed, with a wide variety of pottery pieces on display. The selection was impressive, ranging from functional kitchenware to stunning decorative pieces. It was clear that a lot of thought and care went into curating the collection.
The staff at the pottery shop were knowledgeable and passionate about their craft. They were more than happy to answer any questions I had and provide recommendations based on my preferences. Their expertise made my experience enjoyable and informative.
The quality of the pottery pieces was exceptional. Each piece was meticulously crafted, showcasing the skill and artistry of the artisans. I was particularly impressed with the attention to detail and the unique designs available. It was evident that a lot of care went into creating each piece.
Not only was the pottery beautiful, but the prices were also reasonable. I felt that I was getting great value for the quality and craftsmanship of the pieces. It's rare to find such high-quality pottery at such affordable prices.
Overall, my visit to the pottery shop was a delight. The combination of a welcoming atmosphere, knowledgeable staff, and exquisite pottery made it a memorable experience. I highly recommend visiting this pottery shop for anyone looking to add some beauty and artistry to their home.
I will definitely be returning to this pottery shop in the future. Thank you for providing such a positive and enjoyable training experience!

reviews.text: Had just an amazing artistic/creation afternoon! 👩🏻‍🎨 So, my experience at Studio Clay was reallyyy cool! From the moment I walked in, the staff greeted me warmly and made me feel excited to start. Creating pottery with my favorite theme, Mario/Nintendo, was an absolute blast. 🤩 The instructors were super knowledgeable and guided me through each steps. I was able to create anything I wanted! I've decided for a first time to make some mugs. ☕ The studio had all the tools and materials I needed, all was very nice, good organisation, and very nice group in which I've met people all very friendly and enthusiastic in learning pottery; such a good vibes! Overall, Studio Clay is definitely a place I highly recommend for a fun and inspiring pottery experience! Once we finished our création, we've had to wait around 3 weeks so they can finalise the creations. Once ready, I've opted for the delivery service. Very satisfying. It was so quick, on the next day I received my 2 cups created, nicely wrapped and secured. I was so happy to discover my Mario cups. Tried them with a warm tea/coffee and it was great mugs in of good quality. I'd also advise for the booking process that it's great to go ahead and book in advance coz it's quite full. But definitely worth it! 😁🎨✨

love love LOVE Studio Clay.
Its a cozy place thats full of amazing creativite surprises. You can enjoy workshops on clay handbuilding, use the wheel or even make candles.

Try it out you will be glad you did; just make sure you wear clothes you dont mind having it slightly dirtied up.

I want to share my honest feedback about the workshop. The wheel-throwing instructor was incredibly sweet, patient, and truly helpful. She taught us really well, and I appreciated her effort with everyone. The only challenge was that she was alone with a group of six, so it became difficult for her to support all of us at the same time. Maybe having an additional instructor for bigger groups would make the experience even smoother.

For the coloring part, the ladies were helpful, but since it was my first time, I think a clearer explanation of all the painting rules before starting would really help beginners. For example, I only learned later that the sponge can be used to erase mistakes, and not everyone was told about the coating step. A short briefing before we begin would prevent small mistakes and make the process easier for everyone.

Overall, it was a lovely experience, and everyone was kind. My only suggestion is to have more staff available during busy sessions and to give a quick full rundown of the painting rules at the start to help first-timers feel more confident.

Studio Clay is a chic and lovely place to visit if you enjoy pottery painting. While the selection is somewhat limited—mostly mugs and plates in specific sizes—the atmosphere is fantastic. The staff are incredibly talented, and I’m excited about the opportunity to custom-make designs and paint them later.

Pottery painting times are limited, but the team has been incredibly flexible with me, which I deeply appreciate. The owner’s personal touch, like cooking lunch for the staff, adds a warm sense of integrity to the environment.

If you’re looking to expand your pottery skills, especially with throwing, this is a fantastic place to start. My only suggestion would be to offer a wider collection of pottery pieces so guests can build a more diverse collection. Overall, it’s a wonderful spot that I highly recommend!

reviews.text: I’ve had the privilege of calling this wonderful studio “my peace place” for the past decade. I’ve attended more than 8-10 workshops and I’ll still attend every workshop they do!!! reviews.text: My son had the best summer camp experience here. I mean, adults would like to do what they were enjoying there every day !:) biggest thank you to Kimo and Anar, for all the care, guidance and happy memories.

reviews.text:
I enrolled my children in this summer camp for a trial day, hoping for a high-quality experience given the venue. Unfortunately, it did not meet expectations, especially considering the premium pricing and the reputation of Emirates Palace.

From the moment we arrived, the environment felt disorganized. I was not informed in advance about my children’s group color assignments, which caused unnecessary confusion. The reception staff were not welcoming—there were no smiles or guidance—and my 6-year-old daughter’s bag was taken without any explanation about where she should go or what to expect.

Communication was also lacking throughout the day. I only received three photos of my children after repeatedly following up via WhatsApp. Additionally, my son’s shoes went missing, and the staff were unable to locate them.

Having experienced several other summer camps across the UAE, I believe this program would greatly benefit from benchmarking against others in terms of organization, staff training, and child supervision. At this time, I did not feel that my children were in safe or attentive hands.

I hope this feedback will help improve the experience for other families in the future.

Kids Palace is an absolute gem for families! The facilities are thoughtfully designed to cater children of different ages, ensuring that every age group has a safe and engaging space to explore and have fun. From soft play areas for the little ones to exciting activities for older kids, there’s something for everyone. The colors chosen and different areas throughout the different rooms make this space one of a kind in Abu Dhabi.

What truly sets Kids Palace apart is their incredible staff—caring, friendly, and always attentive to the children’s needs. They go above and beyond to create a warm and welcoming environment, making both kids and parents feel at ease. The cleanliness and safety measures are also top-notch, which is a huge plus for any parent.

If you're looking for a place where your child can play, learn, and have a fantastic time while being well cared for, Kids Palace is the perfect choice! The options to host birthdays and family celebrations are also unique where you can feel at home with a 5-star service and proudly host your friends and guests. Highly recommend!

reviews.text:
My experience at Episodes was abysmal, and incredibly disappointing compared to what one would expect at a Mandarin Oriental property.

I went to the gelato stand at Episodes, hoping to get some of their special flavors. As the server was attending to another guest, I patiently waited for my turn. However, after attending to that guest, she went to the cashier to attend to other guests instead, leaving me unattended.

I waited there for 10 minutes, and observed at least 6 employees who saw me waiting but conveniently ignored me (they didn’t look like they were busy with anything else). In the end, I just walked away.

If it’s just one server, perhaps it’s an anomaly. But if so many of them have no interest in serving their guests, it reflects the poor service standards of the hotel. Shame on you, Mandarin Oriental.

Tried the afternoon high tea at Episodes at Emirates Palace, and it was such a luxurious experience. The spread was beautifully presented and delicious. Honestly, it might have been a little too much for one person, but that is definitely not a complaint, more like a happy problem to have 😆

I had a nice chat with Alice, and learned that they offer different themed afternoon teas throughout the year. This time, I got to enjoy their festive set and the flavours, presentation and little seasonal touches made it feel extra cosy.

The service was another highlight. The staff were warm, attentive... made the whole visit feel elevated.

I was feeling a bit too full at one point, and Alice recommended their Ginger Breeze tea to help with digestion and it worked like a charm. Thoughtful touches like that really made the experience memorable.

Overall, a lovely high tea in a stunning setting, comforting and definitely worth experiencing 😊

We came specifically to visit the café inside, and the staff were incredibly kind in explaining that parking is free — they took our car for valet service, and we just had to show the receipt from the café afterward.

The main goal? To enjoy a gold cappuccino for breakfast — just your average morning routine in Abu Dhabi! :)

The staff were charming and gracious, and along with the coffee, they served us the most delicious dates. As someone who appreciates fine tea sets, I was especially delighted by the elegant cups they used.

The overall atmosphere was welcoming and warm — I truly felt like a princess! I absolutely recommend stopping by if you’re in Abu Dhabi. It’s a memorable and unique experience that’s worth every sip.

5 stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We visited Episodes at Emirates Palace for Saturday high tea and had a beautiful experience. The décor is stunning—floral installations, golden details, and soft lighting create a peaceful, luxurious atmosphere.

Our waiter from Indonesia was incredibly warm and attentive, and the food was both beautifully presented and delicious. The savoury bites were creative and elegant, and the sweet treats were just as indulgent. The tea selection is extensive, but the star of the show was the golden cappuccino—smooth, rich, and topped with edible gold.

We recommend booking at least two days in advance with pre-payment to secure your spot. It’s a magical experience—perfect for families, special occasions, or anyone needing a golden pause in their week.

We enjoyed a Gold Cappuccino at Episode, and it was worth every single penny — truly a majestic experience! After all, we were in a palace, and the quality and ambiance lived up to every expectation.

The staff were bubbly, friendly, and respectful, adding a wonderful personal touch to our visit. Their warm hospitality made the experience even more memorable.

reviews.text:
Fantastic place, which is five stars but first constructive criticism.

My experience at Episodes began on the wrong note. The hotel lobby sat us in the reserved section. We weren’t approached by any of the waiters in that section. After waiting for a while, I got up and enquired, only to be flatly told we had to move to another section to place an order.

My main issue is that no one approached us. I had to get up and ask, which really shouldn’t have been the case.

When we finally got to the right section, Kathy the waitress was incredible. She had great knowledge and a brilliant sense of humour. She completely turned what started as a bad experience into a five-star one. Pradeep was also great (here and elsewhere).

The cocktails and sweets were also great.

Highly recommended, although make sure you go to the right section (the person stood behind the host stand, furthest from the lobby).

reviews.text:
Nothing like before…

Episodes at EP is not just a coffee shop – the food menu is extensive and well thought-out!
A bit pricey, could be worth it but only if the quality of the service is excellent like used to be! Since the EP changed name and management to the Mandarin oriental, unfortunately nothing is like before!😔
Starting with a plastic pinkish flowers all around, entering in shorts and flip flops etc. but the biggest disappointment of all is at Episodes, where the SERVING  of the famous and costly (90dhs pp) 23K gold cappuccino is nothing like used to be! Fortunately, the taste is still the same!👍
Instead of elegant silver tray service, branded fine cotton napkins and well-arranged porcelain mugs with additional touches like dates, chocolates, macarons and refined floral elements, hinting at luxurious attention to details…nowadays you will experience less meticulous presentation, with casual plastic coasters and mismatched plates, paper tissues and lack of cohesive arrangement which detract from the overall premium experience.

The transition reflects a decline in attention to fine details and an overall loss of the polished elegance that once defined this cafe’!
Although, ultimately it’s all subjective!

The photos show the difference in service and presentation at Episodes café before and after the change in management.

P.S. Anyhow, I’ve spoken to the manager and he agreed that some improvements would be necessary!

reviews.text:
Maybe I’m nostalgic, but I remember coming here as a child and have beautiful memories when it was the Officers club. I love how they kept the original building but updated the rooms and kept a modern Emirati feel to it. One of the very few hotels to actually understand and incorporate Emirati culture and tradition well.

I’ve been here many times with kids and without. My kids love the pool and beach during summer and it’s accessible by car to the rest of Abu Dhabi, Saadiyat and Yas.
The rooms are small but well appointed, service is exceptional and goes above and beyond. The bathrooms have started showing some wear and tear over the years, especially in the smaller rooms but the suites are still alright.

This is an old building in the shape of a crescent, so the 2 lifts are in the centre of the crescent and there are none on the ends.
Some rooms are on the ground level and it gets noisy from people (kids) passing outside. Avoid ground level rooms and any rooms far from the lifts.

My only issue here is the breakfast area. Breakfast is always in Al Rimal, which is located in another building and is such a hassle to walk to, that it gets annoying especially if you’re on the top floor away from the lifts. I don’t understand why the breakfast can’t be in the same hotel building instead of the cafe on the ground level or in the restaurant facing the beach. Other than that the breakfast buffet food is always plentiful with amazing Emirati dishes as well as international options. Try the Chammi with plum or dates.
reviews.author: M. Al N.

reviews.text:
I have not even checked in yet, but I already feel compelled to share this experience. Thank you sincerely for taking care of all my requests and for the genuine kindness shown so far.

A special thank you to Mr. Abdelrahman at the front desk. From the very first interaction, he gave me a reassuring and welcoming impression. His professionalism, calm attitude, and warm manners immediately made me feel that everything is in good hands.

I am genuinely optimistic about my stay, and that is entirely thanks to this positive first impression.

reviews.text:
Нам, выбравшим отель для отдыха возле моря и расслабления, неоднократно мешало поведение гостей сборной спортсменов Эмиратов. Не очень приятно выйти в ресторан на ужин в вечернем платье, когда возле тебя сидят громкие люди в спортивных одеждах и тапочках.
Хотелось бы видеть падобающих пятизвёздочному отелю гостей!
Живая романтическая музыка за ужином и бар, где можно посидеть после ужина с коктейлем тоже не помешают отелю.
Особенно хочется отметить единственного профессионально обслуживающего работника ресторана , невероятно приветливого человека по имени Baher!
Действительно профессионал в своём деле в стрессовых ситуациях!
Его знание разных языков помогло многим гостям отеля, которые каждый день выражали ему свою благодарность!
В целом кухня отеля была на высшем уровне,  особенно в выходной день
Воскресенье, в которое мы попробовали не только вкуснейшие блюда, а также десерты на уровне "мишелин".
Фотографии этого вечера уже давно курсируют в инстаграмме с большим успехом)).
Номера не отличаются особенным изыском, звукоизоляция желает лучшего. Функция минибара как холодильника   отсутствует!
Пляж спокойный, места есть всегда.
Но возле бассейна так же мешали гости, приехавшие отмечать детские дни рождения.
Территория отеля очень большая, для таких мероприятий всегда найдётся место в другом углу.
Ходить в купальнике между людей в нарядных платьях- обсолютно не продуманный вариант менеджеров отеля!
Не плохой отель, недостатки которого можно при желании легко устранить.

reviews.text:
I booked this experience to celebrate my friend’s birthday. I’ve tried the dining in the dark concept before and absolutely loved it. The idea of eating without seeing your food and relying on all your senses is truly special… but unfortunately, this visit was the complete opposite.

When we entered, there was a large group of mixed nationalities, a big crowd acting like they owned the place. They were extremely loud—laughing, shouting, and creating nonstop noise.
This experience requires focus, presence, and silence so you can actually taste, sense, and guess the ingredients… but we couldn’t even hear each other from how loud it was.

We politely asked them to lower their voices, but they completely ignored us. The worst part is that the staff did absolutely nothing. They didn’t try to calm the group down or manage the situation at all. Even when I told them we would leave if nothing changed, they still didn’t take any action.

Honestly, it was a very disappointing experience. I wouldn’t recommend anyone to book unless you know exactly how many people will be in the room with you, because clearly their priority now is packing the place and making money, not ensuring the real experience or guests’ comfort.

Definitely not going back like this.

reviews.text:
We had an unforgettable experience at Fresh Basil’s Dine in the Dark!

From the very beginning, our host Agung took such great care of us, especially of our daughter. He thoughtfully prepared coloring materials for her and even arranged a babysitter in case she felt uncomfortable in the dark. That level of attention truly made us feel at ease.

We started with a refreshing summer drink and delicious canapés. The canapés were our absolute favorite and set such a wonderful first impression.

Agung then guided us into the dark dining room with so much ease. We were lucky to be the only ones dining at that time, which turned the evening into a private and intimate experience.

The dishes prepared by Chef Naheed were nothing short of amazing. Every course felt like we were part of a blind-tasting competition from Culinary Wars- an exciting adventure for our senses! Our daughter enjoyed it most of all, and we’re so proud she was brave enough to dine in complete darkness.

A special highlight was the thoughtful surprise: a cake and an anniversary banner for our 8th wedding anniversary. It truly made the evening extra memorable.

Overall, the service, food, and experience were excellent. We highly recommend Fresh Basil Dine in the Dark for anyone looking for a unique and unforgettable dining adventure.

The food was extremely delicious — perfectly balanced, full of flavor, and crafted with creativity. Each course surprised us with bold taste combinations and a beautiful harmony of spices and freshness. It was more than just a meal, it was an experience that engaged all the senses.

The atmosphere was intimate and exciting, and the staff made the whole journey smooth, fun, and comfortable. If you’re looking for something different, memorable, and delicious, I highly recommend trying Dining in the Dark at Fresh Basil. It’s an adventure worth taking!

We have dined on the dark before, but this experience was unmatched... positively incomparable!  Mr. Joel and his team, Meggie and Chef Bassant, handled everything eloquently, efficiently, and professionally from start to finish!  It was a dynamic, delectable dining experience, but Mr. Joel made it absolutely exquisite!

My 76-year-young Mom was visiting us to celebrate being cancer-free (alhumdulilah) for 11 years.  We informed the Fresh Basil team, and Mr. Joel and his team went above and beyond to celebrate her.

Before dinner, as our food was being prepared, we enjoyed a beverage and live music in the ground-level lounge.

Afterward, Mr. Joel led us to the Fresh Basil restaurant to a dimly-lit pre-dinner room where we enjoyed a delicious assortment of canapes prepared over burning sage coupled with a refreshing mocktail.  Mr. Joel thoroughly explained the dining in the dark concept.  After we secured our phones in the provided lock boxes, we were escorted to and seated one by one in the pitch-black dining room.  Then the palate phenomenon began!

We savored three courses of divine delight.  It was interesting and entertaining to discuss what we thought each dish was as we ate.

Afterward, Mr. Joel and his team surprised Mom with a cake that said "I am a survivor"!  How thoughtful and kind!  Our meal was then revealed to us, which was great.  We got a chance to see if our guesses were right; if our palates had fed us the right information.

This experience is one-of-a-kind!  I am grateful to have found a Groupon for it.  Otherwise,  I would not have known Fresh Basil AD existed.  BTW, all food allergies and dislikes are submitted before the dining experience, and the talented Chef Basant makes your meal according to your requests.

I am even more grateful for Mr. Joel and his dynamic team!  Mr. Joel truly uplifted my Mom and us!  Everything he did to make us feel welcomed and ensure we enjoyed every moment of our experience was noticed and is appreciated!  It's rare to meet anyone as genuine, altruistic, kindhearted, sincere, and professional as Mr. Joel; we are glad and fortunate we did!  We will be forever thankful to Mr. Joel and his team and will always remember our delicious Dinner in the Dark @ Fresh Basil AD!

reviews.text:
Dining in the Dark at @babalqasrhotel , is an absolutely surreal experience like none other. The essence of the concept of canceling out one of our key senses, Sight, to invoke our other senses, is really something one must try.

When we arrived at the restaurant, we were greeted by friendly staff who explained the entire concept of the Pitch Dark Dining.

During the briefing by Joel, we were served canapés with burnt rosemary at the bottom of the plate so as it invoke our body’s sensory receptors. Mr.Joel, who wore infrared night vision goggles and also our host for the night, patiently described every aspect of what we would be experiencing once we enter the pitch dark room and having a 3 course dinner meal.

He then led us to our table in the pitch dark room personally with our hands on his shoulders. Once we were seated he brought us our starters followed by the main course and then last but not the least, dessert.

Once we were done with our 3 course, Mr.Joel again escorted us out of the dark room, first into a room with very little light so our eyes can get adjusted before going into the light. Once we were outside in the briefing area of the restaurant, it was time for the big reveal by the chef of what we were served.

The experience of not being able to see the food that is served before you and just using your olfactory senses and gustatory senses to guess the taste, texture, ingredients and if possible the dish itself, is one of its kind.
I highly recommend this entire experience to all of you.
Indeed it’s a MUST-TRY.

reviews.text:
I'm not a Food Blogger nor a Restaurant Critic, however I want to share with you my experience with the new concept of "Dining in the Dark" at Bab Al Qasr Hotel - Abu Dhabi.
We were invited, my beautiful wife and I, by the one and only Elias Saad to a pre-launch dinner at the new restaurant "Fresh Basil - Pitch Black Dining" located in the five star hotel.
"Dining in the Dark"! a brand new concept in Abu Dhabi and the first of its kind in the city. A breath-taking whole experience that made us wonder what we loved the most, the luxurious location, the delicious food, the friendly service or the extraordinary Dark Room. It is indeed an amazing must try new experience, that I highly recommend.
Why am I so impressed? Well, being blindly seated by the waiter, served food that you can only smell and taste, wondering what the creative chef prepared for you is the answer.
When it comes to the socializing part, you find yourself sharing thoughts and ideas about the food with 15 other person in the dark room, without knowing to whom you are talking to. Electronic devices are not allowed!!!! Just chatting with each others! It's madness! It's an exciting weird yet fun experience to be lived with your friends and loved ones.
Kudos to Elias Saad and his amazing team!

reviews.text:
In my opinion, the place is overall a fun experience. I get anxiety at times and it was odd being in pitch black for an hour

No cameras.. no lights ... but plenty of action!

The food itself is awesome, true fine dining quality, but the real reason to visit is the unique experience which is like nothing I have done before and was one of those things that I would recommend anyone adding to your bucket list.

reviews.text: Amazing experience in dining in the dark it’s something very unique in my experience everyone should experience it
reviews.author: hind ouldelkarda

reviews.text:
I booked this experience to celebrate my friend’s birthday. I’ve tried the dining in the dark concept before and absolutely loved it. The idea of eating without seeing your food and relying on all your senses is truly special… but unfortunately, this visit was the complete opposite.

When we entered, there was a large group of mixed nationalities, a big crowd acting like they owned the place. They were extremely loud—laughing, shouting, and creating nonstop noise.
This experience requires focus, presence, and silence so you can actually taste, sense, and guess the ingredients… but we couldn’t even hear each other from how loud it was.

We politely asked them to lower their voices, but they completely ignored us. The worst part is that the staff did absolutely nothing. They didn’t try to calm the group down or manage the situation at all. Even when I told them we would leave if nothing changed, they still didn’t take any action.

Honestly, it was a very disappointing experience. I wouldn’t recommend anyone to book unless you know exactly how many people will be in the room with you, because clearly their priority now is packing the place and making money, not ensuring the real experience or guests’ comfort.

Definitely not going back like this.
reviews.author: Sabeeka Al Hameli

reviews.text:
We had an unforgettable experience at Fresh Basil’s Dine in the Dark!

From the very beginning, our host Agung took such great care of us, especially of our daughter. He thoughtfully prepared coloring materials for her and even arranged a babysitter in case she felt uncomfortable in the dark. That level of attention truly made us feel at ease.

We started with a refreshing summer drink and delicious canapés. The canapés were our absolute favorite and set such a wonderful first impression.

Agung then guided us into the dark dining room with so much ease. We were lucky to be the only ones dining at that time, which turned the evening into a private and intimate experience.

The dishes prepared by Chef Naheed were nothing short of amazing. Every course felt like we were part of a blind-tasting competition from Culinary Wars- an exciting adventure for our senses! Our daughter enjoyed it most of all, and we’re so proud she was brave enough to dine in complete darkness.

A special highlight was the thoughtful surprise: a cake and an anniversary banner for our 8th wedding anniversary. It truly made the evening extra memorable.

Overall, the service, food, and experience were excellent. We highly recommend Fresh Basil Dine in the Dark for anyone looking for a unique and unforgettable dining adventure.
reviews.author: LA

reviews.text:
Dining at Fresh Basil Restaurant for their Dining in the Dark experience was truly unforgettable. The concept itself is unique, and it completely transforms the way you enjoy food. Without relying on sight, every bite becomes more intense, allowing you to fully appreciate the rich flavors and amazing textures of each dish.

The food was extremely delicious — perfectly balanced, full of flavor, and crafted with creativity. Each course surprised us with bold taste combinations and a beautiful harmony of spices and freshness. It was more than just a meal, it was an experience that engaged all the senses.

The atmosphere was intimate and exciting, and the staff made the whole journey smooth, fun, and comfortable. If you’re looking for something different, memorable, and delicious, I highly recommend trying Dining in the Dark at Fresh Basil. It’s an adventure worth taking!
reviews.author: Laura White

reviews.text: Dining in the Dark is a must! Mr. Joel and Agung were spectacular and made our night extra special from start to finish. The food was beyond delicious by Chef Mervin. 10/10 experience from the gourmet food, to the personalized service for our anniversary!

Meggie was an excellent guide throughout, warm, calm, and attentive without being intrusive. He made navigating the experience smooth and comfortable.

A big thank you to both Meggie and Mervin for the special touches to celebrate my birthday. It felt personal and genuinely appreciated. Highly recommended for anyone looking for something different.

The service, unfortunately, was very poor. My partner has an allergy to seafood, and we wanted to order the dragon menu to try different dishes. However, we asked if the dishes could be replaced with vegetarian options so she could try them. reviews.text:
Our recent dinner at Hakkasan Abu Dhabi was, unfortunately, one of the most disappointing fine-dining experiences we have had anywhere in the world. We were a party of four, including two out-of-town guests we wanted to impress, and the evening fell far below the standards expected of a restaurant that proudly advertises a Michelin star.

From the beginning, the greeting was perfunctory and lacked any warmth. Our request for an outdoor table was declined due to a “private party,” yet we later saw multiple empty tables outside and guests being seated who clearly were not part of any large group. This immediately raised questions about the quality of service to come.

But the real shock came upon entering the dining room: Since when does a fine Chinese restaurant play thumping disco-style music? The background noise was so loud that we could not hold a normal conversation with our guests. Even after requesting the volume be lowered, nothing changed. This alone ruined any sense of atmosphere or refinement.

Service throughout the evening was equally disappointing. Our server seemed rushed and overwhelmed, offering no sense of attentiveness or hospitality. At one point, we waited nearly 15 minutes with empty plates on the table before anyone cleared them, and when someone finally came, there was no apology whatsoever. With the supposedly high caliber that Hakkasan claims, the service felt sub-par at best—no friendly greetings, no effort to engage, nothing beyond perfunctory “fast restaurant” interactions.

The food, sadly, did not redeem the evening. The dim sum and Peking duck were dry and surprisingly tasteless, far below expectations for a premium Chinese restaurant. We had ordered a pre-arranged set menu for the table, but the courses were rushed out so quickly that we had no time to enjoy them properly. Dish after dish appeared before we could finish the previous one, creating a hurried, uncomfortable pace that is the opposite of fine dining.

We left wondering how this Hakkasan location ever achieved a Michelin star. Between the loud nightclub-style music, inattentive service, lack of hospitality, and mediocre food, the entire experience was frankly embarrassing—especially with guests in town.

We will never return, and we cannot recommend this establishment to anyone seeking a genuine fine dining experience in Abu Dhabi.

reviews.author: S Mieke

reviews.text:
Voor mijn verjaardag hadden we bij Hakkasan gereserveerd. Mooie setting, perfecte tafel, supervriendelijke bediening, het soort start waarbij je denkt: dit wordt een topavond.
Gezellig was het, absoluut. We kozen voor het degustatiemenu, want in een sterrenzaak is dat normaal de veilige keuze: achteroverleunen en je laten verrassen. Wel, verrast waren we:

Om te beginnen: geen hapjes. Helemaal niets. In een sterrenrestaurant. Vreemd, toch? Je verwacht toch minstens één klein welkomsthapje dat fluistert: “Welkom, we kunnen koken.”

Dan de opbouw van het menu: alle voorgerechten tegelijk, alle hoofdgerechten tegelijk. Echt niet leuk om alles op een hoop te krijgen — je wilt juist een avondvullend menu beleven, rustig opbouwen en genieten. Bovendien: veel te veel. We hebben heel wat onaangeroerd laten staan. Het leek soms wel op een chinees om de hoek, maar daar neem je de overschot dan wel mee naar huis.

En eerlijk? Geen enkel gerecht was echt top. Veel te veel gefrituurd, weinig finesse.

Voor een zaak met naam, faam én een stevig prijskaartje was dit een zware teleurstelling.
Geweldige avond dankzij de sfeer en de bediening, maar culinair gezien… nee, dit was het niet.

Los demás platos estaban correctos, aunque sin la intensidad y explosión de sabor que uno espera de un restaurante con estrella Michelin.

Eso sí, el ambiente es impresionante, ubicado en el Hotel Mandarin Oriental con vistas a las Torres Etihad, una atmósfera elegante, buena música y un servicio atento y amable.
En definitiva, merece la visita por el entorno y la experiencia, pero la comida no alcanza el nivel que promete su reputación.

reviews.text:
Fine the crispy duck is salad is very good. Came right away.  I've now been waiting almost 45 minutes for a stir fried dish.  They've taken my napkin and a lot of people wandering around in dark clothes.   The restaurant is only at 20% filled.  No one has come to explain or assure me that my main course will be coming.  Totally ignored.  There's no way Michelin could give this place a star.  At this point I don't even care about the next course.  If it's coming.  Disappointing and totally wasting my time and goodwill.  Classic story.  Update.  OMFG.  Because I asked for the rest of my salad to take away, this server actually prepared my main course to go.  And it's been sitting in the bag with the salad for the last 30 minutes.  You cannot make this stuff up.  When have you ever had the rest of your first course saved to go and the rest of the meal was packed up without your knowledge.  It gets better.  While I'm waiting for dinner to be served she asks me if I want dessert. I lol at her like she's lost her mind.   Where's the main ?   And you're asking about dessert ?

Seriously, you have to go out of your way to create this kind of illogical chaos.  Michelin one star.  Seriously.

It's only been resolved, partially since I waved over an adult.  And told him my story.  I've never agin seen the person I gave my order to again.

The adult has comped the whole meal.  I was actually served the meal in a plate and it's very good.  And of course the twin is still in the bag.

We went with our daughter and the service was excellent. Our waitress took time to go through the menu and explain options and make recommendations for us. The food was stunningly presented and tasted amazing. Would highly recommend the peking duck amd caviar, a really nice combination.

The dim sum were simply beautiful to look at.

The alaskan lobster was also beautifully presented and tasted sublime.

This restaurant is going to hit your pocket hard, we were £600 for two adults and a two year old (who didnt get her own dishes, except a boiled rice). We had the duck, a couple of starters plus one main each, a glass of champagne and soft drinks.

It is a “special night out” type budget, but would highly recommend!

For dinner for two at 1,700aed you'd expect to wait less than 35mins for deserts (as a part of the pre-set menu, no less) and not to get it only after you asked for the bill and was about to leave. The restaurant was nearly empty too and plenty of stuff was messing around. Food quality on its own is mediocre at best, wine served - the same. Nowhere near to their selling point.
reviews.author: Aleksa Cavic

reviews.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience deserves one. For a party of 8 celebrating a birthday, the service was consistently poor from start to finish.

Drinks were delayed, food came out before the drinks even arrived, and even after finishing what we had, no one bothered to ask if we wanted refills. Several dishes we ordered were forgotten completely, and when the staff finally attempted to bring them out, everyone else had already finished eating—at that point, what’s the point?

For a birthday celebration, I had to ask multiple times for them to bring out the cake I brought myself. When it finally came, it was dropped at the table without candles, plates, or even a knife—as if it were an afterthought. No care, no effort.

To make matters worse, there was no follow-up from a manager or even a proper apology. A simple explanation, a complimentary drink, or any acknowledgment would have gone a long way. Instead, the staff seemed indifferent.

Between the mediocre food and the lack of basic hospitality, this place completely missed the mark. There are plenty of better options in the area—do yourself a favor and explore those instead.

reviews.text: Wow, where to start? The food was brilliant but what was even better was my experience from our waiter, Mr Soe, absolute gentlemen, no request was too much and he made me feel like I was eating in my own home. Hakkasan Abu Dhabi clears the London branch and the staff really made the experience 11/10. Will 1000% be returning when next in AD!

reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of dining at Hakkasan Abu Dhabi during my stay at Emirates Palace, and what made the evening truly unforgettable was the outstanding service.

A special thank you to Alina, Camila, and So — their professionalism, warm attitude, and attention to detail elevated the whole experience. They were attentive without being intrusive, always anticipating what I might need, and added a personal touch that made me feel genuinely welcomed and cared for.

The cuisine was excellent — refined flavors, beautiful presentation, and signature dishes that exceeded expectations. But it was the team’s hospitality that made the dinner feel not just luxurious, but personal and memorable.

Hakkasan Abu Dhabi is not only about exquisite food and elegant atmosphere, but also about people who make you feel special. Thank you once again to the wonderful staff for such an exceptional evening.

reviews.text:

reviews.text:
Our recent dinner at Hakkasan Abu Dhabi was, unfortunately, one of the most disappointing fine-dining experiences we have had anywhere in the world. We were a party of four, including two out-of-town guests we wanted to impress, and the evening fell far below the standards expected of a restaurant that proudly advertises a Michelin star.

From the beginning, the greeting was perfunctory and lacked any warmth. Our request for an outdoor table was declined due to a “private party,” yet we later saw multiple empty tables outside and guests being seated who clearly were not part of any large group. This immediately raised questions about the quality of service to come.

But the real shock came upon entering the dining room: Since when does a fine Chinese restaurant play thumping disco-style music? The background noise was so loud that we could not hold a normal conversation with our guests. Even after requesting the volume be lowered, nothing changed. This alone ruined any sense of atmosphere or refinement.

Service throughout the evening was equally disappointing. Our server seemed rushed and overwhelmed, offering no sense of attentiveness or hospitality. At one point, we waited nearly 15 minutes with empty plates on the table before anyone cleared them, and when someone finally came, there was no apology whatsoever. With the supposedly high caliber that Hakkasan claims, the service felt sub-par at best—no friendly greetings, no effort to engage, nothing beyond perfunctory “fast restaurant” interactions.

The food, sadly, did not redeem the evening. The dim sum and Peking duck were dry and surprisingly tasteless, far below expectations for a premium Chinese restaurant. We had ordered a pre-arranged set menu for the table, but the courses were rushed out so quickly that we had no time to enjoy them properly. Dish after dish appeared before we could finish the previous one, creating a hurried, uncomfortable pace that is the opposite of fine dining.

We left wondering how this Hakkasan location ever achieved a Michelin star. Between the loud nightclub-style music, inattentive service, lack of hospitality, and mediocre food, the entire experience was frankly embarrassing—especially with guests in town.

We will never return, and we cannot recommend this establishment to anyone seeking a genuine fine dining experience in Abu Dhabi.

Voor mijn verjaardag hadden we bij Hakkasan gereserveerd. Mooie setting, perfecte tafel, supervriendelijke bediening, het soort start waarbij je denkt: dit wordt een topavond.
Gezellig was het, absoluut. We kozen voor het degustatiemenu, want in een sterrenzaak is dat normaal de veilige keuze: achteroverleunen en je laten verrassen. Wel, verrast waren we:

Om te beginnen: geen hapjes. Helemaal niets. In een sterrenrestaurant. Vreemd, toch? Je verwacht toch minstens één klein welkomsthapje dat fluistert: “Welkom, we kunnen koken.”

Dan de opbouw van het menu: alle voorgerechten tegelijk, alle hoofdgerechten tegelijk. Echt niet leuk om alles op een hoop te krijgen — je wilt juist een avondvullend menu beleven, rustig opbouwen en genieten. Bovendien: veel te veel. We hebben heel wat onaangeroerd laten staan. Het leek soms wel op een chinees om de hoek, maar daar neem je de overschot dan wel mee naar huis.

En eerlijk? Geen enkel gerecht was echt top. Veel te veel gefrituurd, weinig finesse.

Voor een zaak met naam, faam én een stevig prijskaartje was dit een zware teleurstelling.
Geweldige avond dankzij de sfeer en de bediening, maar culinair gezien… nee, dit was het niet.

reviews.text:
Qasr Al Muwaiji is one of those places that quietly humbles you. Set within a restored historic fort in Al Ain, it once served as both the residence and administrative center of the Al Nahyan family — and most notably, the birthplace of Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan. This is where the story of modern UAE leadership truly begins.

The fort has been beautifully preserved in its original style, allowing you to step straight into the past. Walking through its corridors gives a grounded, almost intimate glimpse into how life once was — simple, resilient, and purpose-driven. The exhibits trace the nation’s journey from humble beginnings to remarkable progress under the steady leadership of the Al Nahyan family, especially the vision of the late Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan.

With free entry and an immersive, thoughtfully curated experience, Qasr Al Muwaiji isn’t flashy — it’s sincere, meaningful, and quietly powerful. A must-visit if you want to understand the soul behind the nation. 🏰✨

قصر المويجعي واحد من المعالم اللي تحسّ إنها تحكي تاريخ المكان بصمت، وتجمع بين الأصالة وهيبة الماضي. من أوّل ما تدخل القصر، بتشوف الطراز الأصيل اللي يميّز العمارة الإماراتية القديمة، الجدران الطينية، والساحات الواسعة اللي تعكس بساطة الحياة زمان وجمالها.

القصر له قيمة خاصة لأنه شهد ميلاد صاحب السمو الشيخ خليفة بن زايد آل نهيان رحمه الله، وبهذا يتحوّل من مجرد مبنى أثري إلى شاهد على مرحلة مهمة من تاريخ الدولة. المعرض الداخلي مرتب بطريقة ذكية، يشرح لك قصة المكان، ويعرض صور ووثائق تحسسّك بقربك من الأحداث والشخصيات اللي صنعت تاريخ الإمارات.

الإضاءة الهادئة، العروض التفاعلية، والممرات المفتوحة على الساحة الداخلية تعطّي الزائر تجربة ممتعة، خصوصًا إذا كنت من محبين الأماكن اللي فيها روح وذاكرة. حتى الصوتيات داخل بعض القاعات مصممة لتعطيك إحساس بالغوص في الماضي.

الجميل بعد إن القصر قريب من العين مول ومنطقة وسط العين، يعني تقدر تزوره ضمن يوم سياحي كامل بدون تعب. المكان مناسب للعائلات، وممتع لهواة التصوير، والزيارة فيه ما تاخذ وقت طويل، لكنها تترك انطباع عميق.

باختصار: قصر المويجعي مكان يجمع التاريخ، الجمال، والهدوء… ويستحق الزيارة بكل تأكيد

قصر المويجعي واحد من المعالم اللي تحسّ إنها تحكي تاريخ المكان بصمت، وتجمع بين الأصالة وهيبة الماضي. من أوّل ما تدخل القصر، بتشوف الطراز الأصيل اللي يميّز العمارة الإماراتية القديمة، الجدران الطينية، والساحات الواسعة اللي تعكس بساطة الحياة زمان وجمالها.

القصر له قيمة خاصة لأنه شهد ميلاد صاحب السمو الشيخ خليفة بن زايد آل نهيان رحمه الله، وبهذا يتحوّل من مجرد مبنى أثري إلى شاهد على مرحلة مهمة من تاريخ الدولة. المعرض الداخلي مرتب بطريقة ذكية، يشرح لك قصة المكان، ويعرض صور ووثائق تحسسّك بقربك من الأحداث والشخصيات اللي صنعت تاريخ الإمارات.

الإضاءة الهادئة، العروض التفاعلية، والممرات المفتوحة على الساحة الداخلية تعطّي الزائر تجربة ممتعة، خصوصًا إذا كنت من محبين الأماكن اللي فيها روح وذاكرة. حتى الصوتيات داخل بعض القاعات مصممة لتعطيك إحساس بالغوص في الماضي.

الجميل بعد إن القصر قريب من العين مول ومنطقة وسط العين، يعني تقدر تزوره ضمن يوم سياحي كامل بدون تعب. المكان مناسب للعائلات، وممتع لهواة التصوير، والزيارة فيه ما تاخذ وقت طويل، لكنها تترك انطباع عميق.

باختصار: قصر المويجعي مكان يجمع التاريخ، الجمال، والهدوء… ويستحق الزيارة بكل تأكيد

Our stay at the Rixos Marina Hotel was truly exceptional. From check-in to departure, every moment reflected the hotel’s commitment to excellence and genuine hospitality. A heartfelt thank you to Mouhammed at the reception, whose professionalism, attentiveness, and friendly demeanor made our stay seamless and enjoyable. His assistance was consistently outstanding and greatly appreciated.

We would also like to commend Claude for his impeccable service during our departure. He ensured that all our luggage and transportation were handled with care and efficiency, paying close attention to every detail. His dedication truly stood out and made the final moments of our stay as smooth as our arrival.

The room service was generally good and punctual, but the in-room service overall should be improved to fully match the high standards and quality of the hotel.

Lastly, the preparation and organization of the Gala Dinner were absolutely remarkable — beautifully executed and perfectly managed, making it a memorable experience.

Rixos Marina Hotel exceeds expectations not only through its luxurious facilities but through the remarkable staff who elevate every guest experience. Highly recommended — we look forward to our next visit.

reviews.text:
We had an absolutely amazing stay at Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi, and the experience exceeded our expectations in every possible way.

First of all, the rooms were exceptionally clean. Not just upon arrival, but throughout the entire stay. Housekeeping did an outstanding job every day, and the level of cleanliness really stood out. Everything felt fresh, well-maintained, and truly luxurious, which made the stay extremely comfortable.

The food was insanely good. The quality, variety, and presentation were on a very high level. Every meal felt well thought out, with delicious flavors and excellent ingredients. Whether it was breakfast, lunch, or dinner, the dining experience was consistently impressive. The drinks were also excellent — well-made, flavorful, and served with great attention to detail.

One of the absolute highlights of our stay was the New Year’s show, which was simply amazing. The entertainment, atmosphere, and overall organization were outstanding and created an unforgettable celebration. It was clear that a lot of effort and professionalism went into making the evening special for the guests.

The service was excellent from start to finish. A special mention goes to Caner at the reception, who was incredibly polite, professional, and helpful. From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed. Caner handled everything with a smile and great courtesy, which made a big difference and set the tone for the entire stay.

Overall, Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi delivers a top-level hotel experience with spotless rooms, outstanding food and drinks, unforgettable entertainment, and truly exceptional service. We would highly recommend this hotel and would absolutely love to return in the future.

reviews.text:
Zunächst war ich mir nicht sicher, ob ich eine Rezension schreiben möchte, da es während unseres Aufenthalts zu einer Unstimmigkeit gekommen ist. Der Umgang des Hotelpersonals mit dieser Situation hat mich jedoch positiv überrascht, sodass ich mich entschieden habe, unsere sehr schönen Erfahrungen zu teilen.

Besonders beeindruckt hat uns das hervorragende Essen: Sowohl das Frühstücks- als auch das Abendbuffet waren äußerst vielfältig, abwechslungsreich und qualitativ. Die Auswahl liess keine Wünsche offen, und die Speisen waren stets frisch und ansprechend zubereitet. Positiv hervorzuheben ist zudem, dass man rund um die Uhr sehr gut verpflegt wird; selbst ohne ein All-Inclusive-Paket zu buchen.

Ein weiterer grosser Pluspunkt ist das Hotelpersonal. Alle Mitarbeitenden waren durchweg sehr höflich, aufmerksam und hilfsbereit. Man hatte jederzeit das Gefühl, willkommen zu sein und ernst genommen zu werden.

Auch das Zimmer hat uns sehr überzeugt: Es war modern, gepflegt und sauber. Das Housekeeping hat hervorragende Arbeit geleistet. Den respektvollen Umgang mit unseren persönlichen Sachen haben wir als sehr angenehm empfunden.

Die Lage des Hotels ist ebenfalls hervorragend. Direkt am Meer gelegen, hat es den Aufenthalt besonders erholsam gemacht.

Die erwähnte Unstimmigkeit konnte gemeinsam mit dem Hotelpersonal schnell und unkompliziert geklärt werden. Dabei wurde deutlich, wie lösungsorientiert dort gearbeitet wird und wie wichtig es dem Hotel ist, dass die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt als positiv in Erinnerung behalten und mit einem guten Gefühl abreisen.

Insgesamt sehr zu empfehlen.

reviews.text:
Wir waren hier im April mit unseren 6 jährigen Zwillingen und hatten Halbpension gebucht.

Eines vorab - das Hotel ist wirklich beeindruckend und vermutlich nicht vergleichbar mit anderen Hotels im klassischen Abu Dhabi. Unter Berücksichtigung von Preis-Leistung habe ich jedoch eine andere Erwartungshaltung, weshalb ich nur 4 Sterne vergebe.

Der Check-In ist verbesserungsfähig - wobei mme. etwas unglücklich. Nach der Ankunft und Abgabe unserer Pässe wurden wir gefragt, ob wir den Check In auf Deutsch vornehmen wollen. Meine Frau bejahte - ich vermute der einzig deutschsprachige Mitarbeiter hatte gerade Pause und war entsprechend gelaunt. - Infos? Fehlanzeige. Zudem wurde dadurch der Check In Prozess ziemlich verzögert. Daneben war das Extrabett noch nicht vorbereitet - bei einem Check In nach 15 Uhr sollte man erwarten können, dass das Zimmer bereits vorbereitet ist.

Ebenfalls nicht optimal empfand ich unser Zimmer mit Meerblick - unter unserem Zimmer gab es Balkone, weshalb wir einen Sichtschutz hatten. Diesen haben sehr wenige Zimmer. Daneben war das Zimmer sehr geräumig und bat ausreichend Platz für uns vier. Ebenfalls negativ - es gibt eigentlich keine Möglichkeit die Badesachen an der Luft / Sonne zu trocknen.

Die Essensauswahl ist sehr groß und abwechslungsreich. In der besagten Preisklasse erwarte ich jedoch einen gewissen Mindestservice bei der Bedienung am Tisch - insbesondere beim Frühstück (Aufnahme Bestellung Getränke, Eierspeisen etc.). Abends gibt es einen Live-grill mit diversen Fleisch- und Fischsorten - leider wiederholt sich die Auswahl stets und wurde nur punktuell ersetzt.

Besonders hervorheben möchten wir den Kids-Club. Unsere Kinder haben diesen geliebt - und einen Mitarbeiter aus einem anderen Hotel aus 2024 wiedererkannt. Die Betreuer sind super, jeden Tag gibt es ein anderes Motto und verschiedene Aktivitäten. Auch abends gibt es neben der Minidisco viel Abwechslung für die Kinder. Besonders erfreulich - anstatt permanent Süßkram zu geben, gab es an einem Abend frische Kokosnüsse sowie wurde Sushi selbst gemacht. Am letzten Tag gab es zudem ein Abschiedsgeschenk. - hier wird in die Gäste von morgen investiert ;-)

Auch für Erwachsene gibt es diverse Aktivitäten. Am Strand und Pool gibt es alternativ ausreichend liegen, sodass man hier nie das Gefühl haben muss, welche zu reservieren.

In der unmittelbaren Nähe vom Hotel gibt es ein "Dorf", welches das authentische Leben in den VAE vor dem "Geldregen" zeigt sowie eine Mall mit Shopping- und Essensmöglichkeiten.
Für weitere Aktivitäten (tagsüber, z.B. Stadttour, YAS-Island) verpasst man zu viele Möglichkeiten, da diese doch etwas weit entfernt sind vom Hotel.

Ein letztes Manko - wobei Jammern auf hohem Niveau. Da wir über einen Reiseveranstalter gebucht hatten, wurde unser Accorhotels Status nicht gewürdigt.

We had an absolutely amazing stay at Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi, and the experience exceeded our expectations in every possible way.

First of all, the rooms were exceptionally clean. Not just upon arrival, but throughout the entire stay. Housekeeping did an outstanding job every day, and the level of cleanliness really stood out. Everything felt fresh, well-maintained, and truly luxurious, which made the stay extremely comfortable.

The food was insanely good. The quality, variety, and presentation were on a very high level. Every meal felt well thought out, with delicious flavors and excellent ingredients. Whether it was breakfast, lunch, or dinner, the dining experience was consistently impressive. The drinks were also excellent — well-made, flavorful, and served with great attention to detail.

One of the absolute highlights of our stay was the New Year’s show, which was simply amazing. The entertainment, atmosphere, and overall organization were outstanding and created an unforgettable celebration. It was clear that a lot of effort and professionalism went into making the evening special for the guests.

The service was excellent from start to finish. A special mention goes to Caner at the reception, who was incredibly polite, professional, and helpful. From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed. Caner handled everything with a smile and great courtesy, which made a big difference and set the tone for the entire stay.

Overall, Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi delivers a top-level hotel experience with spotless rooms, outstanding food and drinks, unforgettable entertainment, and truly exceptional service. We would highly recommend this hotel and would absolutely love to return in the future.

reviews.text:
We stayed here for 7 days, and it was the first holiday in a long time where I didn't want to go back home.

The hotel was phenomenal, both in staff and amenities. My previous experience in the UAE was Jumeriah Al Qasr Dubai, and this was even better. Lovely pools, amazing private beach, and wonderful interiors.

The staff were extremely helpful and attentive throughout our stay, going out of their way especially for our 1-year-old daughter. On one occasion a cleaner passed us in the hallway, asked for our room number, and then returned 10 minutes later with a toy for our baby. Such thoughtfulness means a lot when travelling with a family. Special mention to doorman Siju who helped us out repeatedly with our pram and car seat.

Food wise, I was absolutely blown away by the daily buffet. I am not normally a fan of this, but I have NEVER been to a buffet of such consistently high quality and variety. Unfortunately, I did eat too much and now need to diet. There was too much food to try and all of it was excellent.

This was such a great trip for our family, and my daughter also learned to walk in the long carpeted corridors outside the rooms.

In terms of location, it's ideally situated with a Souk on one side and a pier full of restaurants (and the aquarium) on the other. It's also a short Careem/Uber ride to the malls, which were also brilliant. There is a gym next to the Souk which does the job for anyone looking to burn some calories (machines for every body part, a smith machine, a trap bar, and some heavyish dumbells).

I will certainly be returning - much calmer than Dubai and far fewer influencers.

Thank you for an unforgettable stay.

reviews.text:
Exceptional Stay – Far Beyond Expectations

Our experience at this hotel was truly outstanding—far above anything we could have imagined. From the moment we arrived, the service exceeded every expectation. The team at the restaurants delivered an unforgettable level of hospitality. They even prepared special dishes for our son, and every single meal was fantastic. The buffet offered a wide variety of specialties each day, all incredibly delicious and beautifully prepared.

What truly set this hotel apart was the overall service. Every staff member we encountered was not only friendly, but genuinely thoughtful and attentive. They consistently anticipated our needs before we even had to ask, which made our stay feel effortless and exceptionally comfortable.

We want to extend a very special thank you to Sujeet Kumar and his team. They made our time at the restaurant extra special every single day. Their kindness, professionalism, and warmth elevated our entire stay. More hotels need teams like this—what they provided made a tremendous difference and turned our journey into something truly unforgettable.

We highly, wholeheartedly recommend staying here. An exceptional experience from start to finish.

reviews.text:
Ich finde es kommt selten vor, dass man mit einem Aufenthalt zu 100% zufrieden ist. Hier muss man sagen, sind wir es eindeutig gewesen!
Die Hotelanlage inklusive Pools und Stränden war super gepflegt und sauber. Überall hat es toll geduftet. Die Zimmer waren immer sauber. Es gab 2x am Tag einen room service, der wirklich 1A war. Alle Mitarbeiter sind sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend, alle sehr respektvoll. Das Essen war vielfältig und sehr gut. Wir waren zum Beispiel einen Abend sehr überrascht, dass es einfach so Tomahawk Rind (neben vielen anderen Fleisch Sorten) am Abend Buffet gab. Das Fleisch war super zart und sehr lecker. Von den Toiletten, die wirklich immer frisch und sauber waren, waren wir ebenfalls begeistert. Die location ist super zentral und alles war gut zu erreichen. Die Hotelanlage verfügt über eine eigene kleine shopping mall und einen Supermarkt, zu dem man auf Wunsch auch mit dem club car gefahren wird.
Für jedes Anliegen hatten die Rezeptionisten/innen ein offenes Ohr.
Besonders von der lieben Service Kraft Aashi waren wir sehr begeistert. Als Abschiedsgeschenk gab es sogar noch ein kleines Dessert mit der Aufschrift “see you soon”. Wir haben uns durch und durch wohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder.

reviews.text:
Amazing hotel in Abu Dhabi located in a very cosy and quiet place

The Shangri-La hotel as you can expect has a very professional and friendly staff

The place is huge, with beautiful decoration and amenities

A nice swimming pool and beach overlooking the canal and the Sheik Zayed Mosque which will give you amazing pictures by day, night and sunset time.

The breakfast is awesome, full of flavors with différents stations that propose different cuisine as Indian, Middle East, Western and Asian , fruits, chocolate, ice cream, bread, patisserie, seafood, etc.

The room are super spacious with a little balcony. The internet connection is super good that will allow you to have video call and work in a good condition.

The hotel is at 4 minutes walking distance to the souk and you can even go there by Abra, which is a complimentary service of the hotel. Just need to book through the concierge and they will bring you to the loft, down to the Abra.

The place is located as well at 5 minutes walkable distance of many restaurants, grocery store which is super convenient for a walk after the sunset.

reviews.text:
I enjoyed at stay at the Shangri-La Qaryat Al Bari and it was stunning throughout.
All of the stay were great - however special praise does need to be given to the team in the Horizon Lounge.
Pooch, Aerielle, Gleb and Jane and others were all fantastic.

Praise above this has to go the the power in the kitchen too.
Chef Momma was amazing. She was responsive to a request to make an omelette welcome and the next day went over and above this in making me a stunning Parsi style omelette, which would have been my breakfast everyday if it was not for her phenomenal Avocado on Sourdough Toast. This sounds like such a simple dish - but it can easily be ruined by the complacent cook, which Momma is clearly not.
And as for her porridge, that is great too.
Thank you all for making the stay so special.

Ein tolles, sauberes 5-Sterne-Hotel, das unseren Geburtstagsaufenthalt unvergesslich machte. Von der Ankunft bis zum Check-out war alles perfekt organisiert und luxuriös. Absolut empfehlenswert! Das Restaurant ist vorzüglich, mit riesiger Auswahl an Buffets und internationalen Spezialitäten. Frische Zutaten, Live-Cooking und Themenabende sorgen für Vielfalt – auch für Veganer gibt es Auswahlmöglichkeiten. Der Service war stets aufmerksam und freundlich.
Ich kann das Hotel nur sehr empfehlen.

Service & Personal
Die Mitarbeiter sind extrem höflich und sympathisch; man wird überall mit einem ehrlichen Lächeln begrüßt. Besonders hervorzuheben ist der 24/7 Butler-Service. Dass man den Concierge jederzeit kontaktieren kann, sorgt für ein echtes "Rundum-sorglos-Paket". Im Restaurant wird Gastfreundschaft großgeschrieben: Die Mitarbeiter merken sich individuelle Vorlieben, was den Service sehr persönlich macht.
Kulinarik (Ein Paradies für Langschläfer)
Ein absolutes Highlight ist das Frühstück bis 13:00 Uhr – optimal für alle, die gerne ausschlafen und trotzdem Wert auf ein hochwertiges Buffet legen. Sowohl das Frühstück als auch das Abendbuffet bieten eine super Auswahl und erstklassige Qualität.
Anlage & Umgebung
Die Anlage ist riesig und geht direkt in den Residence-Bereich über. Das ist extrem praktisch, da man in nur wenigen Schritten ein Einkaufszentrum, Friseure, Beautysalons und Cafés erreicht. Trotz der Größe ist das Resort makellos sauber – die Einrichtung (auch in den Zimmern) ist formidabel, wir konnten buchstäblich kein Staubkörnchen finden.
Strand & Natur
Der Strand ist wunderschön; wir sind jeden Tag bis zum Sonnenuntergang geblieben. Besonders bemerkenswert und lobenswert ist das Engagement des Resorts für die Umwelt: Der Schutz der Nestplätze für gefährdete Schildkröten zeigt, dass hier Luxus und Naturschutz Hand in Hand gehen.
Fazit: Ein perfekter Ort für einen erholsamen Familienurlaub auf höchstem Niveau. Wir kommen definitiv

The resort itself is breathtaking , beautifully maintained grounds, and a beach that genuinely feels world-class with its soft white sand and crystal-clear waters.

What elevates this hotel far above others, though, is the exceptional standard of service. Every member of staff we encountered was warm, attentive and genuinely invested in making our stay perfect. Their professionalism and kindness created an atmosphere where we felt cared for at every single moment.

There were so many individuals who made our trip memorable, but a heartfelt thank you goes especially to Ohsen, Obi, Dibyajyoti (Panda), Manisha,  Chef Ajay and Chef Mukesh,

Each of them went above and beyond in ways we didn’t expect, delivering thoughtful touches and personal gestures that transformed a great holiday into an extraordinary one.

We cannot recommend the St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort highly enough. If you're looking for luxury, serenity, and service that truly sets a new benchmark, this is the place. We’re already counting down the days until our next visit!
