Отвечает ,что не может связаться с баром .Подходим на ресепшен к сотруднику ,тот набирает бар и нам все подтверждают .Вот так работают Батлеры и консьержи здесь . То есть не работают вообще . За все время не смогли забронировать ни одного ресторана в своем же отеле ,все приходилось делать самим .|При бронировании через booking мы просили подготовить диван кровать для сына и второе одеяло для взрослых .|Вместо матраса на диван положили простынку , наматрасников или тонких матрасов у них нет . |Вечером вернулись в номер ,второе одеяло ,которое с трудом получили днем ,его унесли . Опять в час ночи идем на ресепшен и просим вернуть одеяло ,через 15 минут возвращают .|Это пример одного дня в «люксовом « отеле .|Базовые вещи -сантехника в номере разваливается ,фото прилагаются .Настроить температуру воды проблематично .|Ванну не принять ,идет ржавая вода .Только душ ,если не обжечься ,проблемы с регулировкой .|На территории везде ,даже в зоне пляжа идут строительные работы ,даже ночью .Фото прилагаются .|Плитка в бассейнах в ужасном состоянии ,не менялась ,наверное ,с открытия .|Единственный плюс отеля -неплохой тренажерный зал и очень хороший внутренний бассейн .|При этом открытый бассейн глубиной всего 120 см |Служба консьержей (батлеров ) присутствует лишь номинально ,ничего не умеют или не хотят .|Посмотрите фото ,они расскажут больше слов !

reviews.text:
My stay at the St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort was unfortunately marred by two significant issues that do not align with the reputation or price point of this luxury brand.

1. Unsafe and Unmaintained Beach:
The main attraction, the beach, was a major disappointment. It was full of sharp stones and pebbles instead of soft sand. Regrettably, this led to an injury/cut on my foot while walking. A luxury resort beach should be safe and properly maintained for guests.

2. Extreme Delay for Beach Food Order:
I placed a food order while relaxing on the beach. I was initially told the expected wait time was 30 minutes. However, the meal only arrived after an astounding one hour and fifteen minutes (75 minutes). This level of delay for a simple order is completely unacceptable and ruined the enjoyment of my time by the sea.
The resort needs immediate action regarding beach maintenance and a serious review of the efficiency of their beach service staff.

The overall value for money was extremely poor.

We had an absolutely unforgettable stay at the St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort. From the moment we arrived, it was clear we were somewhere truly special. The resort itself is breathtaking , beautifully maintained grounds, and a beach that genuinely feels world-class with its soft white sand and crystal-clear waters.

What elevates this hotel far above others, though, is the exceptional standard of service. Every member of staff we encountered was warm, attentive and genuinely invested in making our stay perfect. Their professionalism and kindness created an atmosphere where we felt cared for at every single moment.

There were so many individuals who made our trip memorable, but a heartfelt thank you goes especially to Ohsen, Obi, Dibyajyoti (Panda), Manisha,  Chef Ajay and Chef Mukesh,

Each of them went above and beyond in ways we didn’t expect, delivering thoughtful touches and personal gestures that transformed a great holiday into an extraordinary one.

We cannot recommend the St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort highly enough. If you're looking for luxury, serenity, and service that truly sets a new benchmark, this is the place. We’re already counting down the days until our next visit!

reviews.text:
The Bridge wellness hub is an excellent place to exercise and relax. As I am new to the country and the city of Abu Dhabi, I searched through the city to find a nice place to engage with local community, and also improve my health conditions. It turns out that The Bridge is the place that you can do both!

On the same day Mr Hamza gave a tour to myself and my partner, we decided that this is the place to be. The following months proved us right. If you would like to have a tour of the place, please make sure to ask for Mr Hamza, he will guide you through all the facilities, packages, and take care of you for all the aftermaths. I truly appreciate his help!

Well, Mr Hamza is not the only one you can rely on, Mr Lan from the Krave restaurant on the ground floor has consistently shown his hospitality every time I visit the restaurant. The services with the valet parking, the SPA facilities, and the reception, are all exceptional. At the end of the workout, I could choose to relax in the sauna, or have a walk along the creek in the Al Qana complex. If anyone knows any other place can beat this experience? Please let me know, because so far this is the best place in Abu Dhabi I could find.

As comfortable as I already am, there are still other facilities I have not used often, such as the rooftop pool, group classes, and community activities. I am sure they will not disappoint. My partner is super hyped about the puppy yoga event and marked in her agenda long before the event itself.

All in all, I could wholeheartedly recommend this place. A well-deserved 5-star!

reviews.text:
I recently joined The Bridge Wellness after a long wait due to a knee injury, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience so far. My friend has been a member since last year and always spoke highly of the place, so I was eager to join.

From the moment I signed up, Siham made the process seamless. She helped me with my membership, set up my bookings, and activated my app—all with such care and professionalism. Her assistance made me feel truly welcome.

Before becoming a member, my friends and I frequently held meetings at The Bridge restaurant. Our group includes individuals with gluten and lactose intolerances, and Chef Yunita always went above and beyond to accommodate our needs. Her attention to detail and kindness made every visit special. We often hold business meetings and friendly gatherings there two to three times a week, and the food and service never disappoint.

Today, I had my first session with coach Zikhona, and coach Juliana  ( her spining class is so positive energy keep always looking for the next one)  I absolutely loved them energy and dedication to helping me achieve my goals. Them encouragement has already made me feel more confident about my journey to a healthier lifestyle.

One of the highlights was the expertise of Mrs. Maram, a highly professional dietitian—wow! She takes the time to meet with you, listen to your needs, measure your progress, and provide a full-week meal plan complete with recipes and a detailed guide. Her support is truly incredible!

If you’re looking to change your lifestyle with full guidance and support, The Bridge Wellness Hub is the perfect place. The choice is in your hands—take the first step toward a healthier you!

I highly recommend The Bridge Wellness to anyone looking to transform their lifestyle. The supportive environment, excellent service, and personalized care make it an outstanding choice for wellness and personal growth.

Honestly, I’m extremely frustrated with how The Bridge gym handles member requests. I emailed them asking to freeze my membership from July 25 to August 4—no one reply. I had to call the call center myself, only to be told to “wait until Monday.” That Monday came and went no response. and I had to follow up again after a full week. Eventually, I was told that the complimentary month couldn’t be frozen, which would have been useful to know from the start. Overall, the communication was poor, and I feel like I wasted a week waiting for a response.
Why waste my time if you’re not going to do your job properly? The communication is unprofessional and completely unacceptable. If you can’t respect your members’ time, don’t offer these services at all.

I joined this gym because it was marketed as a luxury space with proper ladies’ facilities, but it’s been a huge disappointment! Since day 1, I made it clear I wanted to train only in the ladies’ section. Now, without warning or proper communication/email, they reduced the ladies’ area, gave half to the mixed section, and moved the cardio machines far away — meaning I now have to leave the private area, put my hijab back on, and walk across the gym mid-workout!

When I complained, management’s response was: “We were never a ladies’ gym, we’re a mixed gym with a ladies-friendly area.” Fair enough, but this was never communicated to me when I joined.

The constant changes, lack of transparency, and disregard for members’ comfort make this place stressful instead of enjoyable. For the price they charge, it’s simply NOT worth it.

If you’re a woman looking for a genuinely private and accommodating gym experience, this is definitely NOT the place.
reviews.author: Anwaar Khaled

reviews.text:
I couldn’t believe I’d ever write a bad review about The Bridge. I’ve been a member for almost 3 years, and my fitness journey started here. I used to love this gym — it felt like home. But now, I’m honestly heartbroken and extremely disappointed. The Bridge has changed — and not in a good way.

Let’s start with the ladies’ gym: it’s still the same tiny studio, with barely any equipment. We have one Smith machine, one shoulder machine, two back machines, and that’s it. The heaviest plate is only 15kg. I’ve requested so many times — for a leg press, hip thrust machine, abductor, back machines, and more plates. Not once did I get a reply. Every time I ask who to talk to, I’m told “Admissions doesn’t want to change anything.” So who’s actually listening to the members?

They recently added a new cardio studio, but it’s on the other side of the gym on the same floor, separated by just some curtains. It’s a very small area with maybe 4 cardio machines and 2 stair masters. That’s not enough for the number of women using the gym, and it doesn’t fix the bigger issue — the lack of proper weight training equipment.

Then there’s the ladies-only timing — from 9 AM to 12 PM on weekdays. Most of us work during those hours, and for the few who can go, it’s still not enough time. I’ve raised this point before too, and once again, nothing changes.

What frustrates me most is the renewal process. They used to offer small discounts for loyal members. This year, I got nothing — just a higher price, and now I’m paying more than double what I originally paid. And for what? The ladies’ section hasn’t improved at all. It feels like we’re being overcharged and ignored. How can prices keep going up, but the services stay the same — or worse?

I miss the old Bridge. The coaches back then were amazing — they knew us by name, brought energy to every class, and made the gym feel like a real community. Now, most of them are gone. Some of the new coaches have no energy, don’t engage with the class, and just go through the motions. Even the staff and security have changed, and it’s just not the same vibe anymore.

The Bridge keeps changing, but not for the better. All we ask for is a well-equipped ladies’ gym, proper communication, and coaches who care. I never thought I’d say this, but the gym that once felt like my second home now just feels like a business that stopped caring.

I’ve been a loyal member of this gym for years, but sadly, I can no longer recognize the place I once loved. What used to feel like a vibrant, welcoming space now feels cold, disconnected, and lifeless. The recent “revamp” seems more like a downgrade — equipment awkwardly shuffled around with no aesthetic or functional improvement. The layout feels rushed and uninspired.

We used to have energy. Community. Happy hours. Coaches who actually cared. Even the baristas knew your name and your order. Now? Most of the good coaches and managers are gone, and so are the familiar faces that made this gym feel like home. It’s disheartening. And every time concerns are raised, the answer is always: “Change is a natural part of any organization.” But change is meant to bring progress not decline. That phrase is being used to justify poor decisions, not meaningful growth.

The pricing is unstable, the environment is dull, and frankly, I regret renewing my membership this year. It used to be a place we looked forward to — now it just feels like any other gym trying to imitate what it once was.. this is my last year joining for sure.

reviews.text: Before anything I must say, staff are great and my review is not about them in any way, I actually love the team. If you’re a working woman, the gym ladies timing is only accessible from 9 AM to 12 PM which is not convenient for any woman who works. only 1 studio is accessible during the full day which is the size of a bedroom, literally. The studio does not accommodate more than 10 people at the same time, not enough machines, people cram unhygienically and its just too much. Moreover, since I first joined in 2023 they have been promising to upgrade and extend the ladies area, and we kept sharing our feedback and expressing how small the ladies area is and they kept promising to make the experience better. 2 years and a half later, NOTHING. They extended the ladies area this Ramadan (March) until we received an email in June stating that the extension is removed and we’re back to the studio lol, again, the studio that is the size of a bedroom literally. So it’s my first day back after they removed the extension on the 9th of june. I tried to go in and funny enough, there was a class happening at that time! Meaning that if you want to go to the gym, you have to check prior and make sure that theres no class taking place in the studio when you wanna go to the gym, meaning, you have a membership for a gym that you cannot go to at your convenience  but at theirs hahaha. Unplanned situation? They freeze. They follow “policy” like it’s gospel because they don’t know how to lead without a script.

It’s not just disappointing it’s quite embarrassing. A masterclass in how to kill a great thing with corporate mediocrity.

reviews.text:
The Bridge wellness hub is an excellent place to exercise and relax. As I am new to the country and the city of Abu Dhabi, I searched through the city to find a nice place to engage with local community, and also improve my health conditions. It turns out that The Bridge is the place that you can do both!

On the same day Mr Hamza gave a tour to myself and my partner, we decided that this is the place to be. The following months proved us right. If you would like to have a tour of the place, please make sure to ask for Mr Hamza, he will guide you through all the facilities, packages, and take care of you for all the aftermaths. I truly appreciate his help!

Well, Mr Hamza is not the only one you can rely on, Mr Lan from the Krave restaurant on the ground floor has consistently shown his hospitality every time I visit the restaurant. The services with the valet parking, the SPA facilities, and the reception, are all exceptional. At the end of the workout, I could choose to relax in the sauna, or have a walk along the creek in the Al Qana complex. If anyone knows any other place can beat this experience? Please let me know, because so far this is the best place in Abu Dhabi I could find.

As comfortable as I already am, there are still other facilities I have not used often, such as the rooftop pool, group classes, and community activities. I am sure they will not disappoint. My partner is super hyped about the puppy yoga event and marked in her agenda long before the event itself.

All in all, I could wholeheartedly recommend this place. A well-deserved 5-star!

reviews.text:
I recently joined The Bridge Wellness after a long wait due to a knee injury, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience so far. My friend has been a member since last year and always spoke highly of the place, so I was eager to join.

From the moment I signed up, Siham made the process seamless. She helped me with my membership, set up my bookings, and activated my app—all with such care and professionalism. Her assistance made me feel truly welcome.

Before becoming a member, my friends and I frequently held meetings at The Bridge restaurant. Our group includes individuals with gluten and lactose intolerances, and Chef Yunita always went above and beyond to accommodate our needs. Her attention to detail and kindness made every visit special. We often hold business meetings and friendly gatherings there two to three times a week, and the food and service never disappoint.

Today, I had my first session with coach Zikhona, and coach Juliana  ( her spining class is so positive energy keep always looking for the next one)  I absolutely loved them energy and dedication to helping me achieve my goals. Them encouragement has already made me feel more confident about my journey to a healthier lifestyle.

One of the highlights was the expertise of Mrs. Maram, a highly professional dietitian—wow! She takes the time to meet with you, listen to your needs, measure your progress, and provide a full-week meal plan complete with recipes and a detailed guide. Her support is truly incredible!

If you’re looking to change your lifestyle with full guidance and support, The Bridge Wellness Hub is the perfect place. The choice is in your hands—take the first step toward a healthier you!

I highly recommend The Bridge Wellness to anyone looking to transform their lifestyle. The supportive environment, excellent service, and personalized care make it an outstanding choice for wellness and personal growth.

reviews.text: This shopping mall is a popular destination for both locals and tourists, offering a wide variety of shops, from international brands to local boutiques. Visitors can enjoy a range of dining options, including restaurants, cafes, and fast-food outlets, as well as entertainment facilities such as cinemas and play areas for children. The mall provides a comfortable and modern environment for shopping, relaxing, and spending time with family and friends. It is conveniently located and often hosts seasonal events and promotions, making it an attractive place for a full day of leisure and shopping.

reviews.text:
زرت الجيريا مول في جزيرة الماريا واحدًا من المراكز التجارية الراقية التي تجمع بين الفخامة والهدوء والموقع الاستثنائي في قلب أبوظبي. ما يميز هذا المول أنه ليس مجرد وجهة للتسوق، بل مساحة راقية للتجول والاستمتاع بالأجواء الساحلية المحيطة بجزيرة الماريا، والتي تعد من أجمل المناطق الحديثة في الإمارة. التصاميم الداخلية للمول أنيقة وعصرية، والمساحات الواسعة تمنح الزائر شعورًا بالراحة وتسهّل التنقل بين المتاجر.

يضم الجيريا مول مجموعة منتقاة من المحلات الراقية التي تلبي احتياجات الباحثين عن الجودة، سواء في الموضة، العطور، الهدايا، أو الإكسسوارات. كما توجد خيارات ممتازة للمطاعم والمقاهي، بعضها مطل على الواجهة البحرية، ما يجعل التجربة أكثر جمالًا خاصة في أوقات المساء. الجلسات في المقاهي مريحة وهادئة، وتمنح الزائر فرصة للاسترخاء أو العمل في بيئة مميزة.

يضم الجيريا مول مجموعة منتقاة من المحلات الراقية التي تلبي احتياجات الباحثين عن الجودة، سواء في الموضة، العطور، الهدايا، أو الإكسسوارات. كما توجد خيارات ممتازة للمطاعم والمقاهي، بعضها مطل على الواجهة البحرية، ما يجعل التجربة أكثر جمالًا خاصة في أوقات المساء. الجلسات في المقاهي مريحة وهادئة، وتمنح الزائر فرصة للاسترخاء أو العمل في بيئة مميزة.

reviews.text:
I would like to share my honest feedback about my experience at your gym. The facility itself is spacious and well-equipped, and I really appreciate the variety of machines and the overall cleanliness of the place.

However, I faced some issues during my visits. The trainers often prioritize their personal clients over regular members. For example, on one occasion, I was using a machine when a trainer insisted that I stop so his client could use it. Also, when I asked for guidance about using certain machines, I didn’t receive much help unless I joined a paid training program.

Another inconvenience is the Wi-Fi access process. Each time I come to the gym, I have to request a paper password to connect, which is not very practical.

Because of these issues, I can’t give a high rating, but I truly hope my feedback helps improve the overall experience for all members.

reviews.text:
I've been a member of UFC for three years, but over the past year, it has become increasingly difficult to attend consistently. I have already submitted a formal complaint regarding the gym equipment, yet the issues persist.
The treadmill gives electric shocks, and the stair machine randomly speeds up and slows down, making it unsafe. The yoga mats are worn out, dirty, and have an unpleasant odor. There are only two cable ropes available for around 30 people during peak hours, and just one foam bar for the entire gym. The treadmills are positioned directly in front of the mirrors, which is inconvenient. Additionally, essential equipment such as leg grips, stretch belts, and properly stored skipping ropes are missing—the skipping rope is simply thrown into an empty cardboard box.

Most concerningly, there are no water dispensers, which is surprising since this is the first gym I’ve ever been to that lacks such a basic necessity. I am extremely disappointed with the current state of the gym and the decline in its quality. To be fair enough the coaches Ayman and Hamdi are very helpful and the Receptionist is very welcoming.

reviews.text:
I've been a member of UFC for three years, but over the past year, it has become increasingly difficult to attend consistently. I have already submitted a formal complaint regarding the gym equipment, yet the issues persist.
The treadmill gives electric shocks, and the stair machine randomly speeds up and slows down, making it unsafe. The yoga mats are worn out, dirty, and have an unpleasant odor. There are only two cable ropes available for around 30 people during peak hours, and just one foam bar for the entire gym. The treadmills are positioned directly in front of the mirrors, which is inconvenient. Additionally, essential equipment such as leg grips, stretch belts, and properly stored skipping ropes are missing—the skipping rope is simply thrown into an empty cardboard box.

Most concerningly, there are no water dispensers, which is surprising since this is the first gym I’ve ever been to that lacks such a basic necessity. I am extremely disappointed with the current state of the gym and the decline in its quality. To be fair enough the coaches Ayman and Hamdi are very helpful and the Receptionist is very welcoming.

reviews.text:
My visit to Warner Bros. World was nothing short of magical, and it is an experience I will cherish for a very long time. From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the attention to detail, the immersive atmosphere, and how every corner truly brings the world of Warner Bros. characters to life. Each area felt like stepping straight into a movie or cartoon I grew up loving, and the overall organisation and cleanliness of the park were excellent.
My favourite ride was green latern.
What truly made my visit exceptional, however, was the outstanding support and kindness of a staff member named Jennifer from Cameroon. Jennifer went above and beyond her role to ensure I had the best possible experience. She took her time to patiently explain each ride to me, making sure I fully understood what to expect before going on them. Her explanations were clear, engaging, and thoughtful, which helped me feel comfortable and excited rather than overwhelmed.
What stood out most was her deep knowledge and passion for the park. Jennifer didn’t just explain the rides; she also shared the history behind the characters and the stories that inspired each attraction. Listening to her brought the entire experience to life in a meaningful way, allowing me to appreciate the creativity and legacy of Warner Bros. on a deeper level. She answered all my questions with genuine enthusiasm and never made me feel rushed.
Jennifer’s friendly attitude and willingness to help made me feel truly welcomed and valued as a guest. It is rare to meet someone who combines excellent customer service with such sincerity and dedication, and she is truly a credit to Warner Bros. World.
Because of Jennifer, my visit was not just fun, but memorable and enriching. I left the park with a smile, wonderful memories, and a deeper appreciation.I highly recommend Warner Bros. World to anyone looking for an unforgettable experience, and I sincerely hope other visitors get the chance to be guided by someone as amazing as Jennifer. She truly made my day special.

reviews.text:
I am a theme-park enthusiast and I’ve traveled visiting many parks and resorts all over the world.

What I found at Warner Bros World just blew me away! Although I had done my homework and studied the park in advance (reading thru the website and watching vlogging YouTube videos) I was still shocked by the high-level quality of experience this park offered!

My son and I visited on New Year’s Eve and although we were told the park would be really busy because of the holidays — it was still a very manageable experience… nothing compared to a busy day at Disneyland 🤣

The first two hours of the day were the least busiest… a good time to visit the more popular attractions (Batman: Knight Flight and Tom & Jerry’s Spin)

But throughout the day we were able to enjoy ourselves at a good and simple pace… some rides… popcorn… character interactions (…and I mean intentional interactions, not just photos!)… strolling through the park taking photos (beautiful and detailed scenery throughout the whole place)… ribeye steak lunch in Bedrock… show in the main hall area… such an amazing time.

I have to say… Warner Bros World in Abu Dhabi is one of the best! And I’ll tell you why:

1. Excellent and Friendly Employees!!! I know this should be a given when dealing with the service industry… but more and more many theme parks are beginning to lower their standards in this area. However, I found every single employee at WB World to be so absolutely friendly, helpful and excellent in their area of service. While shopping in the Bedrock Boutique, two employees: Pride and Bushra, gave me FIRST CLASS shopping experience… walking me through the store and helping me to find everything Flintstone that I wanted (I’m a huge Fred Flintstone fan!)… big friendly smiles and wonderful conversations about the local area and culture. These friendly employees really make a difference in making you feel welcomed and in having such an enjoyable day in the park!

2. Character Interactions. Not only can you meet and get a photo with the characters, but they actually take time to interact with you. For example, Robin and Batwomen took no less than 5 minutes talking to us, asking us questions, making funny jokes and just making our experience so much more fun! They were amazing! Later on, we met the Flintstones and although they can’t talk, they made motions and communicated in creative ways… again, interacting and making the whole experience so much more than just taking a photo. It’s a higher level of theming altogether. Just amazing.

3. Awesome rides and attractions! I’ve visited Warner Bros Movie World in Australia (and I love it there!) but the rides and attractions at this Warner Bros World are so much more different and highly themed. I kept telling my son “these rides are so world-class” — they could easily compete alongside anything at Disney. Creative and fun… just loved them all! My favorite was the Bedrock River Adventure, but that’s because I’m a huge Flintstones fan! Love what they did with them here… and I hope they’ll never get rid of this area. I grew up in the years when Hanna-Barbera cartoons were the main programs we watched on Saturday morning television… it’s so nostalgic to see these cartoons coming back to life here at this park. Cartoon Junction was also another favorite area with Tom & Jerry, Scooby Doo and the Looney Tunes! My son (in his twenties) really loved the Metropolis and Gotham areas and attractions in this park.

Also notable mentions for the delicious food selections and many places to sit and relax in the park. Worldclass attraction that should be visited by anyone looking to have a fun day at a theme park. Loved it so much!

I recently visited this so-called “funhouse” attraction, but unfortunately, the name no longer fits. What should have been a lively and playful experience felt more like a dull walk-through. Many of the classic funhouse elements were either turned off or simply not working: no lighting effects in the mirror maze section, the escalator was just a regular staircase, and the spinning wheel at the end – once a highlight – was static and lifeless.

It seems like the operators may be erring on the side of excessive caution, but if that means stripping the attraction of all its interactive elements, then what’s the point? If the goal is to ensure absolute safety by removing everything that made it exciting, perhaps it’s time to consider retiring the attraction altogether and replacing it with something that can still thrill while respecting safety standards.

As it stands, it’s not a funhouse – it’s a sad house. Not worth the time!!!

reviews.text:
White Club Abu Dhabi — Extremely Disappointing Experience

My wife (52) and I (54) attended the “Old School Jam” event on 05 December 2025 and spent approximately four hours at the venue. We were initially welcomed very well, and the atmosphere at entry was pleasant.

However, this positive first impression was completely overshadowed by what followed. Over the course of the evening, we each had a few drinks — certainly no more than 10 per person. When we requested our bill upon leaving, we were shocked to be presented with a total of AED 2,000. Even more concerning, no itemized receipt was provided despite asking for one.

Without a transparent breakdown of charges, it is impossible to verify what we were actually billed for. This lack of billing transparency is unacceptable and left us feeling extremely uncomfortable and taken advantage of.

Unfortunately, this experience has completely eroded our trust in this establishment. We will not be returning and would strongly advise others to exercise caution and always insist on itemized billing before settling payment.

⸻

Very disappointed with White Club in Abu Dhabi.
Today my friends and I had an extremely unpleasant experience. We ordered specific drinks, but they brought us something completely different and, what is even more outrageous, charged us double the price for it! When we immediately said that we did not order those drinks, the waiter was incredibly rude, spoke to us arrogantly, and made no attempt to fix the issue.

The service is absolutely not what you would expect from a place that positions itself as high-end. Instead of apologizing and correcting the mistake, the staff acted as if we were at fault for placing an order at all. The atmosphere, which was supposed to be enjoyable, turned into a stressful experience — our evening was completely ruined.

I have been to many venues in Abu Dhabi, and I have never encountered such treatment towards customers. It is unacceptable to charge for something we did not order and then show such disrespect.

I do not recommend this club to anyone who values honesty, respectful service, and a pleasant experience. There are plenty of other places in the city where you can enjoy your time without this kind of negativity. White Club in Abu Dhabi is definitely not worth the money or attention.

reviews.text:
⸻

Very disappointed with White Club in Abu Dhabi.
Today my friends and I had an extremely unpleasant experience. We ordered specific drinks, but they brought us something completely different and, what is even more outrageous, charged us double the price for it! When we immediately said that we did not order those drinks, the waiter was incredibly rude, spoke to us arrogantly, and made no attempt to fix the issue.

The service is absolutely not what you would expect from a place that positions itself as high-end. Instead of apologizing and correcting the mistake, the staff acted as if we were at fault for placing an order at all. The atmosphere, which was supposed to be enjoyable, turned into a stressful experience — our evening was completely ruined.

I have been to many venues in Abu Dhabi, and I have never encountered such treatment towards customers. It is unacceptable to charge for something we did not order and then show such disrespect.

I do not recommend this club to anyone who values honesty, respectful service, and a pleasant experience. There are plenty of other places in the city where you can enjoy your time without this kind of negativity. White Club in Abu Dhabi is definitely not worth the money or attention.

reviews.text:
I recently visited WTCAD – World Trade Center Abu Dhabi (برج الشيخ محمد بن راشد), and it was an amazing experience.

The complex includes a modern shopping mall, Souk Central Market, residential and office towers, and several restaurants and cafés. The architecture beautifully combines modern elegance with traditional Arabic design, creating a unique and welcoming atmosphere.

The Souk area is especially charming — full of local crafts, perfumes, and souvenirs. The mall section features international brands and a variety of dining options, from casual bites to fine dining.

It’s a great place for shopping, exploring, or relaxing, right in the heart of Abu Dhabi. The location is central, and parking is convenient.

Overall, WTCAD perfectly blends culture, comfort, and modern lifestyle — highly recommended for both tourists and residents.

Review for Xtreme Zone - Sons Birthday Party

I recently had the pleasure of hosting my son s birthday party at Xtreme Zone in Abu Dhabi Mall, and I couldn't be happier with the experience! From start to finish, everything was exceptionally organized and fun.

The Xtreme Fun package was perfect for our group of 15 kids, offering a variety of attractions like the trampoline, climbing wall, and soft play area, which kept everyone entertained for hours. The party took place on September 25th, and the venue was set up beautifully in Hall-C.

A special shoutout goes to Doris and Malik, who went above and beyond in ensuring everything ran smoothly. They were attentive, friendly, and truly made the day memorable for my son and his friends. Their professionalism and enthusiasm created a joyful atmosphere that the kids absolutely loved.

The McDonald's catering was a hit with the kids, and the balloon decorations added a festive touch to the celebration. I appreciated the clear communication from the Xtreme Zone team regarding the event details and requirements, making the planning process seamless.

Overall, I highly recommend Xtreme Zone for anyone looking to host a fun and exciting birthday party. Thank you, Doris, Malik, and the entire team, for making my sons birthday so speciaL.

reviews.text: I have to explain why I’m giving this excellent place a 4 star: expectation vs price and comparison to Zuma Dubai. The Dubai branch was above and beyond and really deserving of 5 stars despite the expense. Here they fell short on multiple front. The tables were squeezed so tightly that navigating between them was an issue. The service while excellent but was too rushed. The appetizers were on the table in less than 5 min and the mains came in 10-15 min after. The miso soup was average. The shrimp tempura was very good but could be better. Nigiri was excellent but at this price range it is not compelling. The highlight of our meal was the sweet potato ice cream with pecan which was to die for. Would I come again or recommend? definitely yes after all I’m nitpicking because at this level I was expecting more.

reviews.text:
We celebrated our anniversary at Zuma today and it honestly couldn’t have been a better experience. From the moment we sat down, the service and hospitality stood out just as much as the food and drinks.

A special shout-out to Kamal, our main server. He struck the perfect balance between being attentive and giving us space to enjoy our meal. He checked on us at just the right times, always had an eye on our table without hovering, and even refolded our napkins every time we left the table – those small details that really make you feel looked after. He was warm, easy to talk to, asked if we were new to Zuma and the brunch, and made us feel genuinely welcome throughout.

We also had the pleasure of being looked after by Apollo, the sommelier. He was incredibly patient, humble and kind, with a calm, warm presence that makes you want to sit and chat with him about wine all afternoon. His recommendations were spot on, and you can tell he truly enjoys what he does. He explained the wines in a simple, friendly way and was very accommodating to our preferences. Just a great person to have guiding us through the wine list.

Another special mention to Dominique. He wasn’t even serving our table, but he was one of the only team members walking past who noticed the “Happy Anniversary” message on our dessert plate and acknowledged it. As people from the hospitality industry ourselves, we really appreciate those tiny touches of awareness and genuine guest care. That simple moment of recognition says a lot about him and about Zuma’s culture. He has a spark of personality that will definitely take him a long way and adds to the Zuma brand.

The food was outstanding – we left absolutely stuffed. The quality of the produce, especially the seafood and the raw dishes, really sets Zuma apart from other high-end places. You can taste the intention and care behind every plate. The wines were excellent, and even the coffee smelled and tasted amazing.

Overall, an incredible anniversary brunch. Huge thanks to Kamal, Apollo, Dominique and the rest of the Zuma team for making our day so special. 🌟🍷🍣 Highly recommended.

reviews.text:
Zuma never misses. Whether it’s lunch or dinner, the experience is top-tier from start to finish. I’ve been here more times than I can count and it’s consistently excellent, food, service, vibe, all on point.

The business lunch is one of the best deals in Abu Dhabi, generous portions, great variety, and perfectly executed dishes. You walk out full, satisfied, and still on schedule. For dinner, it’s a whole other level, dim lighting, smooth music, and that signature Zuma buzz that somehow makes even Tuesday feel like a Friday.

Favorites? Always the spicy beef tenderloin, black cod, sushi platter, and that dangerously good green tea banana cake. Cocktails? Sophisticated without trying too hard. Service? Polished, but human.

If I had one suggestion, maybe a couple more rotating seasonal specials or AD-exclusive dishes could keep things extra fresh for regulars like me. But honestly? Still five stars. Zuma is a benchmark for what dining in Abu Dhabi should feel like.

I have been dining at Zuma Abu Dhabi for over 11 years, and I have never experienced something this alarming. Today, I found a strange soft, purplish object in my salad  much larger than what was later shown to me and it was breaking apart when touched. The moment I saw it, I felt immediate stomach discomfort and a strong urge to vomit.
For a fine dining restaurant of this level, this is extremely unacceptable. The team told me they would “investigate,” but this should not happen in a place known for hosting high-profile guests and operating in a country with strict health and safety standards.
I am truly disappointed, and I hope the management takes this matter seriously. This experience was shocking and far from what I expect from Zuma.

We took a chance visiting Zuma on Sunday for lunch with our two kids, and the experience was truly five-star. While the reputation focuses on high-end cuisine, the atmosphere was perfectly welcoming for a family meal.
The food was, without question, excellent. The quality of the sushi and signature dishes is arguably the best in Abu Dhabi. Every single plate was executed flawlessly, arriving quickly and beautifully presented.
The service, however, truly elevates the experience. It was great: attentive but never intrusive. A special shoutout goes to Ana, our server, who made the entire lunch completely stress-free and ensured the children felt just as welcome as the adults.
Zuma proved that fine dining and family fun can absolutely coexist. We highly recommend it for a special weekend lunch.

reviews.text:
Zuma Abu Dhabi is absolutely amazing! Every time I visit, the experience is perfect from start to finish. The restaurant has a beautiful modern design with a warm and elegant atmosphere — perfect lighting, great music, and a lively vibe that makes it feel special the moment you walk in.

The food is incredible. Every dish is prepared with so much care and flavor — the sushi, black cod, and wagyu beef are on another level. The presentation is beautiful, and you can really taste the quality of every ingredient. Even the desserts are a work of art — the Zuma chocolate fondant is a must-try!

The staff are very professional, polite, and attentive without being too much. They always make sure everything is just right. The outdoor terrace is also stunning, especially during sunset with the beautiful Abu Dhabi skyline in view.

Yes, it’s a premium restaurant, but honestly worth every dirham for the quality, service, and atmosphere you get.

If you’re looking for the best dining experience in Abu Dhabi, I highly recommend Zuma — elegant, delicious, and unforgettable every single time.

reviews.text:
We celebrated our anniversary at Zuma today and it honestly couldn’t have been a better experience. From the moment we sat down, the service and hospitality stood out just as much as the food and drinks.

A special shout-out to Kamal, our main server. He struck the perfect balance between being attentive and giving us space to enjoy our meal. He checked on us at just the right times, always had an eye on our table without hovering, and even refolded our napkins every time we left the table – those small details that really make you feel looked after. He was warm, easy to talk to, asked if we were new to Zuma and the brunch, and made us feel genuinely welcome throughout.

We also had the pleasure of being looked after by Apollo, the sommelier. He was incredibly patient, humble and kind, with a calm, warm presence that makes you want to sit and chat with him about wine all afternoon. His recommendations were spot on, and you can tell he truly enjoys what he does. He explained the wines in a simple, friendly way and was very accommodating to our preferences. Just a great person to have guiding us through the wine list.

Another special mention to Dominique. He wasn’t even serving our table, but he was one of the only team members walking past who noticed the “Happy Anniversary” message on our dessert plate and acknowledged it. As people from the hospitality industry ourselves, we really appreciate those tiny touches of awareness and genuine guest care. That simple moment of recognition says a lot about him and about Zuma’s culture. He has a spark of personality that will definitely take him a long way and adds to the Zuma brand.

The food was outstanding – we left absolutely stuffed. The quality of the produce, especially the seafood and the raw dishes, really sets Zuma apart from other high-end places. You can taste the intention and care behind every plate. The wines were excellent, and even the coffee smelled and tasted amazing.

Overall, an incredible anniversary brunch. Huge thanks to Kamal, Apollo, Dominique and the rest of the Zuma team for making our day so special. 🌟🍷🍣 Highly recommended.

reviews.text:
Zuma never misses. Whether it’s lunch or dinner, the experience is top-tier from start to finish. I’ve been here more times than I can count and it’s consistently excellent, food, service, vibe, all on point.

The business lunch is one of the best deals in Abu Dhabi, generous portions, great variety, and perfectly executed dishes. You walk out full, satisfied, and still on schedule. For dinner, it’s a whole other level, dim lighting, smooth music, and that signature Zuma buzz that somehow makes even Tuesday feel like a Friday.

Favorites? Always the spicy beef tenderloin, black cod, sushi platter, and that dangerously good green tea banana cake. Cocktails? Sophisticated without trying too hard. Service? Polished, but human.

If I had one suggestion, maybe a couple more rotating seasonal specials or AD-exclusive dishes could keep things extra fresh for regulars like me. But honestly? Still five stars. Zuma is a benchmark for what dining in Abu Dhabi should feel like.

I have been dining at Zuma Abu Dhabi for over 11 years, and I have never experienced something this alarming. Today, I found a strange soft, purplish object in my salad  much larger than what was later shown to me and it was breaking apart when touched. The moment I saw it, I felt immediate stomach discomfort and a strong urge to vomit.
For a fine dining restaurant of this level, this is extremely unacceptable. The team told me they would “investigate,” but this should not happen in a place known for hosting high-profile guests and operating in a country with strict health and safety standards.
I am truly disappointed, and I hope the management takes this matter seriously. This experience was shocking and far from what I expect from Zuma.

Zuma Abu Dhabi is absolutely amazing! Every time I visit, the experience is perfect from start to finish. The restaurant has a beautiful modern design with a warm and elegant atmosphere — perfect lighting, great music, and a lively vibe that makes it feel special the moment you walk in.

The food is incredible. Every dish is prepared with so much care and flavor — the sushi, black cod, and wagyu beef are on another level. The presentation is beautiful, and you can really taste the quality of every ingredient. Even the desserts are a work of art — the Zuma chocolate fondant is a must-try!

The staff are very professional, polite, and attentive without being too much. They always make sure everything is just right. The outdoor terrace is also stunning, especially during sunset with the beautiful Abu Dhabi skyline in view.

Yes, it’s a premium restaurant, but honestly worth every dirham for the quality, service, and atmosphere you get.

If you’re looking for the best dining experience in Abu Dhabi, I highly recommend Zuma — elegant, delicious, and unforgettable every single time.

reviews.text: During my stay at the St Regis Resort in Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi, I did Dynamic Vinyasa with Mariam Almazrouei and Swing Yoga with sound healing with Rula Al Ghoul. Beautiful restaurant — the décor is absolutely fantastic and instantly sets the tone. It was a bit quiet when we visited, but it was a weekday, so understandable.

The food was excellent: the burrata was one of the best I’ve ever had, incredibly fresh and flavorful. The beef ribs were amazing, perfectly cooked and full of depth, and the peri-peri chicken was outstanding as well. Amira dessert was awesome.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful dining experience at this restaurant in Abu Dhabi. From the moment we arrived, the service stood out, the staffs were extremely polite, attentive, and genuinely helpful. The ambience is vibrant yet elegant, with great music, beautiful interiors, and a lively vibe that makes the entire place feel warm and welcoming. The food was excellent, with every dish thoughtfully prepared and full of flavor. The cocktails deserve a special mention, they were absolutely amazing. What impressed me most was how the staff took time to understand our preferences and suggested drinks and dishes that matched our taste perfectly. Valet parking is available. I would highly recommend making a reservation, especially on weekends, as it tends to get busy. Overall, it’s a must-visit spot in Abu Dhabi for anyone who appreciates great food, drinks, and atmosphere.

A Truly Royal Experience – Beyond All Expectations!

From the moment we arrived, we were treated to an exceptional experience that far exceeded our expectations. The ambiance was elegant and serene, creating the perfect setting for an unforgettable dining journey. The hospitality we received was nothing short of royal – every detail was thoughtfully curated to ensure we felt welcomed and valued.

Special thanks to our table waiter, Sunil, whose professionalism, deep knowledge of the cuisine, and passion for service truly stood out. He didn’t just serve the dishes – he handpicked them with great care, explained each component, and ensured every bite was perfect. His attention to detail and personalized recommendations elevated our entire dining experience.

Equally commendable was Barakat, our second waiter, whose cheerful demeanor and warm, polite service added so much joy to our time here. His genuine smiles and attentive care made us feel right at home, creating a relaxing and delightful atmosphere throughout.

Together, Sunil and Barakat delivered an outstanding level of service that turned our evening into something truly special. They are a shining example of hospitality done right.

We left with full hearts, satisfied taste buds, and wonderful memories. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a luxurious and heartfelt dining experience.

reviews.text:
⭐☆☆☆☆ Shockingly Poor Customer Service

We were a table of four and after finishing our first dessert, we simply asked for another round of churros. Since the portion only included five, we politely requested three more so everyone could have one. To our surprise, the manager, Belen, flat-out refused.

What made this even more unacceptable is that we had already ordered two bottles of wine and six additional glasses — clearly we were not a low-spending table. Meanwhile, the table next to us was only drinking beer, yet somehow we were treated as if asking for three extra churros was unreasonable. It felt petty, unwelcoming, and completely lacking in basic hospitality.

Belen’s attitude left a terrible impression and overshadowed what should have been an enjoyable evening. I walked out absolutely unhappy and disappointed. With service like this, I definitely will not be recommending this place to anyone.

reviews.text:
بصراحة مطعم الدلة الذهبية للمأكولات الشعبية من المطاعم اللي تفتح النفس ما شاء الله 👌🏻
من أول ما تدخل تحس بالريحة الزينة للمأكولات الإماراتية، ريحة الهيل والبهارات اللي تردّك لأيام الأولين 🇦🇪
الأكل عندهم لذيذ ونظيف، والتقديم مرتب والطعم فعلاً يبرد الخاطر 😋
جربت عندهم مكبوس الدياي وكان شي خيااالي، الرز مستوي عدل والبهارات موزونة، والدياي طري وطعمه ممتاز 👏🏻
وبعد صالونة الكنعد لذيذة بشكل ما ينقال، الصوص ثقيل وموزون والسمك فريش وطري جداً 😍
حتى الخبز والمقبلات لذيذة وتكمل التجربة، تحس إن الأكل معمول بحب واهتمام.
الخدمة طيبة والموظفين محترمين وبشوشين، والمكان نظيف ومرتب دايم 👏🏻
باختصار، مطعم يستاهل الزيارة والتكرار، خصوصاً لعشّاق الأكل الإماراتي الأصيل.
يعطيهم العافية، وإن شاء الله مب آخر زيارة 🤍

reviews.text:
بصراحة مطعم الدلة الذهبية للمأكولات الشعبية من المطاعم اللي تفتح النفس ما شاء الله 👌🏻
من أول ما تدخل تحس بالريحة الزينة للمأكولات الإماراتية، ريحة الهيل والبهارات اللي تردّك لأيام الأولين 🇦🇪
الأكل عندهم لذيذ ونظيف، والتقديم مرتب والطعم فعلاً يبرد الخاطر 😋
جربت عندهم مكبوس الدياي وكان شي خيااالي، الرز مستوي عدل والبهارات موزونة، والدياي طري وطعمه ممتاز 👏🏻
وبعد صالونة الكنعد لذيذة بشكل ما ينقال، الصوص ثقيل وموزون والسمك فريش وطري جداً 😍
حتى الخبز والمقبلات لذيذة وتكمل التجربة، تحس إن الأكل معمول بحب واهتمام.
الخدمة طيبة والموظفين محترمين وبشوشين، والمكان نظيف ومرتب دايم 👏🏻
باختصار، مطعم يستاهل الزيارة والتكرار، خصوصاً لعشّاق الأكل الإماراتي الأصيل.
يعطيهم العافية، وإن شاء الله مب آخر زيارة 🤍

But

There should be laws in place regarding the cost of food in these venues, every food areas prices are simply criminal!

reviews.text: Absolutely lovely! Do not miss this. The only thing I regret is not having more clarity on the shows, especially the dolphin shows. Loved the Arabic twist which was integrated into the small details, ensuring that local wildlife and local culture was represented. Nice options for kids of all ages. and park size is manageable. Lots of food options.
reviews.author: N A

reviews.text:
Ein toller und außergewöhnlicher Park.
Der fast komplett indoor gelegen ist. Nur die phantastische Achterbahn Manta mit drei Launch „Starts“ mit mehrfachen Airline Momenten hatte viel Spaß gemacht.
Die Mitarbeiter sind fast alle nett und freundlich und Gast orientiert.
Ein Besuch ist wirklich lohnenswert und eine Buchung vorweg mit Kombitickets sparrt auch den Geldbeutel.
Man sollte als Erwachsener mindestens 4 Stunden einplanen (plus Anfahrt von Abu Dhabi)
reviews.author: Krystian Cwikowski

reviews.text: Had an amazing experience here. All the zones are fantastic. Enjoyed watching the dolphin and the sea lion show. You wouldn't give reserved seats to folks with toddlers even if they reach the auditorium well before the show, but quick pass owners get reserved seating even at the last minute? I understand quick pass folks getting quick access , but why give them reserved seating ?

Anyway, endless ocean and Arctic circle is beautifully maintained at Sea World. We loved the penguin area and how everybody gets a chance to get close to the penguins in a habitat that suits them.

Loved the Polar region too, the Walrus was the big showstopper at the park. Maybe do something about the stench in that area ?

Food at Seaworld is pretty expensive, but the café near the penguin area is particularly goood and has good value for money.

We missed the mermaid show and there was just 1 show in the entire day. It was a bummer to not have caught that show. Felt like there could be announcements in the park or displays that showed timings and venues to these things..

The amazing 360 displays at the center of the park enthrall you and present a spectacular view of the shows.

We kept checking with various staff members about the "Pick a pearl" bit, but we failed to get any clarity on what it was all about and left without taking that experience ultimately.

reviews.text:
Major safety failure: no staff or security response to threats during a family show

We attended a show here with our two children (aged 4 and 7). What happened raised serious concerns about guest safety and the venue’s ability to manage incidents inside the amphitheater.

Seating was unassigned and guests were taking any available seats. I entered first and seated our child in a single free seat. No one indicated that the seat was reserved or being held. When my husband arrived a few minutes later, he sat with our child (the child remained in the same seat, sitting on his lap). At that point, a nearby group suddenly claimed the seat was being held.

A man from that group arrived about a minute before the end of the show and immediately began shouting at my husband, claiming the seat and making direct physical threats, all while standing next to our child. The situation continued despite the show being almost finished.

Most concerning was the complete lack of response from the venue. There was no visible staff or security presence in the amphitheater, and no intervention at any point. I was forced to leave one of our children alone and go into the corridor to try to find help, yet no assistance came. Even after the show ended, the aggressive behaviour continued and we left feeling unsafe.

The impact on our family was significant. Our children were frightened and distressed, and the rest of our day was affected by stress and anxiety after what should have been a normal family outing.

When we approached reception ourselves, we were told to stand in a queue and submit a complaint. This is not an appropriate response when guests have been threatened and children are involved. Later, we received an official reply describing the incident as a “misunderstanding.” We strongly disagree: physical threats, lack of intervention, and distressed children are not a misunderstanding.

We expect a formal follow-up from management and clear action to ensure visible staff and security presence, proper escalation procedures, and active monitoring during family shows. Without these measures, families cannot feel safe attending events at this venue.

reviews.text:
We liked this place overall.

The thing that bummed us the most about this place was the staff's behavior at the entry gate. They were checking bags and the checking lady in the extreme right line was super rude. She not only made us throw all food we had, but also spoke in a very condescending tone and humiliated us out of the queue.

I requested her to let us keep a piece of cake we got for our son, but NO, she asked us to throw that too. How else would food vendors inside the park earn if we get our son's favorite cake inside the park, even if it were to make sure he's not famished in the first half of the day.

I am all in for compliance and following rules, just be a little flexible when it comes to kids and a small piece of cake ain't hurting anybody. Toddlers are hard to console when something they're looking forward to, gets thrown in the bin.

Nevertheless, we started with the dolphin show. Very average. Kudos to the dolphins, but the stage presenters really need to up their game. No one could understand a word they said. The dolphin show at the Dubai Dolphinarium was wayyyyyyyyy better. Also, what's with the reserved seating at the auditorium ? You wouldn't give reserved seats to folks with toddlers even if they reach the auditorium well before the show, but quick pass owners get reserved seating even at the last minute? I understand quick pass folks getting quick access , but why give them reserved seating ?

Anyway, endless ocean and Arctic circle is beautifully maintained at Sea World. We loved the penguin area and how everybody gets a chance to get close to the penguins in a habitat that suits them.

Loved the Polar region too, the Walrus was the big showstopper at the park. Maybe do something about the stench in that area ?

Food at Seaworld is pretty expensive, but the café near the penguin area is particularly goood and has good value for money.

We missed the mermaid show and there was just 1 show in the entire day. It was a bummer to not have caught that show. Felt like there could be announcements in the park or displays that showed timings and venues to these things..

The amazing 360 displays at the center of the park enthrall you and present a spectacular view of the shows.

We kept checking with various staff members about the "Pick a pearl" bit, but we failed to get any clarity on what it was all about and left without taking that experience ultimately.

Seaworld does seem promising for a future visit. I'd like to give it another go in the future, hoping for a much better experience next time 🤞

reviews.text:
Major safety failure: no staff or security response to threats during a family show

We attended a show here with our two children (aged 4 and 7). What happened raised serious concerns about guest safety and the venue’s ability to manage incidents inside the amphitheater.

Seating was unassigned and guests were taking any available seats. I entered first and seated our child in a single free seat. No one indicated that the seat was reserved or being held. When my husband arrived a few minutes later, he sat with our child (the child remained in the same seat, sitting on his lap). At that point, a nearby group suddenly claimed the seat was being held.

A man from that group arrived about a minute before the end of the show and immediately began shouting at my husband, claiming the seat and making direct physical threats, all while standing next to our child. The situation continued despite the show being almost finished.

Most concerning was the complete lack of response from the venue. There was no visible staff or security presence in the amphitheater, and no intervention at any point. I was forced to leave one of our children alone and go into the corridor to try to find help, yet no assistance came. Even after the show ended, the aggressive behaviour continued and we left feeling unsafe.

The impact on our family was significant. Our children were frightened and distressed, and the rest of our day was affected by stress and anxiety after what should have been a normal family outing.

When we approached reception ourselves, we were told to stand in a queue and submit a complaint. This is not an appropriate response when guests have been threatened and children are involved. Later, we received an official reply describing the incident as a “misunderstanding.” We strongly disagree: physical threats, lack of intervention, and distressed children are not a misunderstanding.

We expect a formal follow-up from management and clear action to ensure visible staff and security presence, proper escalation procedures, and active monitoring during family shows. Without these measures, families cannot feel safe attending events at this venue.

reviews.text:
Das Wahat Al Karama Monument ist den Märtyrern der vereinigten Arabischen Emirate gewidmet, und ehrt die Taten der Kriegshelden, die ihr Leben für das Wohlergehen der Bürger der vereinigten Arabischen Emirate opferten. Das kostenlos zugängliche Monument, ist nachts beleuchtet, und ein Superfoto Spot für die große Moschee, die sich direkt gegenüber befindet.

Benötigte Besuchszeit : für die Besichtigung des Monuments, und die ebenfalls auf dem Gelände befindliche Kunstausstellung, sollten Besucher 30-45 Minuten einplanen.

Anreise: es gibt eine Fußgängerbrücke, die von der großen Moschee direkt rüber zu dem Monument führt, wodurch das Wahat Al Karama Monument einfach zu Fuß erreicht werden kann. Es stehen jedoch auch ausreichend kostenlose Parkplätze zur Verfügung, und für die Anreise mit dem öffentlichen Nahverkehr, gibt es eine Bushaltestelle, die sich ebenfalls direkt vor dem Monument befindet.

Shuttle Bus: es gibt einen Shuttle Bus, der im 30 Minuten Takt zwischen dem Wahat Al Karama Monument, und der großen Moschee hin und her fährt.

Eintritt: Das Wahat Al Karama Monument ist 24/7 kostenlos zugänglich, und Barriere frei!

reviews.text:
Of course. Here is an extremely positive review for Wahat Al Karama, written specifically for photographers.

★★★★★

The Ultimate Reflection Shot of the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque!

For photographers, Wahat Al Karama isn't just a beautiful memorial; it is the single best and most essential location in Abu Dhabi for capturing an iconic, postcard-perfect shot of the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.

The key is the massive, shallow reflection pool that forms the centerpiece of the memorial. It is a perfectly designed, giant liquid mirror. By positioning yourself at the far end of the pool, you can achieve a breathtaking, symmetrical reflection of the entire mosque, including all its domes and minarets.

The best time to shoot is unquestionably sunset. Arrive about an hour before sunset to secure your spot. You'll be able to capture the mosque during the golden hour as the warm light hits its white marble, then witness the sky explode with color, and finally, stay for the magical blue hour as the mosque's own lights turn on, creating a dazzling display in both the sky and the water.

Bring a tripod, a wide-angle lens, and some patience. The shot you will walk away with is absolutely world-class and worth the visit alone. A must-do for any serious cityscape or travel photographer visiting Abu Dhabi.

reviews.text:
عندما قررت زيارة مطعم "بيت يدوه" في أبوظبي، كنت أتطلع إلى تجربة فريدة ولا تُنسى في عالم الضيافة والطعام. لكن الواقع تجاوز توقعاتي بكثير.

بدايةً، لاحظت الاستقبال الحار والودود من فريق العمل، حيث كانوا يستقبلون الضيوف بابتسامات طيبة وترحيب يشعرك بالانتماء للمكان. بمجرد دخولي، أُبهرت بالتصميم الداخلي الرائع الذي يجمع بين الحداثة والتراث بشكل متناغم، مما يخلق أجواءً مميزة ومريحة للاستمتاع بتناول الطعام.

أما بالنسبة للطعام، فقد كانت كل تفاصيله مدروسة بعناية فائقة، حيث تميزت الأطباق بجودة المكونات والتقديم الراقي، مما جعل كل وجبة تتحول إلى تجربة لا تُنسى للحواس.

ولا يمكنني أن أتجاهل جودة الخدمة التي قدمها الفريق، فكانوا متفانين في راحة الضيوف وتلبية احتياجاتهم بكل احترافية وودّ.

بيت يدوه ليس مجرد مطعم، بل هو وجهة تجمع بين الثقافة والفن والطهي، حيث يمكن للزائر أن يستمتع بتجربة شاملة للأذواق والمشاعر. إنه مكان يثير الدهشة والإعجاب، ولا شك أنني سأعود مرارًا وتكرارًا للاستمتاع بسحره الفريد.

Here's the translation of the text into English, Spanish, and Chinese:

English:
"When I decided to visit 'Beit El Dweh' restaurant in Abu Dhabi, I was looking forward to a unique and unforgettable experience in the world of hospitality and food. But the reality exceeded my expectations by far.

Firstly, I noticed the warm and friendly reception from the team, as they welcomed guests with genuine smiles and a hospitality that made you feel like you belonged. Upon entering, I was impressed by the stunning interior design that harmoniously blends modernity with heritage, creating a distinctive and comfortable atmosphere for dining.

As for the food, every detail was meticulously crafted, with dishes characterized by the quality of ingredients and elegant presentation, turning each meal into an unforgettable sensory experience.

And I cannot ignore the quality of service provided by the team, as they were dedicated to the guests' comfort and needs with professionalism and warmth.

Beit El Dweh is not just a restaurant; it's a destination that brings together culture, art, and cuisine, allowing visitors to enjoy a comprehensive experience of tastes and emotions. It's a place of wonder and admiration, and I will undoubtedly return time and time again to savor its unique charm."

Spanish:
"Cuando decidí visitar el restaurante 'Beit El Dweh' en Abu Dhabi, estaba esperando una experiencia única e inolvidable en el mundo de la hospitalidad y la gastronomía. Pero la realidad superó con creces mis expectativas.

En primer lugar, noté la cálida y amigable recepción por parte del equipo, ya que recibían a los huéspedes con sonrisas genuinas y una hospitalidad que te hacía sentir como en casa. Al entrar, me impresionó el impresionante diseño interior que combina armónicamente la modernidad con el patrimonio, creando una atmósfera distintiva y confortable para comer.

En cuanto a la comida, cada detalle estaba meticulosamente elaborado, con platos caracterizados por la calidad de los ingredientes y una presentación elegante, convirtiendo cada comida en una experiencia sensorial inolvidable.

Y no puedo ignorar la calidad del servicio proporcionado por el equipo, ya que estaban dedicados al confort y las necesidades de los huéspedes con profesionalismo y calidez.

Beit El Dweh no es solo un restaurante; es un destino que reúne cultura, arte y cocina, permitiendo a los visitantes disfrutar de una experiencia completa de sabores y emociones. Es un lugar de asombro y admiración, y sin duda volveré una y otra vez para disfrutar de su encanto único."

Chinese:
"当我决定去阿布扎比的“贝特尔杜埃”餐厅时，我期待着在款待和美食的世界中获得独特而难忘的体验。但事实远远超出了我的预期。

首先，我注意到团队的热情友好接待，他们用真诚的微笑和让人感到宾至如归的热情欢迎客人。一进门，我就被迷人的室内设计所震撼，它将现代与传统巧妙地融合在一起，为用餐创造了独特而舒适的氛围。

至于食物，每一个细节都经过精心制作，菜肴的特点是优质的食材和优雅的呈现方式，使每一餐都变成了令人难忘的感官体验。

我不能忽视团队提供的优质服务，他们专注于客人的舒适和需求，以专业精神和热情对待。

“贝特尔杜埃”不仅仅是一家餐厅；它是一个汇聚了文化、艺术和美食的目的地，让游客享受到全方位的味觉和情感体验。它是一个令人惊叹和钦佩的地方，我毫无疑问会一次又一次地返回，享受它独特的魅力。"

reviews.text:
Yadoo’s House Restaurant & Cafe is a charming family-style restaurant where you can dine in true Emirati style. The name means ‘grandmother’s house’ and that warm, welcoming, traditional environment is exactly what you’ll find here, alongside great local cuisine.

Noteworthy dishes include the various majboos (Emirati chicken rice), salona (chicken stew), and kofta offerings. However, just like an accommodating relative, you’ll find some more western dishes for the less adventurous, including pasta dishes and sandwiches. There’s even a dedicated kids’ menu.
